jobs.title: Programming and game design club instructor
jobs.description:
**Brief:**

We are looking for game educators whose hearts beat for creativity, game design, and 21st-century skills! In this role, you will act as the mentor and guide for two of our awesome club themes: _My Own Game Studio_ and _Coding and Future Skills_. You will lead children and young people behind the scenes of the digital world, helping them develop logical thinking and breathe life into their own game ideas in a safe and engaging online environment.

**About us:**

School of Gaming (SOG) is a game-based education and digital youth work company that combines education and gaming in a fun and safe way. We provide children and young people with opportunities to develop 21st-century skills such as teamwork, problem-solving, and creativity. Our trained game educators guide kids in inspiring online clubs and courses with a strong social and educational impact.

**Description:**

Have you ever wondered what it feels like to be the one pulling the strings behind the scenes of a game studio? Now is your chance to become the boss of your own game studio and lead the talents of tomorrow from initial idea to final publication. And don't worry, we don't require you to move to Silicon Valley! You can stay right in your gaming chair in Finland or work at your local school. Or both!

Your mission is to guide and mentor groups of 10–15 young, creative gamers. In the _My Own Game Studio_ club, you aren't just coding. You are setting up a whole production team, including scriptwriters, graphic designers, sound designers, and producers. You will help kids identify their strengths and collaborate. In the _Coding and Future Skills_ club, you will step behind the digital curtain using the globally acclaimed Code.org platform.

Rather than spoon-feeding answers or mechanically grinding code syntax, you encourage them to try, fail, and figure things out on their own. Your role is to tickle their gray brain cells, spark their curiosity, and create challenges for them to solve.

**What We Are Looking For:**

- You know which way to hold a mouse and you understand the mechanics and culture of gaming worlds.

- You have a visual eye or a basic understanding of the different aspects of game design (coding, graphics, audio, or storytelling).

- We greatly appreciate it if you have former experience guiding small humanoids on Tellus (e.g., camp counselor, club instructor, or youth work).

- If gaming is your passion and you love stepping into stories and play, you are the Game Educator we want!


We provide plenty of materials, ready-made templates, and infinite support 24/7.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the interaction between information systems and machine learning
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in action-oriented modeling for trustworthy AI, available at the Department of Informatics, University of Oslo.

The starting date is no later than 01.03.2027 and as soon as possible after the appointment.

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years.

The fellowship is funded in full by TRUST for the whole period. No teaching, supervision, or research-assistance duties are required in the position, and the fellowship period can therefore not be extended to four years on that basis.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo. The successful candidate will be part of the daily research and social life of TRUST – the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, and of the information systems research group.


Project description

The position is funded by TRUST, the Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI, which is a research centre dedicated to developing trustworthy AI systems that are accurate, fair, transparent, safe, and well-governed. The centre brings together researchers from computational and data science, law, social sciences, and philosophy to develop new AI technologies and study their societal impact in areas such as healthcare, industry, governance, security, and climate. TRUST is led by University of Oslo, SINTEF, and Norwegian Computing Center. With a consortium of over 70 partners from academia, industry, government, and civil society in Norway and internationally, TRUST’s research is theoretical, methodological, legal, and empirical in nature.

The postdoc will conduct the research project Action-Oriented Modeling for Trustworthy AI in Practice. The project addresses a persistent problem in applied AI: statistically accurate models routinely fail when they meet the organizations and ecosystems meant to use them. Models are misaligned with local procedures and decision processes, too rigid for resource-constrained operational systems, and opaque to the decision-makers who must act based on them. We treat this as a methodological problem rather than a technical one.

The primary deliverable of this position is a theoretical and methodological template that we call Action-Oriented Modeling. Rather than delivering finished algorithms, the template specifies how to build deliberately context-agnostic model architectures that expose methodological choices as parameters, and how local actors then configure, tune, and operate them. Its novelty lies in integrating three dimensions normally treated separately: configurable architectures that let domain experts shape model behavior without machine learning expertise; iterative field validation inside operational workflows; and governance mechanisms that transfer model ownership to local users.

The successful candidate will lead the development of this template into a generic, transferable, and theoretically grounded contribution. Your main tasks are to:

  • Develop, formalize, and publish the Action-Oriented Modeling template. This is the central output
  • Validate the template empirically through an action research design approach supplemented by participatory design methods
  • Define governance principles for model ownership that let stakeholders revise models as operational contexts change
  • Coordinate collaboration between the core development team, implementation partners, and local stakeholders, and act as a competence hub for action-oriented AI across TRUST

Two contrasting cases provide the empirical ground. The primary case is climate-sensitive disease prediction supporting public health decisions in low- and middle-income countries, built on DHIS2 and the action research network of the Health Information Systems Programme (HISP), with national health teams in ten countries. The complementary case is KoSy, the DHIS2-based municipal surveillance platform run by the Norwegian Institute of Public Health. We seek a candidate motivated by the methodological contribution to these and other empirical settings.

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in information systems, informatics, computer science, science and technology studies, or another relevant field. The applicant must document that the degree corresponds to the requirement. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eventually eligible for appointment
  • Documented experience with engaged, qualitative research methods in organizational settings, such as action research, design science research, or participatory design
  • Documented ability to publish conceptual, theoretical, or methodological contributions in high-ranking peer-reviewed journals or conferences
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience conducting sociotechnical research on information systems, examining how technology, people, and organizational contexts interact
  • Understanding of machine learning and predictive modeling sufficient to engage critically and constructively with data scientists, for example on data quality and model assumptions
  • Technical skills sufficient to deploy and test models

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

In terms of personal skills:

  • You are motivated by methodological questions, enjoy qualitative fieldwork, and are excited about the academic challenge of turning messy empirical data into clear theoretical contributions
  • You work well both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team, and you communicate across the boundary between technical and institutional expertise
  • You collaborate respectfully and effectively with practitioners and decision-makers who are not researchers
  • You work in a professional and structured manner and adapt quickly to new tasks
  • You are dependable and high-performing, also in hectic periods
  • You prefer being present at work and contribute actively to the professional and social environment you are part of

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • A position at the centre of a national research effort on trustworthy AI, with access to the TRUST network and to operational partners in ten countries
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter, stating your motivation, summarizing your scientific work, and describing your research interests. The cover letter should not be written with the help of AI
  • A research statement of no more than three pages, setting out how you would approach the development and validation of the Action-Oriented Modeling template. The statement must connect clearly to the development of the template, and it is the main basis on which the evaluation committee will assess your fit for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activity
  • Copies of educational certificates and academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that you wish to be considered by the evaluation committee. Please link these 5 publications, do not send them, except if they are still in manuscript format
  • Names and contact details of 2 to 3 references, with name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years).

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.description:
Personlig assistent för man i rullstol - Ulricehamn

Vi söker nu en engagerad och omtänksam personlig assistent till en man i rullstol i centrala Ulricehamn. Som assistent kommer du att vara en viktig del av kundens vardag och ge stöd inom olika områden.

I denna roll kommer du att assistera kunden med personlig hygien, måltider, övriga dagliga aktiviteter samt vara behjälplig med att svara i telefonen och hantera kommunikation med externa parter. Du kommer vara kundens förlängda armar och ben, och din närvaro kommer göra en verklig skillnad i hans liv. Lika viktigt som att ingripa när det behövs behöver man ha respekt och förståelse när man ska ta ett steg tillbaka och låta kunden få tid för sig själv.

Erfarenhet/Kvalifikationer:

    Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt och respektfullt.
    Empatisk och tålamodig samt har förmåga att lyssna och vara stödjande.
    Förmåga att vara flexibel och anpassa sig till kundens behov och önskemål.

Personliga egenskaper:

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, lyhörd och har förmågan att skapa en trygg och tillitsfull relation med kunden. Du är noggrann och pålitlig samt har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och ta egna initiativ när det behövs. Det är viktigt att du är följsam och respektfull gentemot kundens integritet och önskemål. Du har inga problem med axlar eller rygg då en del tunga lyft förekommer i arbetet.

Vad vi erbjuder dig som anställd:

    En meningsfull och givande arbetsuppgift där du kan göra verklig skillnad i en persons liv.
    Möjlighet att utveckla din förmåga att kommunicera, arbeta med empati och skapa relationer.
    Ett positivt och stöttande arbetsklimat där din insats uppskattas och värderas högt.


Anställningen är vid behov när ordinarie personal är sjuk eller ledig. Arbetspassen är mån-sön kl 10-19.30

Om du känner att du har den empati, engagemang och vilja som krävs för att vara en bra personlig assistent, och vill vara en del av att skapa en meningsfull vardag för en annan person, tveka inte att söka till denna position. Vi ser fram emot att få träffa dig och välkomna dig till vårt team!

Monument Assistans är alternativet för personer med personlig assistans som söker skräddarsydda lösningar. Vi har hög kompetens och bred erfarenhet av personlig assistans. För att vi ska kunna hjälpa våra kunder på allra bästa sätt så arbetar vi med hög tillgänglighet och ett nära och personligt samarbete.

Vi vet att vår personal är nyckeln till att bedriva en bra personlig assistans. Därför är det centralt för oss att du som medarbetare är både känner stolthet och glädje över att arbeta hos oss. Vi på Monument Assistans vill därför ge dig möjligheten att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vi uppskattar nyfikna och engagerade medarbetare.

Vi erbjuder dig goda lönevillkor, ett nära ledarskap och friskvårdsersättning. Vi ger dig en arbetsmiljö där det är högt i tak och där du har goda möjligheter att påverka din egen arbetssituation. Vi tar gärna fram individuella fortbildningslösningar beroende på i vilken typ av uppdrag du arbetar i. Hos oss får du möjligheten att växa!

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer – Satellite Communications at Ovzon
jobs.description:
At Ovzon, you will work with the space-based systems that enable satellite communications when terrestrial infrastructure is insufficient, unavailable or disrupted. The role combines RF engineering and system-level design with requirements engineering, procurement, supplier collaboration and verification.

About the role

Ovzon develops and delivers integrated mobile satellite communication services. Its communications system includes Ovzon 3, the company’s proprietary geostationary satellite, featuring steerable spot beams and an On-Board Processor that enables communication even when ground infrastructure is limited or unavailable.

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will work at the heart of Ovzon’s technical organization and take responsibility for how the communications system is designed, specified and verified as a whole. The role requires a broad system perspective: understanding how different technical domains interact, evaluating alternative solutions and ensuring that external suppliers meet defined requirements.

You will be based at Ovzon’s Stockholm office, where much of the company’s technical development takes place. The workplace combines a highly specialized engineering environment with an open, forward-looking culture and close collaboration across technical disciplines. Many colleagues bring experience from the space industry and strong academic backgrounds, creating an environment where technical discussions, shared learning and complex problem-solving are part of the day-to-day work. With additional offices in the United States, you will also be part of an international organization with connections across teams and markets.

Responsibilities

You will work across the full development chain, from technical needs and system requirements to delivered and verified solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

    Developing, structuring and maintaining technical requirements for satellite communication systems.
    Contributing to system-level design and evaluating alternative technologies and technical trade-offs.
    Preparing technical documentation for procurement processes and evaluating proposals and supplier solutions.
    Reviewing technical documentation and ensuring that partners and suppliers meet defined requirements.
    Developing and reviewing RF, link and capacity budgets.
    Defining verification plans and acceptance criteria, and supporting the validation team with system knowledge and test planning.
    Managing regulatory requirements within radio communications and contributing to cybersecurity requirements for the communications system.
    Coordinating technical matters across internal specialists, partners and suppliers, and leading smaller technical projects when required.

We are looking for someone who

    Holds a relevant technical degree, for example in electrical engineering, engineering physics, space engineering, telecommunications or systems engineering.
    Has several years of relevant experience in systems engineering, requirements engineering or technically advanced communication systems.
    Has practical experience of formulating, structuring or following up technical requirements.
    Can understand complex systems and the interfaces between areas such as RF, networks, software, hardware and external subsystems.
    Is comfortable reading, writing and assessing technical documentation.
    Is fluent in English, both spoken and written.

It is considered an advantage if you have:

    A Systems Engineering certification, such as ASEP or CSEP.
    Experience in satellite communications, radio communications, telecommunications or other RF-based systems.
    Worked with RF or link budgets, frequency planning or regulatory matters within radio communications.
    Experience in technical procurement, proposal evaluation or requirements management involving external suppliers.
    Worked with verification planning, requirements traceability or validation of complex systems.
    Experience of cybersecurity requirements for communication systems.
    Professional working proficiency in Swedish.

To succeed in the role, you combine technical curiosity with a structured and pragmatic approach. You can move between detailed requirements and the wider system perspective, document your conclusions and drive technical matters forward even when all the answers are not yet available. You collaborate closely with specialists and suppliers while taking ownership of your analyses and follow-up.

About the employment

This is a consultancy assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The shared intention of Friday and Ovzon is for you to transition to direct employment with Ovzon after 12 months.

This position is placed in a security class. Employment is therefore subject to successful completion of a security vetting process, including a register check, in accordance with Swedish security protection legislation.

Applicants who already have the legal right to work in Sweden will be prioritized. Work permit sponsorship may be considered in exceptional cases.

Practical information

    Employment: Full-time
    Start date: By agreement
    Location: Stockholm
    Salary: Market-aligned monthly salary
    Contact person: Anna Persson

About Friday

Friday connects technical specialists with companies where their knowledge and ambitions can develop over time. We take the time to understand what you are looking for and match you with roles that fit both your experience and your next career step.

We value potential and ambition and work actively toward an inclusive recruitment process in which candidates are assessed on relevant qualifications and experience.

Friday has offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Each year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and recruit technical specialists for organisations ranging from international companies to growing technology businesses.

jobs.title: Fine dining floor manager til Tamashii
jobs.description:
I November åbner Norrlyst Koncernen dørene til Tamashii - et nyt ambitiøst restaurantprojekt på en af Københavns mest unikke lokationer

Tamashii betyder “sjæl” på japansk, og køkkenet bliver moderne asiatisk med Henrik Jyrks personlige aftryk. Ambitionen er høj, med teknik og råvarekvalitet i den skarpe ende, men uden den formalitet, der ofte forbindes med fine dining.

Fra køkken og service til vinkort og indretning er Tamashii skabt med en ambition om at nå Michelin-niveau.

Nu søger vi en floor manager der vil være med til at sætte retningen for hele gæsteoplevelsen og stå i spidsen for et hold, hvor service, struktur og nærvær er afgørende.

Om Norrlyst Koncernen

Norrlyst Koncernen står bag nogle af Københavns mest markante restauranter og vinbarer. Fælles for vores steder er en kompromisløs tilgang til kvalitet, stærkt værtskab og et ønske om konstant at udvikle os.

Vi tror på, at de bedste restauranter skabes af mennesker, der tager ansvar, skaber relationer og løfter hinanden. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med ledelse, kultur og udvikling – og vi giver plads til dem, der vil sætte deres præg.

Som floor manager bliver du en nøgleperson i åbningen og får du sammen med restaurantchefen ansvaret for at skabe rammerne for en serviceoplevelse, der er lige så gennemtænkt som gastronomien.

Rollen

Du bliver den daglige leder af restauranten sammen med restaurantchefen.

Du skal sikre, at gæsteoplevelsen hænger sammen fra første kontakt til sidste farvel – og at teamet arbejder som én enhed, hvor struktur, overblik og energi går hånd i hånd.

Du er tæt på driften, men også på kulturen. Du er synlig på gulvet, sætter retning for dit team og skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor faglighed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring med fine dining.

  • Er en stærk leder, der kan skabe ro, struktur og energi i service.

  • Har et naturligt værtskab og brænder for at skabe gode gæsteoplevelser.

  • Arbejder struktureret

  • Trives med ansvar og motiveres af at bygge en kultur op fra bunden.

  • Er tydelig, nærværende og god til at få mennesker til at lykkes sammen.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i åbningen af et nyt og ambitiøst restaurantprojekt.

  • Indflydelse på opbygningen af service, struktur og team.

  • Muligheden for at præge kulturen fra første dag.

  • Attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår.

  • Personalefordele på tværs af Norrlyst Koncernens restauranter og vinbarer.

Hvis du motiveres af værtskab, ledelse og ambitionen om at skabe en restaurantoplevelse på højt niveau, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Product Manager AnoxKaldnes MBBR
jobs.description:
Veolia – Driving Ecological Transformation

Veolia is a global leader in environmental services, operating on all five continents with nearly 218,000 employees. The company specialises in water, energy and waste management, and develops and implements innovative solutions for decarbonisation, pollution remediation and resource recovery – supporting communities and industries in their ecological transformation.

Within Water Tech, a dedicated team of experienced professionals works to address the world's most complex challenges related to water scarcity, water quality, productivity and energy. Together, we strive towards a shared goal: to create a more sustainable future.

At Veolia, diverse perspectives are encouraged and valued. Joining us means you will be part of a network that makes a real difference – for society and for the environment.

About the role

Are you passionate about driving growth and innovation in wastewater treatment technology? We're seeking an experienced Product Manager to drive accretive profitable growth of the AnoxKaldnes MBBR technology portfolio, including MBBR, Hybas, AnitaMox, eXeno, and Cella.

In this dynamic role, you'll sit at the intersection of technology, market intelligence, supply chain, and commercial strategy, working closely with the Aerobic Wastewater Technologies Leader to define and execute the technology strategy.

Strategy & Innovation

    Curate and maintain the technology roadmap for the AnoxKaldnes MBBR portfolio
    Define and drive the innovation roadmap by identifying gaps and opportunities through market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitive analysis
    Monitor and analyze market trends, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics to anticipate future technology needs
    Work closely with the Aerobic Wastewater Technologies Leader to define technology and business strategy

Commercialization & Go-to-Market

    Lead the commercialization of new technologies and offers, from core offering definition through launch and adoption tracking
    Develop and execute go-to-market strategies and launch plans
    Develop compelling marketing messaging and positioning for the technology portfolio; collaborate with marketing and communications functions to produce impactful marketing content and campaigns
    Champion new technology introductions and represent the portfolio at industry conferences, customer events, and technical forums

Cross-Functional Collaboration

    Work transversally across the organization—engaging with sales, engineering, R&D, marketing, communications, regional teams, and other business lines (EPP, MWIS)
    Collaborate with regions to understand local market needs and ensure global relevance with local applicability
    Establish and maintain relationships with key external stakeholders including customers, industry partners, research institutions, and technology collaborators
    Enable the commercial organization through training, technical content, and thought leadership

Business Operations

    Support the development of technology training and educational programs for internal teams and external clients
    Contribute to business planning processes, including annual strategic planning and investment prioritization
    Provide timely reporting and strategic recommendations to senior management
    Maintain accurate documentation of technology roadmaps, innovation pipelines, and commercialization plans

Education

    Minimum Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, or equivalent professional experience
    MBA or business-related qualification is an asset

Professional Experience

    Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience in water/wastewater treatment, including familiarity with biological treatment technologies (MBR, MBBR, MABR, BAF, or equivalent)
    Demonstrated experience in technology management, product management, or innovation management roles
    Experience developing and executing technology or product roadmaps
    Experience with commercialization of new technologies or products, including go-to-market strategy development
    Experience working in a matrix or transversal organizational structure
    Experience engaging with regional or global teams across multiple markets
    Experience with marketing strategy and technical communication

Language Skills

    Written and oral English proficiency required
    Other languages encouraged

Key Competencies

    Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills with the ability to translate market insights into actionable plans

    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization

    Ability to communicate clearly and concisely on complex technical matters to both technical and non-technical audiences

    Strong customer orientation and market awareness

    Self-driven, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously

Other Requirements

    Valid driving license (Category B)

Why join us?

Be part of a forward-thinking team focused on ecological transformation. Work with global experts in water treatment and contribute to environmental sustainability. If you join us you join a company that values knowledge sharing and personal development but most importantly you join a company where we pride ourselves on our friendly, open and collaborative atmosphere.

We can offer you freedom in return for responsibility. We are convinced that the right person for this job will have an exciting future!

Location: Based in Lund, Sweden .

jobs.title: Er du en trygg, leken og omsorgsfull person som liker musikk og å skape gode øyeblikk?
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
Er du en trygg, leken og omsorgsfull person som liker musikk og å skape gode øyeblikk? Da håper vi du vil bli en del av teamet vårt!

Vi søker nå etter flere assistenter til ei blid og livsglad jente på 11 år. Hun elsker musikk, lek og aktivitet, og trenger assistenter som kan bidra til at hverdagen hennes blir både trygg, innholdsrik og morsom. I utgangspunktet søker vi etter noen som ønsker å jobbe i ca 20-50% stilling. Det er mulig å tilpasse stillingsprosent, så skriv gjerne i søknaden hvor mye du ønsker å jobbe.

Som BPA-assistent blir du en viktig del av hverdagen hennes. Arbeidsdagene er varierte og består blant annet av:

  • Bistand ved måltider og personlig pleie
  • Lek, aktiviteter og sosialt samvær
  • Legging og kveldsrutiner
  • Transport til og fra aktiviteter
  • Trening og tilrettelegging for mestring
  • Lett husarbeid knyttet til hennes hverdag

Arbeidstidene vil kunne være:

  • Ettermiddag/kveld: kl. 15.00–21.30
  • Nattevakter: kl. 21.30–08.00
  • Dagtid 08.00-15.00 i skolefri perioder

Det vil bli noe endringer i vaktene i skoleferier og helligdager

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er positiv, fleksibel og løsningsorientert
  • Trives sammen med barn og liker å by på deg selv
  • Er trygg, omsorgsfull og ansvarsbevisst
  • Tar initiativ og ser hva som trengs
  • Er glad i musikk og lek
  • Snakker og skriver flytende norsk

Det er krav om førerkort og plettfri politiattest.

Vi tilbyr

Hos Prima Assistanse får du mer enn bare en jobb – du får muligheten til å gjøre en reell forskjell i et barns liv. Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull og givende arbeidshverdag
  • God opplæring og tett oppfølging
  • Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser gjennom egen tariffavtale
  • Et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg! Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende, så ikke vent med å søke.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Group AP/AR Administrator
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Group AP/AR Administrator to Akind, an international group with high ambitions and a clear goal of being the best place to grow, for both people and business. Come join us!

About the role

Akind is a family of brands (Academic Work, Brights, Winona, Crowd Collective) located in six European countries. We are now looking for a Group AP/AR Administrator to join our international finance team based in Linköping.  

As part of the Group AP/AR team, you will have a primary focus on Accounts Payable (AP). You will take responsibility for the day-to-day AP process while also getting the opportunity to learn and gradually take on other processes within the team.

The team consists of six colleagues with diverse experiences, and together we manage three core processes: Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Credit. We handle the financial flows for approximately 35 companies across six countries. While you will have a clear area of responsibility (AP), we believe in sharing knowledge across the team and building an understanding of the full financial flow. Over time, you will therefore have the opportunity to learn more of the team's processes and broaden your expertise.

Work tasks

Your main responsibilities within Accounts Payable will include:

    Manage the AP process from invoice arrival to payment and post-control.
    Register and maintain supplier information and set up new suppliers.
    Handle supplier reminders and discrepancies.
    Communicate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve questions and issues.
    Ensure accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments.
    Contribute to improving AP processes, routines, and ways of working.

As you become familiar with the AP process, you will also have the opportunity to learn more about the other areas managed by the team, for example:

    Accounts Receivable: Invoicing for our various companies and providing support throughout the process. You will act as a problem solver and guide colleagues across the organization on billing issues.
    Credit: Conduct manual credit assessments for new and existing customers, reconciling bank payments, and managing potential debt risks.
    Team support: Provide first-class support in AP/AR and credit to colleagues across the organization, as well as to our clients and suppliers.
    Continuous improvement: Contribute to best practices that increase quality and efficiency. You will work daily in systems such as Workday, Basware, and Google Sheets, and we encourage you to challenge our current ways of working as we evolve.

You will be part of a larger finance department in Linköping consisting of approximately 30 employees. Our culture is defined by ambitious and kind people; we are convinced that our employees are the foundation of our growth. That is why we invest in both individual development and strong leadership.

We are looking for

    Experience: At least 2 years of experience working with Accounts Payable, experience from working with Accounts Receivable is a plus.
    Experience from delivering great service to customers or colleagues.
    Language: Fluency in Swedish and English is required for daily international contact with clients and colleagues.
    You are comfortable working in various systems. Experience with Workday or Basware is a plus.

We are looking for a highly responsible and orderly individual who handles sensitive data with the highest level of accuracy. You have a supportive mindset and build trust easily with both internal and external partners. You are comfortable taking ownership of your work, while also knowing when to ask for support or involve others. You manage to stay calm and professional even when explaining complex financial matters to a stressed colleague.

You are also curious and enjoy learning. While AP will be your main area of responsibility, you are interested in understanding how the different parts of the financial flow connect and in gradually broadening your knowledge within the team. You enjoy an international, fast-changing environment where continuous improvement is the norm.

Recruitment Process

    Logic and personality tests (Alva Labs)
    Phone interview with Talent Acquisition
    Digital interview with Talent Acquisition
    Final interview with the Hiring Manager and a chance to meet the team.

The final date to apply is October 10th but the recruitment process is ongoing so we may proceed with candidates to the next stage before the final date to apply.

Why join us?

    Community: We are a team that truly enjoys working together. We have a policy of being in the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays and Fridays are our fixed team days).
    Benefits: You’ll receive a comprehensive benefits package, including a generous wellness allowance, occupational pension, and health insurance. Plus, we enjoy "Akind Breakfast" on Tuesdays and "Finance Breakfast" on Fridays!
    Development: You will receive a warm onboarding where we train you with care. While you will have a clear focus on AP, you will also have the opportunity to learn other processes within the team and continuously broaden your financial expertise. As part of a company aiming to lead the way in digital innovation, you will have great opportunities to grow alongside us and within the team.

jobs.title: 5R People Malaga søger kundekonsulenter
jobs.description:
5R People Malaga søger nye kollegaer der ønsker at arbejde med salg og kundeservice! Afdelingen er placeret ved byens bedste strand, Malagueta, og beskæftiger ca. 35 glade danske kollegaer, der løser forskellige opgaver, som primært er rettet imod det danske marked. Afdelingen har eksisteret siden 2015, og har fået opbygget den samme respekt og troværdig som vores danske afdelinger. 

5R People er et kontaktcenter, og vi ønsker at skille os ud fra mængden, ved at levere en oplevelse udover det sædvanlige for både medarbejdere, kunder og kundernes kunder. Vi leverer et professionelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor trivsel og udvikling er i fokus, og hvor opgaven er, at sikre den bedste oplevelse ud i mod vores kunder og deres kunder. 

Vi tilbyder: 

  • Fuldtid 

  • Fast timeløn + fordelagtig provisionsordning uden loft 

  • Beliggenhed ved byens bedste strand 

  • Tryg og sikker udstationering med særdeles ordnede forhold 

  • Hjælp til arbejds- og opholdstilladelse 

  • Professionel oplæring 

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling 

  • Et udvidet netværk bestående af 500+ engagerede kollegaer 

  • Intern eller ekstern karriereudvikling 

  • Arbejdsopgaver indenfor salg 

  • Medspillende og motiverede ledere 

Hvorfor skal du være vores nye kollega? 

Hos 5R People har vi en seriøs tilgang til det at drive et kontaktcenter. Det betyder at du vil opleve at blive grundigt oplært, og modtage løbende træning og uddannelse. Det er ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med salg og/eller kundeservice, det vigtigste er, at du har lysten til at lære det. Hos os er der plads til alle! 

Som vores nye kollega vil du opleve at repræsentere anerkendte og respekterede virksomheder. 

Et job hos 5R People kan således være starten på en lang og spændende rejse med mange muligheder. 

Hvorfor søge hos 5R People? 

Som medarbejder hos 5R People vil du komme til at arbejde i et godt miljø omgivet af skønne kollegaer. Du vil komme til at indgå i et kompetent og velfungerende team, hvor du vil få ansvar for egne resultater, og samtidig blive udfordret i hverdagen med spændende opgaver. 

Hos os får du de bedste værktøjer til at udvikle dit talent, både på det faglige og personlige plan.   

Du får mulighed for at blive en kompetent medarbejder med erfaring og viden, som gør dig eftertragtet på arbejdsmarkedet, og som giver dig en kommunikationsmæssig kompetence, der er guld for din fremtid, uagtet om det er hos 5R People eller ved dit næste job. 

Der er medarbejdere i alle aldersgrupper, og et godt fællesskab på tværs af alle afdelinger. Du bliver således en del af en arbejdsplads med et godt arbejdsmiljø i gode rammer og fantastisk beliggenhed. 

Skulle du have nogle spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Chef Birgitha Mühlensteth på telefon +45 87 46 90 00 eller sende en mail til info@5rpeople.dk 

Send din ansøgning til: job.malaga@5rpeople.dk 

Læs mere om 5R People på http://www.5rpeople.dk

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja teknisesti osaavaa henkilöä osaksi Sähkö-Teamin korjaamotiimiä. Työ on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen ja työtä tehdään arkisin klo 07.30 – 16.00. Tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme kirjoille.

Työ painottuu sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon, vianmääritykseen ja korjaukseen. Tehtävässä pääset käsittelemään erilaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita aina vian selvittämisestä moottorin purkamiseen, korjaamiseen, kokoonpanoon ja testaukseen asti.

Työskentely tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti korjaamolla, mutta työhön kuuluu tarvittaessa asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja mittaustyöt. Joskus isoja sähkömoottoreita huolletaan myös paikan päällä asiakkaan tiloissa, jolloin työskennellään työryhmässä yhdessä muiden Sähkö-Teamin asentajien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

\- sähkömoottoreiden huolto, korjaus ja testaus

\- moottoreiden purku, tarkastus ja kokoonpano

\- sähköisten vikojen vianmääritys, mittaukset ja kunnon arviointi

\- mekaaniset huolto- ja asennustyöt, kuten laakereiden ja tiivisteiden vaihdot

\- asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja kuntokartoituskäynnit

Työnhakijalta odotamme:

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on sähköalan koulutus ja käytännön ymmärrys sähkömoottoreista sekä sähkö- ja mekaniikkatöistä. Sinulla voi olla esimerkiksi taustaa teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähköasennuksista, koneiden huollosta tai muista tehtävistä, joissa sähköinen ja mekaaninen osaaminen yhdistyvät.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää erityisesti:

\- sähköalan koulutusta

\- ymmärrystä sähkömoottoreiden toiminnasta ja rakenteesta

\- sähköalan perusteiden ja sähkötöiden hallintaa

\- mekaanista asennusosaamista

\- kykyä tehdä vianmääritystä ja tulkita mittaustuloksia

\- käytännönläheistä ja itsenäistä työotetta

\- B-luokan ajokorttia

\- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

Tarjoamme sinulle kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työn vakavaraisessa yrityksessä. Sähkö-Teamilla on vuosikymmenten kokemus sähköalalta ja sähkökoneiden korjaamisesta, joten sinulla on mahdollisuus hyödyntää omaa ammattitaitoa monipuolisesti ja samalla oppia lisää sähkömoottoreista, sähkökoneista ja niiden korjaamisesta.

Palkkaus määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten täytä hakemus pikimmiten ohessa olevan linkin kautta. jobs.title: Critical Environment Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Microsoft’s Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Critical Environment Operations Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

    Empower a culture of safety, security, and compliance in all aspects of our Datacenter operations
    Lead a team of Mechanical, Electrical and Control System professionals supporting Microsoft's online services  
    Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our Datacenters  
    Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability to ensure optimal operational efficiency  
    Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year
    Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives  
    Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring  
    Establish and enhance working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and business partners

Work with regional and global peers to share and build practices across the entire datacenter portfolio  

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

    Proven experience of mission-critical service management (e.g., providing IT services, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, military, or managing physical operations in an IT and/or critical environment infrastructure).
    Strong people management experience, including hiring, mentoring and team development
    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
    *This role requires you to be on-site, and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

    Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

    Relevant experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU) AND xperience working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) AND Experience managing budget $500k+
    Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field.
    Experience in leading a diverse, technical team.
    Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications, Leadership Development Certifications, PMP, CDCP.
    Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services
    Experience working on large scale CE projects  
    Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.)

jobs.title: PRODUKTIONSTEKNISK SPECIALIST TIL MAYEKAWA NORDIC A/S
jobs.description:
Vær med til at bygge en ny afdeling op fra bunden

Produktionsteknisk Specialist med fokus på at modne udviklingsafdelingens arbejde og gøre det klar til produktion.

For english version, click here

Mayekawa Nordic A/S har igen bedt os om at finde den rette person til en central rolle i virksomheden. De søger nu en produktionsteknisk specialist, der trives i krydsfeltet mellem udvikling, produktion og mennesker. Man kan sige at de leder efter en, der kan tage et produkt fra tegnebordet og gøre det klar til at blive bygget. Igen og igen.

Virksomheden har domicil i Middelfart og fungerer som nordisk udviklingscenter for den japanske koncern Mayekawa. Virksomheden udvikler industrielle køleanlæg og varmepumper og er særligt kendt for mCHILLER-serien, der bruger det naturlige kølemiddel ammoniak og på den måde opnår høj energieffektivitet og bæredygtighed.

Opgaven
Mayekawa Nordic opretter en ny Industrialization-afdeling på kontoret i Middelfart, og med den følger en ny stilling som produktionsteknisk specialist. Afdelingens opgave er at sikre, at de produkter udviklingsafdelingen designer, rent faktisk kan produceres. Og det bliver dig, der får ansvaret for at bygge afdelingen op fra bunden sammen med produktionsteknisk supporter.

Stillingen er uden personaleansvar, men du får ansvaret for den faglige retning og for, at opgaverne bliver løst og driften kører, samtidig med at du selv står for en stor del af det faglige arbejde. Ved din side får du en produktionsteknisk supporter, som også bliver ansat nu, og som du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med.

Sammen med udviklingsdirektøren, som du refererer til, finder du ud af, hvad afdelingen skal kunne, og du bygger arbejdsgangene til det. Du sidder med ved bordet, når udvikling og produktion skal blive enige om, hvordan tingene kan gøres bedre, og selvom det nogle gange betyder lange møder, er det også der, du gør den største forskel.

Mayekawa har en produktionsenhed i Serbien, som du kommer til at få meget kontakt med, og du skal derfor regne med, at stillingen indebærer op til 50 rejsedage om året.

Ansvarsområder
I samarbejde med Mayekawa Nordics ledelse bygger du afdelingen op fra bunden og finder, udvikler og sætter rammerne for, hvordan den skal arbejde. Dine ansvarsområder bliver:

  • Opbygning af afdelingens arbejdsgange og processer

  • At afdelingen sikrer en grundig modning af produkterne, så de kan gå sikkert fra udvikling til produktion

  • Kontakten til de tre samarbejdspartnere: udvikling i Danmark, moderfirma i Japan og produktion i Serbien

  • Sourcingaftaler i samarbejde med strategisk indkøb

 Arbejdsopgaver
En stor del af din tid kommer til at gå med konkrete tekniske opgaver:

  • CAD-automatisering på tværs af produktfamilier og varianter

  • Arbejde med produktvarianter og vurdering af, hvad en ændring påvirker

  • Design-for-assembly-forbedringer

  • Integration af kvalitetssikring i udviklingsprocesserne

  • Udvikling af systemer til generering af kundedokumentationspakker

  • Integration af nye produktfunktioner i eksisterende produktlinjer

Faglige kompetencer
Vi går mere op i, hvad du har lavet, end i hvad der står på dit eksamensbevis. Du kan være PTA, produktionsteknolog, maskinmester, maskintekniker, teknisk designer eller ingeniør. Du kan også være faglært og have bygget videre med efteruddannelse og mange år tæt på produktionen. Det afgørende er, at du har stået i krydsfeltet mellem udvikling og produktion før og ved, hvor det typisk går galt i praksis.

Du bliver den første i afdelingen, så du skal kunne bidrage fra dag ét. Derfor skal du have solid erfaring med:

  • Inventor og Vault, gerne også automatisering og opsætning af arbejdsgange

  • Mekanisk design og montageprocesser

  • Produktionsteknologi

  • ERP- og PDM-systemer

Kender du til svejsning, pladebearbejdning, rør og fittings, er det en fordel.

Du taler og skriver engelsk på et niveau, hvor du kan forklare tekniske detaljer og forhandle løsninger med kolleger i Japan og Serbien.

Hvem du er
Du tager ansvar og venter ikke på, at nogen beder dig om noget, og du er god til at opsøge den viden, der skal til for at løse en opgave. Du er god til at skabe og vedligeholde relationer, og du er ikke bange for at tage teten, når det er nødvendigt, men forstår samtidig at give plads til andre, når det er dem, der skal fylde.

Du har lyst og drive til at bygge systemer, forbedre dem og holde dem kørende. Du gør opgaver færdige frem for at kaste dig over de næste, og du har nemt ved at navigere i en organisation, der endnu ikke er struktureret. For det er præcis det, du og din kollega kommer til: at skabe strukturen, der ikke er der endnu.

Det vil være en fordel for dig, hvis du har interesse/erfaring med at arbejde i et internationalt miljø, med relationer og kontakter uden for landets grænser.

 Mayekawa Nordic tilbyder

  • Et selvstændigt job med stor frihed til selv at tilrettelægge arbejdet

  • Gode muligheder for at udvikle dig fagligt

  • Kolleger med en uformel tone og en god stemning

  • En god lønpakke med pension og sundhedsforsikring

  • Fleksible arbejdstider, der passer til dine rejseaktiviteter

  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

Din primære arbejdsplads er på kontoret i Middelfart.

Er det dig, der skal bygge afdelingen op?
Er du den, der får tingene til at virke, når tegningen skal blive til et rigtigt produkt? Kan du se dig selv have medansvar i opbygningen af noget, der ikke findes endnu, og samtidig have hænderne i det faglige undervejs? Har du lyst til at sætte dit præg på en afdeling fra første dag, uden at skulle være personaleleder? Så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig. Uanset om du har en ingeniørtitel eller har lært faget på gulvet.

Praktiske forhold
Den optimale tiltrædelse er 1. november 2026, men den rigtige kandidat betyder mere end datoen, så vi venter gerne. Der er derfor ingen fast ansøgningsfrist.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette.

Så vil du med, er det bare med at sende ansøgningen af sted.

Vigtigt: Ansøgning og CV skal sendes via Ansøgningslinket, så vi får dit materiale ind i vores rekrutteringssystem (GDPR).

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Om Mayekawa
Mayekawa er en familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt af Kisaku Maekawa i 1924. Siden da er den vokset til at være en af verdens førende inden for industriel køling med mere end 4.500 medarbejdere fordelt over hele kloden.

Den første stempelkompressor kom i 1934. Siden har Mayekawa arbejdet videre med MYCOM kompressorteknologien, og i dag står MYCOM som det stærkeste navn i branchen.

Naturlige kølemidler har været omdrejningspunktet fra begyndelsen, fordi hensynet til miljøet vejer tungt hos Mayekawa. Industriel køling er stadig kerneforretningen, men virksomheden arbejder også med udstyr til kødforarbejdning og med robotteknologi.

Om Mayekawa Nordic A/S
Mayekawa Nordic A/S er udviklingscenter for standard chillers og varmepumper under Mayekawa Europe. Det er her mCHILLER Series bliver udviklet. I 2021 kom mCHILLER FUGU, en vandkølet ammoniak chiller, og i oktober 2022 fulgte mCHILLER TAKA, som er luftkølet.

Organisationen er flad. Man spørger, når man er i tvivl, og man hjælper både sit team og sin leder med at få tingene til at lykkes.

Som ny kollega kommer du ind i en virksomhed, der ligger helt fremme i branchen, og som ser på hele mennesket. Der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.

Mayekawa prioriterer arbejdsmiljøet og bakker det op med sociale aktiviteter og en fri og ærlig omgangstone, hvor der er plads til sjov og til at være den, man er, blandt kolleger der bliver hængende. De værdier skal gerne passe til dine egne.

Arbejdsadresse
Mayekawa Nordic A/S
Damgårdvej 6,
5500 Middelfart

www.mayekawa.dk 

Se på kort

jobs.title: Rzeźnik - Rozbiór Łopatki Wieprzowej / Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning
jobs.description:
Pracuj w Danii jako rzeźnik – atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie, elastyczność i stabilne warunki pracy. Danish Crown to jedna z największych firm spożywczych w Europie. Oferujemy stabilne warunki zatrudnienia i pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku.

Opis stanowiska


  • Wykonywanie rozbioru łopatki wieprzowej zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami jakości i wydajności.




  • Precyzyjna praca nożem na linii produkcyjnej, z dbałością o detale.




  • Monitorowanie i utrzymywanie wysokiej jakości cięcia oraz efektywności pracy.




  • Ścisłe przestrzeganie zasad higieny i bezpieczeństwa pracy na każdym etapie produkcji



Wymagania


  • Ugruntowane doświadczenie w rozbiorze mięsa, najlepiej w pracy z łopatką wieprzową lub przodami.




  • Doskonała umiejętność sprawnego i precyzyjnego posługiwania się nożem.




  • Udokumentowane doświadczenie w pracy na ubojni lub w zakładzie mięsnym.




  • Zdolność do efektywnej i samodzielnej pracy w tempie produkcyjnym od pierwszego dnia.




  • Sprawność fizyczna oraz odpowiedzialność w wykonywaniu powierzonych zadań.



Oferujemy


  • Atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie godzinowe z dodatkami, 176 dkk + 12,20% czyli 197,58 dkk z możliwością wzrostu po przejściu na system akordowy.




  • Stabilne zatrudnienie bezpośrednio u duńskiego pracodawcy Danish Crown, z pełnym pakietem socjalnym (urlop, emerytura).




  • Wsparcie w procesie relokacji i adaptacji w Danii (CPR, podatki, ubezpieczenie, zakwaterowanie).




  • Pomoc w języku polskim oraz innych językach, a także wprowadzenie w życie i pracę w Danii.



English version:

Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.
The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note: You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

• Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)
• Knife work in high-volume pork production
• Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield
• Following hygiene and safety procedures
• Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

• Experience with deboning
• Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends
• Good knife skills
• Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant
• Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment
• Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

• Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

• After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

• Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

• Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

• Canteen facilities

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer:

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift
Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.
If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift
32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application
If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Ewa Pedersen email ewape@jks.dk telefon: +45.61204070.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Mayekawa Nordic A/S har endnu engang bedt os om at finde den rette person til en vigtig funktion. De søger en Produktionsteknisk Supporter, der kan skabe/fastholde struktur, understøtte udvikling og være et vigtigt bindeled i den tekniske hverdag.

Mayekawa Nordic A/S har deres domicil i Middelfart og fungerer som nordisk udviklingscenter for den japanske koncern Mayekawa. Virksomheden udvikler industrielle køleanlæg og varmepumper og er særligt kendt for mCHILLER-serien, der bruger det naturlige kølemiddel ammoniak og på den måde opnår høj energieffektivitet og bæredygtighed.

Afdelingen du kommer ind i findes ikke endnu. Den skal bygges op fra bunden, og du bliver en af de to første på plads, nemlig en leder og dig. Lederen sætter retning og bygger rammerne, og sammen bærer I det daglige arbejde i systemerne og holder dem kørende. Du er rigtig god til værktøjerne, og du trives med det. Og fordi afdelingen er så ny, er du med til at forme den, mens den bliver til.

Da der vil være behov for at besøge produktionsenheden i Serbien, skal du forvente op til 25 rejsedage om året.

Ansvarsområder
Du holder styr på det, der skal være i orden, for at resten kan fungere. Ansvaret er dit:

  • Færdiggøre og justere 3D modeller med henblik på produktion.

  • Styre tegningspakker og -lister.

  • Struktureret organisering af emner og koder.

  • Opbygning og vedligehold af styklister og BOM-lister.

  • Vedligeholdelse af produktmanualer.

  • Arbejdet i ERP- og PDM-systemerne.

  • Beskrivelse af delelementer, så de er til at forstå for produktionen.

Arbejdsopgaver
Meget af dit ansvar og arbejde ligger på det udførende plan, tæt på tegningerne og værktøjerne:

  • CAD-automatisering og workflows i praksis.

  • Oprette, opdatere og frigive tegninger.

  • Fra prototype til produktionsmodel, frem til sidste test inden overlevering.

  • Leverandørkontakt og indkøbsspecifikationer.

Faglige kompetencer
Du har sikkert en baggrund som maskinmester, produktions teknolog eller noget, der ligner. Du har arbejdet med konstruktion før, og har du haft fingrene i produktionssiden også, er det et klart plus.

Afdelingen skal samlet mestre en række tekniske områder, og du kommer til at bære en god del af det håndværksmæssige. Det gælder Vault og Inventor, herunder automatisering og workflows, mekanisk design og montageprocesser, kendskab til produktionsteknologi og erfaring med ERP- og PDM-systemer. Viden om svejsning, pladebearbejdning, rør og fittings er en fordel.

Personlige kompetencer
Du er struktureret og fokuseret, og du får tingene færdige frem for at kaste dig over det næste. Du tager selv initiativ, når der skal findes en løsning, og du venter ikke på, at nogen beder dig om det.

Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og er samtidig en holdspiller. Ja, det er en klassiker, men her betyder den noget. I er kun to i afdelingen, så I skal kunne stå på egne ben hver især og samtidig trække på samme hammel, når det gælder.

Og så kan du finde vej i en organisation, der endnu ikke er struktureret. For det er præcis det, du kommer til: at være med til at skabe strukturen, der ikke er der endnu.

Det vil være en fordel for dig, hvis du har interesse i eller erfaring med, at arbejde i et internationalt miljø, med relationer og kontakter uden for landets grænser. Derfor er det også væsentligt, at du taler engelsk på et højere niveau.

Mayekawa Nordic tilbyder

  • Et spændende og selvstændigt job med stor frihed i udførelsen af opgaverne og gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Du vil være en del af et dynamisk og engageret team, hvor der er en uformel tone og en god atmosfære.

  • En attraktiv lønpakke, inklusive pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

  • Fleksible arbejdstider, der matcher dine rejseaktiviteter.

  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

Din primære arbejdsplads vil være på kontoret i Middelfart.

Er det dig, der skal holde det hele kørende?
Kan du se dig selv i systemerne til daglig, med ansvaret for at data, koder og styklister er i orden, og med hænderne i tegningerne hele vejen fra idé til overlevering? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Praktiske forhold
Den optimale tiltrædelse er 1. december 2026, men den rigtige kandidat betyder mere end datoen, så vi venter gerne. Der er ingen fast ansøgningsfrist.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette. Så vil du med, er det med at sende ansøgningen af sted.

Kontakt
Hvis du har spørgsmål, der vedrører stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte John Pagaard på +45 2090 4970.

Vigtigt: Ansøgning og CV skal sendes via Ansøgningslinket, så vi får dit materiale ind i vores rekrutteringssystem (GDPR).

Om Mayekawa
Mayekawa er en familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt af Kisaku Maekawa i 1924. Siden da er den vokset til at være en af verdens førende inden for industriel køling med mere end 4.500 medarbejdere fordelt over hele kloden.

Den første stempelkompressor kom i 1934. Siden har Mayekawa arbejdet videre med MYCOM kompressorteknologien, og i dag står MYCOM som det stærkeste navn i branchen.

Naturlige kølemidler har været omdrejningspunktet fra begyndelsen, fordi hensynet til miljøet vejer tungt hos Mayekawa. Industriel køling er stadig kerneforretningen, men virksomheden arbejder også med udstyr til kødforarbejdning og med robotteknologi.

Om Mayekawa Nordic A/S
Mayekawa Nordic A/S er udviklingscenter for standard chillers og varmepumper under Mayekawa Europe. Det er her mCHILLER Series bliver udviklet. I 2021 kom mCHILLER FUGU, en vandkølet ammoniak chiller, og i oktober 2022 fulgte mCHILLER TAKA, som er luftkølet.

Organisationen er flad. Man spørger, når man er i tvivl, og man hjælper både sit team og sin leder med at få tingene til at lykkes.

Som ny kollega kommer du ind i en virksomhed, der ligger helt fremme i branchen, og som ser på hele mennesket. Der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.

Mayekawa prioriterer arbejdsmiljøet og bakker det op med sociale aktiviteter og en fri og ærlig omgangstone, hvor der er plads til sjov og til at være den, man er, blandt kolleger der bliver hængende. De værdier skal gerne passe til dine egne.

jobs.title: Projectleider funderingstechnieken | Nederland
jobs.description:
Jouw uitdaging

Als projectleider ben jij de commerciële trekker van onze projecten. Jij krijgt de volledige regie over indrukwekkende funderingsprojecten. Van de eerste calculatie en het commercieel advies, tot de effectieve uitvoering op de werf!

Jouw werkplek

Jouw werkplaats bevindt zich voornamelijk op onze vestiging in Nederland (regio Tilburg/Eindhoven). Daarnaast ben je uiteraard ook regelmatig op de baan.

Jouw team valt onder Smet Group Nederland, afdeling Funderingstechnieken (Smet-F&C). Smet-F&C werkt bouwputten uit en bedenkt funderingsoplossingen voor hoogspanningsmasten, windmolens, kaaimuren, metro- en tramverbindingen en meer. Kortom, Smet-F&C is expert in het stabiel funderen van complexe bouwwerken.

Wat jij gaat doen

Als projectleider word jij ingeschakeld in ons team van projectleiders dat op basis van diverse funderingstechnieken de klant een gepaste oplossing aanbiedt en succesvol uitvoert aan juiste prijzen. Het uitbouwen van een interessant netwerk van klanten en partners is een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw job.

Jouw belangrijkste taken:

  • Acquisitie en verkoop: studiewerk, calculaties, varianten uitwerken, offertes opstellen, oplossing verkocht krijgen, …
  • Voorbereiding: dossieropbouw, overdracht naar techniekverantwoordelijken, budgetten, kwaliteit, veiligheid, …
  • Uitvoering: werfleiding opvolgen, facturatie met min- of meerwerken, budget- en kwaliteitscontrole, veiligheid, procedures, …
  • Nazorg: facturatie en evaluaties op alle gebieden.

Je kan hiervoor terugvallen op diverse interne diensten die je dan ook, voor jouw projecten, aanstuurt, begeleidt en opvolgt: aankoop, ontwerp- en studiebureau, uitvoerders, projectsupport, administratie, …

Wie jij bent

  • Je beschikt over een Master of Bachelor in een bouwkunde of Civiele techniek
  • Je kijkt verder dan het standaardplan. Je denkt proactief mee en durft met slimme, alternatieve funderingstechnieken te komen die het verschil maken.
  • Je kan vlot communiceren in het Nederlands. Je bent assertief wanneer nodig, maar altijd met een klantgerichte focus.
  • Je houdt van cijfers en details. Je offertes zijn nauwkeurig, je budgetbeheer is strak en je vindt vlot je weg in de gangbare software.
  • Je combineert je technische expertise met een neus voor kansen. Je overtuigt klanten niet alleen met feiten, maar ook met een ijzersterke oplossing.

jobs.title: Administrative Accounting Analyst
jobs.description:
The Embassy of Chile in Helsinki is looking for a Substitute Administrative Accounting Analyst

JOB DESCRIPTION

Some of the duties and responsibilities of the analyst include, inter alia:

\- Daily Administrative tasks of the Embassy, including keeping the calendar of the Ambassador and the Embassy updated, scheduling appointments, reception work, making logistical and travel arrangements, handling phone calls and conference calls.

\- Prepare the Mission's accounting.

\- Assist the Ambassador in the activities and tasks of the Mission.

\- Support diplomatic officials and Chilean delegations as requested by the Head of Mission.

\- Receive and distribute emails addressed to the Embassy.

\- Coordinate with the Missions drivers the mobilization for daily agenda.

\- Replace functions in the Consular Section as requested.

\- Keeping the Embassy files updated.

\- Doing unofficial translations.

Detailed list of the tasks will be provided in the interview.

SELECTION CRITERIA

Please note that only applicants with a clean criminal record and holders of a permanent residence permit in Finland will be eligible for consideration.

Required qualifications and experience:

\- Fluent in Finnish, Spanish and English language. This point will constitute an important asset in the selection process

\- Previous experience in accounting and administrative tasks

\- Excellent computer skills (Office, Excel, Windows, others)

\- Suitable technical or academic degree, at graduate level

\- Team work spirit, keen eye for detail and good abilities in scheduling and organizing

The monthly salary is EUR 2,350 and the working hours are 40 per week (9 am to 5 pm).

The opening is open for seven months starting 1st of January 2027. The Embassy observes the Finnish public holidays calendar.

Durch agile “Always-on”-Ansätze statt klassischer Kampagnen-Denke.   • Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst sicher und überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch.
