jobs.title: Product Portfolio Senior Manager Education & Athletes Pathways
jobs.employer: Académie Internationale des Sciences et Techniques du Sport (AISTS)
jobs.description:
Postulation : https://www.jobup.ch/en/jobs/detail/b2dabcb5-de1a-49d7-870d-91c536ce96a7/?source=company_detail

Are you passionate about creating seamless experiences in education and sport? Are you sensitive to serving the
athletes and bringing them at the center of the sport ecosystem ?
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?
Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping
the future of sports leadership.
About AISTS
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not-for-profit academic
centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it offers world-class
education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary approach combines
expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership. With a network of over 750
alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport organisations, AISTS shapes the future of
international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting
excellence in sport management to drive positive global impact through the power of sport.
Your role
The Product Portfolio Senior Manager is responsible for translating the AISTS portfolio strategy into a coherent,
prioritised and commercially viable product portfolio across three product areas: Education, Athletes Pathways, and
Advisory. It initially owns direct responsibility for both Education and Athletes Pathways products streams.
The role ensures that AISTS moves from a primarily MAS-centred organisation toward an integrated platform
combining industry access, short and tailored education, athlete-career transition solutions, and international sport
organisations advisory services (e.g. impact assessments, certification, research mandates, etc.).
Positioning & Context
Reporting to the Executive Director, you will work in partnership with the Professors, experts, speakers and partners
of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the Head of B2B Partnerships & Development and the
Head of Operations & Delivery. Initially, you will manage the Sport Advisory Product Coordinator.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role may evolve
according to the deployment of the strategy.
Key responsibilities
Portfolio Management
• Own the consolidated product portfolio roadmap across Education, Athletes Pathways and Advisory.
• Establish common product management standards and coherence across products in terms of target
audiences, value propositions, pricing logic, delivery model, resource needs and expected contribution.
• Prioritise product development using mission alignment, market demand, revenue potential, profitability,
scalability, feasibility and strategic value.
• Translate strategic priorities into clear product briefs, annual product plans, performance indicators and
implementation milestones.
• Maintain product governance discipline, ensuring that each product has an owner, business case, delivery
model, quality criteria, review cycle and is aligned with B2B development (proposal development) and clearly
framed for the Operations and Delivery team to operate
• Provide the Executive Director with a consolidated view of product performance, portfolio risks,
dependencies and investment priorities.
Product ownership
1. Athlete Pathways
• Design and develop the AISTS Athletes Pathways offer, including education, transition, employability,
leadership, entrepreneurship and mentoring formats for active, retiring and retired athletes.
• Build the product value proposition for IFs, NOCs, Olympic stakeholders, athlete commissions, agencies,
sponsors and individual athletes.
• Coordinate athlete-specific curriculum development, mentor pools, career coaching components and
storytelling opportunities with alumni, industry experts and corporate partners.
• Track performance of the athlete pathway product, including athletes supported, revenues, scholarships,
partner satisfaction and post-programme outcomes.
2. Master of Advanced Studies in Sport Management and Technology (MAS) & Continued Education
programmes
• Coordinate curriculum architecture, learning formats, field visits, internships, Client Team Projects, research
papers and industry exposure to maintain and strengthen the leading positioning of the programme.
• Work with delivery coordinators and academic partners to ensure programme design is feasible, coherent
and quality-controlled.
• Lead on the design of the annual Continued Education portfolio across Sport Business, Sport Leadership and
Sport Technology, ensuring their relevance for market needs
• Define course value propositions, target segments, learning outcomes, course leaders, pricing logic and
annual calendar priorities.
• Source lecturers and guest speakers and, where relevant, supervise MAS Client Team Projects
3. Training Houses and tailored education solution
• Develop repeatable B2B education offers for sport organisations starting with IFs and then NOCs, NFs,
LOCs, etc.
• Package tailored education into clear formats, such as staff training, leadership journeys, member federation
modules, Olympic Capital Training Weeks and capability-building workshops ensuring balanced
customisation and reusability
4. Learning innovation and online support
• Use digital or online learning selectively to support continuity, blended formats, pre-work, follow-up modules
or scalable partner needs.
• Contribute to the development of reusable learning assets, templates, cases and content libraries when they
improve product quality and scalability.
• Coordinate with academic and industry stakeholders to keep education products relevant to emerging
trends such as digital, AI, sustainability, governance, fan engagement and commercial innovation.
Product team management
• Manage and coordinate the work with the product coordinator(s).
• Ensure that product owners work closely with Business Development and Marketing for market relevance,
positioning and partnerships and with Operations for delivery feasibility.
What we offer
• Dynamic Work Environment: Join an international team passionate about sports and education.
• Career Development: Gain exposure to a wide range of projects in a prestigious organisation.
• Inclusive Culture: We value diverse perspectives and actively encourage applications from all genders,
backgrounds, and experiences.
• Professional Growth: Access to training programmes to enhance your skills and career development.
• Mentorship Opportunities: Be part of a supportive team committed to helping you thrive in your role.
• Prime Location: Work in Lausanne, the Olympic Capital, with access to sports facilities and view on the
lake
Your skills and experience
• Experience:
o 8 years of experience, with minimum 3 years in continuing education programme design and/or
product development;
o Strong ability to bring strategy into product architecture, priorisation and execution plans;
o Business mindset, with ability to assess value propositions, pricing and financial contribution
without compromising AISTS quality and mission;
o Strong understanding of Olympic and international sport ecosystem, including trends and
challenges in the sport industry, and experience in working with / on elite-athletes related topics;
o Relevant network in the sport industry and international sport organisations a strong asset;
o Familiarity with Swiss higher education environment an asset;
• Technical Skills:
o Proficiency in MS Office 365; experience with e-learning, AI solutions, data management and CRM
an asset;
o Native-level fluency in English or French, with proficiency in the other language (3rd language is
a plus).
o Familiarity with AISTS activities and the MAS programme is highly valued;
o Experience related to sport (athlete, volunteer, coach or management) is highly valued;
• Personal Traits: Agile, flexible with ability to adapt in all situation, reliable, highly organised and at ease
with multitasking and service-oriented with strong communication skills in multicultural environments.
• Education: Master (MSc) degree in (Sport) Management and Business, Applied Sciences or Engineering
with a keen interest for human and athlete development.
What we expect
• Results driven, ability to sense priorities and client / service oriented.
• Dynamic personality with strong interpersonal skills.
• Ability to maintain a positive, pragmatic and open-minded attitude under stressful and operational
situations.
• Strong organisational, analytical, project and time management skills, with excellent attention to detail.
• Diplomacy, tact and discretion. Keen sense of confidentiality.
• Flexibility to work occasionally in the evenings and on weekends.
We welcome candidates from all professional backgrounds and encourage applications even if not all qualifications
are met. At AISTS, we value your potential.

jobs.title: Sport Advisory Product Coordinator
jobs.employer: Académie Internationale des Sciences et Techniques du Sport (AISTS)
jobs.description:
Postulation : https://www.jobup.ch/en/jobs/detail/16ecfd73-10cb-4260-922f-0ac4003adcfd/?source=company_detail

Are you passionate about challenging the status-quo in sport?
Do you value research-driven and scientifically rigourous solutions?
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?
Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping
the future of sports leadership.
About AISTS
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not-for-profit
academic centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it
offers world-class education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary
approach combines expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership.
With a network of over 750 alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport
organisations, AISTS shapes the future of international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves
as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting excellence in sport management to drive
positive global impact through the power of sport.
Your role
The Product Coordinator – Sport Advisroy is responsible for building AISTS sport advisory – such as
impact assessment, sport equipment certification, etc. – into clear, market-facing products with
scientifically-rigorous methodologies and lean delivery models. The role covers two main product
families: impact assessments and analysis for sport events and organisations; and sport equipment
compliance/certification services for key sport equipment stakeholders (rule-makers, designers,
producers, users…).
Positioning & Context
Reporting into the Product Portfolio Senior Manager, you will work in partnership with the Professors
and researchers of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the B2B Development &
Marketing team and the Operations & Delivery team.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role
may evolve according to the deployment of the strategy.
Key responsibilities
Product development
• Transform AISTS globally recognised assessment methodologies into clear, repeatable and costefficient
products while preserving its core characteristics: scientifically rigorous and pragmatic for
industry application, incl.:
o standardised impact assessment products with economic impact as a core entry point and
extensions into environmental, social & media and stakeholder/community-relevant impacts
o independent sport equipment regulation assessment and certification processes to support
key sport stakeholders – federations, event organisers, manufacturers and athletes – in
guaranteeing a level-playing field companies in designing, assessing and certifying
processes, operational frameworks and quality standards.
o Develop sample outputs, case references and marketing-ready value propositions for IFs,
event organisers, cities, hosts, sponsors and sport organisations.
• Create a leaner operational model that combines AISTS quality assurance with external experts,
academic partners and delivery coordinators where appropriate:
o Define product formats, methodology templates, data needs, deliverables, pricing logic,
timelines and delivery roles.
o Define what AISTS can credibly own directly versus what requires technical, legal,
engineering or standards partners.
o Establish quality assurance principles, methodology governance and documentation
standards to protect AISTS credibility.
• Explore opportunities of application of existing products into other fields such as sport venues
and infrastructures, innovation with new materials, compliance with emerging standards and
certification, etc.
Commercial packaging and performance, governance and continuous improvement
• Work with the B2B Development & Marketing team to:
o identify priority clients and opportunities, including IFs, event organisers, brands, technology
providers and venues.
o translate technical products into simple commercial materials, one-pagers, case studies and
pitch narratives.
• Create product pricing and effort models that improve profitability compared with bespoke oneoff
projects
• Track project outcomes, client satisfaction, methodology improvements, cost of delivery and
repeatability.
• Build a database of assessments and findings over time to enable benchmarking, recurring
diagnostics and future thought leadership.
What we offer
• Dynamic Work Environment: Join an international team passionate about sports and education.
• Career Development: Gain exposure to a wide range of projects in a prestigious organisation.
• Inclusive Culture: We value diverse perspectives and actively encourage applications from all
genders, backgrounds, and experiences.
• Professional Growth: Access to training programmes to enhance your skills and career
development.
• Mentorship Opportunities: Be part of a supportive team committed to helping you thrive in your
role.
• Prime Location: Work in Lausanne, the Olympic Capital, with access to sports facilities and view on
the lake
Your skills and experience
• Experience:
o 2-3 years of experience, in sport advisory, consulting or research capacity, preferably with
experience in product management;
o Strong ability to bring ideas and methodologies into pragmatic and applicable solutions
o Business mindset, with ability to frame value propositions and pricing in line with AISTS quality
and mission
o Strong understanding of Olympic and international sport ecosystem, in particular of trends
and challenges of the sport industry;
o Relevant network in the sport industry and international sport organisations a strong asset;
o Familiarity with Swiss higher education environment an asset;
• Technical Skills:
o Proficiency in MS Office 365; experience AI solutions, data management and CRM an asset;
o Business engineering or engineering background;
o Native-level fluency in English or French, with proficiency in the other language (3rd language
is a plus).
o Familiarity with AISTS activities and the MAS programme is highly valued;
o Experience related to sport (athlete, volunteer, coach or management) is highly valued;
• Personal Traits: Agile, flexible with ability to adapt in all situation, reliable, highly organised and at
ease with multitasking and service-oriented with strong communication skills in multicultural
environments
• Education: Master (MSc) degree in (Sport) Management and Business, Applied Sciences or
Engineering with a keen interest for sport.
What we expect
• Results driven, ability to sense priorities and client / service oriented.
• Dynamic personality with strong interpersonal skills.
• Ability to maintain a positive, pragmatic and open-minded attitude under stressful and operational
situations.
• Strong organisational, analytical, project and time management skills, with excellent attention to
detail.
• Diplomacy, tact and discretion. Keen sense of confidentiality.
• Flexibility to work occasionally in the evenings and on weekends.
We welcome candidates from all professional backgrounds and encourage applications even if not all
qualifications are met. At AISTS, we value your potential.
How to Apply
We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and strongly encourage applications from women
and men equally. We particularly welcome candidates who bring diverse experiences and perspectives.
Send your CV, work certificates, and a cover letter (in English) outlining your motivation to join AISTS
through the platform jobup only. Deadline of application 11th of October 2026.
Starting Date: As soon as possible
Occupancy rate: full time, 100%
Location of work: Lausanne, Switzerland

jobs.title: Truck Racing and Historic Sporting Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Truck Racing and Historic Sporting Coordinator will contribute to the sporting, regulatory and operational delivery of the FIA Truck Racing and Historic Championships. The position is intended for a confirmed sporting coordination profile, capable of managing day-to-day championship matters with a high level of autonomy, while ensuring appropriate escalation and validation on regulatory, sporting and governance matters.

The role requires practical on-site experience, regular interaction with Race Control, Stewards, Race Directors, officials and teams, and the ability to distinguish between matters to be managed independently, matters to be prepared for validation, and matters to be performed under the authority of the relevant sporting decision-makers.

The indicative workload allocation is expected to be:
Truck Racing: 60%
Historic Championships: 40%

MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
TRUCK RACING CHAMPIONSHIP SPORTING COORDINATION :
Coordinate the day-to-day sporting administration of the Truck Racing Championship, ensuring compliance with FIA requirements, sporting regulations and established procedures.
Manage the championship entry process and entry platform where applicable, including competitor support, document follow-up and deadline monitoring.
Review entry documentation and prepare any non-standard or eligibility-related matters for validation by the relevant Championship Manager or competent FIA body.
Coordinate routine communications with teams, ASNs, officials and internal FIA departments on sporting and operational matters.

HISTORIC CHAMPIONSHIPS SPORTING COORDINATION :
Coordinate day-to-day sporting and administrative matters related to Historic Championships, in liaison with the Historic Championships & Commission Manager.
Prepare sporting documents, procedures and information notes for review and validation by the relevant manager or governance body.
Follow up championship-related actions, regulatory updates and stakeholder requests.
Ensure proper coordination between Historic championship activities, commission work and FIA internal processes.

SPORTING DOCUMENTATION :
Prepare, review and maintain sporting documents for events and championships, including procedures, notes to competitors, operational guidelines and Stewards' Handbooks.
Ensure sporting documents remain aligned with current FIA regulations, championship requirements and operational practices.
Prepare draft amendments or updates for validation by the relevant Championship Manager and, where applicable, FIA governance bodies.
Coordinate the circulation of validated documents to the relevant internal and external stakeholders.

ON-SITE EVENT OPERATIONS AND RACE CONTROL SUPPORT

Race Control and Stewards support :
Support the Race Director and Race Control team during events, including preparation and coordination of operational procedures, messaging systems, radio communications, incident follow-up and parc fermé processes.
Prepare Race Control documentation, checklists and briefing materials in advance of events.
Assist the Stewards during events by coordinating administrative and operational processes, including official documentation, communication flows and distribution of decisions.
Prepare incident-related documentation or reports for review by the Race Director or Stewards, without substituting for their sporting decision-making authority.
Operate FIA onboard camera systems and retrieve footage when requested by the Race Director or Stewards for sporting or regulatory purposes.

Commission, committee and stakeholder coordination :
Attend meetings of the Truck Racing Commission, Historic Commission and related working groups as Sporting Coordinator.
Prepare agendas, working documents, meeting dossiers and follow-up notes for review and validation where required.
Maintain records of commission activities, recommendations and decisions.
Follow up action items resulting from commission meetings and coordinate with relevant FIA departments or stakeholders.
Escalate sensitive, strategic or policy-related matters to the relevant Championship Manager or Head of Racing & Historic.

Operational and administrative coordination :
Coordinate the operational needs of FIA staff on-site in relation to Truck Racing and Historic activities.
Support implementation of FIA sporting requirements during events.
Ensure effective preparation, follow-up and filing of sporting and operational documentation.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of sporting and operational processes within the scope of the role.

PROFILE:
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in motorsport sporting operations, championship coordination, race administration or equivalent.
Proven practical on-site experience and regular interaction with Race Control, Stewards, Race Directors, officials, teams and championship stakeholders.
Strong understanding of motorsport sporting regulations, event operations and regulatory processes.
Ability to work autonomously, manage priorities and identify matters requiring validation or escalation.
Strong organisational, drafting and communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear sporting and operational documentation.
Ability to work under pressure in an event environment and to interact professionally with officials, competitors and internal departments.
Fluent in English; French would be an advantage.
Available from December 2026.

jobs.title: SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Securecell is a Swiss technology company at the intersection of biotechnology, engineering, and healthcare. For more than three decades, we have been developing innovative solutions that help advance scientific discoveries and improve people's lives. Combining deep expertise in bioprocess control with a strong culture of innovation, we collaborate across disciplines to transform complex challenges into practical technologies that create real-world impact.

Continuing steadily on our sustainable innovation path and growth journey, we are looking for a
SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
for our Information Technology Department – Software Architecture team – product R&D role

THE OPPORTUNITY
It is an opportunity to contribute to technologies that support groundbreaking scientific discoveries and help shape the future of biotechnology and healthcare.
As a member of our Software Architecture team, you will play an important role in designing, developing, verifying, and managing the lifecycle of software solutions for innovative medical and biotechnological devices. Working closely with experts from various disciplines, you will contribute to challenging projects, develop innovative solutions, and help deliver products that create value for our customers worldwide.
Whether you are improving existing technologies, driving innovation, or solving complex technical challenges, your contributions will have a direct impact on our success and future growth.
You are part of our Software Architecture Team and accountable for the design, development, verification, and lifecycle management of our Lucullus software platform. In this role, you actively contribute to software development, provide technical leadership, and oversee the software development, integration, and verification of our innovative devices. Lucullus is our process information management platform for bioprocess labs: it connects and controls lab devices and bioreactors, acquires and stores process data, and supports experiment planning and analysis.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
•    Design and evolve the architecture of the Lucullus platform (modules, APIs, data model, device-integration layer) and document key decisions in architecture decision records and design specifications.
•    Implement key components yourself (approx. 50% of time is hands-on design and coding)
•    Own the non-functional requirements: performance, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
•    Prototype and evaluate new technologies before they are adopted in the product.
•    Create, review, and maintain technical documentation, including specifications and design descriptions.
•    Support requirements management, risk management, and compliance activities in accordance with applicable standards and quality requirements.
•    Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, and Product Management.

WHO YOU ARE
You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and thrive in an environment where software architecture and development are critical to delivering innovative technologies. You are proactive, hands-on, and motivated to develop technologies that advance biotechnology and improve lives. You are comfortable providing technical leadership within cross-functional and agile teams. You would rather design and build than coordinate: you enjoy writing code, sketching architecture, and defending technical trade-offs with facts. Leading here means leading by technical example, not by managing people or schedules.


YOUR PROFILE
•    Completed studies (FH / Uni / ETH) in Engineering, preferably Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology.
•    At least 3years of experience in software development.
•    Strong expertise in software development with experience in enterprise-grade applications. Hands-on approach.
•    Ability to collaborate effectively, translating architectural decisions into technical solutions across teams.
•    Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complexity in a large technical stack.
•    Ability to mentor engineers and drive technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews.
•    Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD tools, and automation frameworks.
•    Proficiency in Linux environments, particularly with LTS distributions and Oracle Linux (preferred but open to alternatives).
•    Industry experience in Medtech/Biotech and in (bio)process technology is not a prerequisite; however, there must be a strong interest and awareness that the environment is regulated.
•    Experience working with enterprise databases, particularly Oracle DB and PostgreSQL.
•    Solid understanding of security best practices, compliance, and secure coding methodologies.
•    A valid work permit is required, and only direct applications will be taken into consideration (no agencies)

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL
•    Experience in biotechnology, bioprocessing, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, or life sciences (nice to have)
•    Proven track record of designing and personally implementing software systems end-to-end
•    Passion for innovation and technology
•    Ability to navigate ambiguity and identify practical solutions
•    Strong sense of ownership and accountability
•    Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset
•    Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across disciplines
•    Experience working in multidisciplinary and international environments

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT SECURECELL
Make an Impact: Your work contributes to innovative technologies that support scientific progress, improve healthcare outcomes, and help address real-world challenges
Work with Exceptional People: Join a global team of talented scientists, engineers, software developers, and business professionals who are passionate about innovation and collaboration
Grow Your Career: We encourage continuous learning and provide opportunities to develop new skills, expand your expertise, and take on new challenges
Innovate Every Day: Be part of cutting-edge projects and help develop solutions that push the boundaries of biotechnology, automation, and healthcare technology
Take Ownership: We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. You'll enjoy a high level of responsibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to make a visible contribution
Enjoy a Collaborative Culture: Our success is built on teamwork, knowledge sharing, mutual respect, and a genuine passion for solving complex challenges together
Be Part of Our Growth Story: Join a growing Swiss technology company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and long-term thinking are at the core of everything we do

WHAT WE OFFER
With flexible working arrangements, a modern workplace, flat hierarchies, and short decision-making paths, we empower individuals to take ownership, contribute ideas, and make a visible impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement, allowing every team member to help shape the future of our company and the industries we serve. To complement this, we offer:
•    Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and contribution
•    Comprehensive benefits package supporting your well-being
•    Generous vacation entitlement, flexible working hours, and hybrid or remote work options
•    Flexible leave arrangements that support work-life balance
•    Learning and development opportunities through training, mentoring, and hands-on experiences
•    Opportunities to collaborate with international customers and partners
•    Convenient location with direct access to public transport, free indoor parking, complimentary coffee and mineral water
•    Private accident insurance and paid time off for new parents
•    Employee share purchase programs (availability varies upon eligibility)
•    Regular team events and company gatherings that strengthen connections and celebrate success

JOB LOCATION
This position is based at Securecell AG headquarters in Urdorf (Zurich), Switzerland. Reporting to: Head of Software.

INTERESTED?
We look forward to learning more about you! Please submit your complete application, including a cover letter, a resume, certificates, and references, through our career portal at www.securecell.ch/jobs, and share, in 2-3 sentences, what attracted you to our company and this role.

jobs.title: Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty
jobs.description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty
to join the school from: August 2027

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 02.11.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for around 500 students aged 7-18 representing 70 nations. Students prepare for IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced, enthusiastic, dynamic, knowledgeable leader and/or teacher of Physical Education and Sport. PE and Sport are compulsory for students throughout the Junior and Senior schools. In Years 10 and 11 students have the option of studying IGCSE PE. Subsequently, in Years 12 and 13, Sports, Exercise and Health Science is offered and is currently taught in conjunction with the Science department.
KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Professional Standards and Expectations
Carry out teaching duties and exercise responsibilities in line with the Guiding Principles of Aiglon;
Treat all members of the community, colleagues and students, with respect and consideration. Treat all students fairly, consistently and without prejudice;
Set a good example to students in terms of appropriate dress, standards of punctuality and attendance;
Read and adhere to the various policies of the school as expressed in the Aiglon Guide and other agreed documentation, and support the ethos of the school by upholding the behaviour code, uniform and kit regulations and other expectations;
Be available to work on campus in good time to complete all necessary preparations and meetings before the start of term;
Take personal responsibility for professional development and participate in staff training in line with the continued professional development programme of Aiglon;
Encourage members of their faculty to take responsibility for their own professional development and ensure all in the faculty participate in staff training in line with the CPD programme of Aiglon;
Reflect on personal and school practices in pursuit of continuous improvement.
Participate in appraisal and self-evaluation activities and ensure the appraisal system is adhered to and completed within the faculty;
Chair a weekly faculty meeting;
Ensure all faculty members are aware of and adhere to departmental deadlines, policies and procedures;
Undertake pastoral and other duties, including weekend and evening duties, as prescribed within school policies;
Ensure that all deadlines are met as published in the school calendar and as directed by the Head of Faculty/Deputy School Directors;
Undertake professional duties that may be reasonably assigned, including cover and exam invigilation and ensure members of their faculty also undertake these duties;
Attend Assembly/Meditation on at least two mornings a week when averaged over any term and be prepared to give a Meditation once each year;
Be proactive and take responsibility for matters relating to health and safety;
Support the school through regular attendance at various events in the School Calendar (these may be religious, spiritual, sporting or cultural).
Departmental Management
Implement a clear vision for curriculum Physical Education and all aspects of Sport at Aiglon, making sure that there is continuity and progression between Junior School and Senior School;
Develop and manage the strategic development plan for the faculty in line with the School’s strategic development plan thus fostering a love of Physical Education and inspiring a lifelong commitment to Sport;
Line management of Head of Junior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Senior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Snowsports and Performance Athletes, MCFC football coach and the Sports Facilities Manager and support  them in the management of all other members of the Physical Education and Sport faculty;
Ensure that the faculty embraces the opportunities available through strategic partnerships including MCFC;
Ensure the faculty handbook is updated annually and includes reference to objectives for the year ahead which tie into the school’s overall objectives;
Provide a strategic link between the Academic Leadership Group and the Physical Education and Sport faculty, attending meetings and reporting on School-wide initiatives;
Ensure that the Department meets the curriculum requirements for the School;
Monitor and develop the quality of teaching, coaching and learning, through regular visits to lessons and otherwise, with a clear focus on excellence;
Implement a clear vision and structure for competitive inter-school sport across the School at Aiglon;
Implement a clear programme for inter-house sport at Aiglon. Liaise with the Director of Boarding and attend House Parent meetings where necessary to publicise and promote sporting initiatives, with clear communication to all stakeholders (students, staff and parents);
Promote and communicate to the Aiglon community initiatives and success stories from the Physical Education and Sport faculty, through weekly assemblies and the calendar alongside regular liaison with stakeholders in Admissions, Communications and Alumni teams;
Ensure that requirements of examination boards are met, and students are entered for public examinations, submitting appropriate coursework and ensuring that students are suitably prepared for examinations;
Preparing an annual report for the Deputy Director setting out an analysis of external examination results and value-added statistics;
Ensure, in consultation with the Deputy School Director the effective deployment of staff and classes within the Department;
Participate in the appointment of new staff, and support new staff entering the Department;
Ensure all members of the faculty take account of students' prior levels of attainment, and baseline data where relevant, and use these to set targets for future improvements;
Oversee all aspects of the organisation of tournaments, fixtures and trips where appropriate;
To be available for School sporting events including The Challenge, Sports Day and other major School events;
Booking of snowsports instructors for all students in the winter term, which will require close liaison with external ski school instructors used by Aiglon, ensuring a high level of instruction takes place and to ensure ability groups are monitored regularly.

jobs.title: Head of Applied Innovation
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Head of Applied Innovation to lead and shape AAK's global Applied Innovation function,

driving the development of differentiated, science-based solutions that support our long-term growth

ambitions. Reporting to the President Commercial Development & Innovation, this strategic leadership role is

responsible for defining and delivering AAK's global innovation pipeline across key industry segments,

ensuring innovation activities are aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, and business strategy.

Leading a global team across our Centres of Excellence and innovation hubs, you will oversee the full

innovation lifecycle—from ideation and product development through to commercialization—while

strengthening innovation governance, application excellence, intellectual property, and portfolio

management. Working closely with senior leaders across Commercial, Marketing, Operations, Customer

Innovation, and R&D, you will play a pivotal role in delivering market-leading solutions and positioning AAK as

a trusted innovation partner worldwide.

​Innovation Strategy & Portfolio Management

- Define and execute AAK's global innovation strategy across key industry segments, ensuring

alignment with business objectives and market opportunities.

- Lead the end-to-end innovation process, from ideation and product development through pilot,

scale-up, and commercialization.

- Manage and prioritise the global innovation portfolio, ensuring transparency, strategic alignment, and

effective resource allocation.

- Drive continuous improvement of AAK's StageGate innovation process to strengthen governance,

decision-making, and execution.

- Deliver differentiated lipid-based solutions by translating scientific insights into commercially

successful products.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Lead, develop, and inspire the global Applied Innovation organisation, including Centres of

Excellence and cross-functional innovation teams.

- Foster a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, accountability, innovation, and

continuous learning.

- Partner with Industry Business Leaders, regional teams, Marketing, Customer Innovation, Insights,

Commercial, R&D, and Operations to align innovation priorities globally.

- Build and maintain strong external partnerships with customers, universities, start-ups, and strategic

innovation partners.

​

Innovation Excellence & Commercialisation

- Drive Application Excellence globally, ensuring consistent technical standards, methodologies, and

scientific rigour.

- Ensure successful technology transfer from innovation into manufacturing, supporting efficient

industrialisation and product launches.

- Lead innovation-related digitalisation initiatives, including portfolio management and Product

Lifecycle Management (PLM) capabilities.

- Oversee innovation budgets and ensure effective investment across strategic innovation priorities.

Intellectual Property & Governance

- Develop and implement AAK's innovation intellectual property strategy, driving proactive IP creation

and protection.

- Collaborate with Legal and external partners to manage IP risks, freedom-to-operate assessments,

and competitive intelligence.

- Ensure robust governance, compliance, and continuous improvement across innovation processes

and systems.

​

Executive Leadership

- Present innovation strategy, portfolio progress, and key initiatives to the Executive Committee and

Board.

- Provide strategic insight and recommendations that support long-term business growth and

competitive advantage.

- Act as a visible innovation leader across the organisation, championing customer-centric and

science-led innovation.

About you

- Degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.

- 10+ years of leadership experience within innovation, product development, or R&D in the food,

ingredients, or related industry.

- Proven experience leading global or regional innovation teams within a complex matrix organisation.

- Strong knowledge of StageGate processes, New Product Development (NPD), portfolio

management, and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM).

- Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into successful innovation pipelines and

commercial outcomes.

- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify growth opportunities through customer and

market insights.

- Experience developing intellectual property strategies and innovation governance frameworks.

- Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of developing high-performing global teams.

- Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience engaging Executive

Committee and Board-level audiences.

- Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex scientific concepts into clear

business messages.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, global, decentralised environment with multiple stakeholders

and competing priorities.

- Fluent in English; additional languages such as Spanish, Mandarin, or Portuguese would be

advantageous.

- Willingness to travel regularly within Europe and occasionally internationally.

jobs.title: Tekninen koordinaattori
jobs.description:
Porvoon kaupungin matkailu ja tapahtuma- ja markkinointipalvelut hakee teknistä koordinaattoria vakituiseen tehtävään vastaamaan Porvoon Taidetehtaan teknisestä koordinoinnista sekä toteuttamaan kaupunkitapahtumia. Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian, sopimuksen mukaan.

Taidetehdas on sekä kaupunkilaisten avoin toimintaympäristö että monipuolinen kulttuuri- ja tapahtumatalo. Tekninen koordinaattori varmistaa, että tämä näkyy jokaisessa tilaisuudessa laadukkaana toteutuksena, turvallisuutena ja sujuvana palveluna.

Tehtävässä vastaat siitä, että Taidetehtaan tilat, kalusto ja tekniikka ovat asianmukaisessa kunnossa, käyttövalmiina ja oikeilla paikoillaan. Huolehdit myös siitä, että tilat on kalustettu ja valmisteltu tarkoituksenmukaisesti eri tapahtumia varten. Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä tapahtumajärjestäjien, palveluntuottajien ja talon muiden käyttäjien kanssa ja ohjaat heitä tilojen ja välineistön oikeaoppisessa käytössä.

Työnkuvaan sisältyy sekä talon päivittäisen toiminnan ylläpitoa että tapahtumiin liittyvää käytännön tukea valmisteluista aina toteutukseen saakka. Huolehdit talon yhteisten toimintatapojen toteutumisesta, seuraat kaluston ja teknisten järjestelmien ajantasaista tilannetta, osallistut hankintojen suunnitteluun ja varmistat, että ratkaisut ovat tarkoituksenmukaisia ja kustannustehokkaita.

Työssäsi keskeistä on myös turvallisuuden varmistaminen: ylläpidät ajantasaista dokumentaatiota, perehdytät tilojen käyttäjiä, ohjaat turvallisia toimintatapoja ja valvot, että tapahtumat toteutuvat voimassa olevien vaatimusten mukaisesti. Tehtävässä vastaat omien vastuualueidesi asioiden seurannasta, dokumentoinnista ja loppuun saattamisesta.

Arjen tuotannoissa tarvitset luovaa otetta, kykyä hallita kokonaisuuksia ja valmiutta tehdä päätöksiä nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Huolehdit turvallisista työtavoista, perehdytyksestä ja laadunvarmistuksesta, ja viet käytäntöön talon yhteisiä pelisääntöjä. Tehtäväsi ulottuu myös Taidetehtaan ulkopuolelle: osallistut tiimin tuottamiin kaupunkitapahtumiin, joissa hyödynnetään osaamistasi ja kokemustasi tuotantojen teknisestä koordinoinnista.

Edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa alempaa korkeakoulututkintoa tai vastaavaa osaamista sekä riittävää työkokemusta tapahtumien teknisestä tuotannosta. Tehtävä edellyttää käytännön osaamista tapahtumatekniikasta sekä tapahtumatilojen teknisten järjestelmien käytöstä ja ylläpidosta. Tehtävässä tulee pystyä kartoittamaan asiakkaiden teknisiä tarpeita ja keskustelemaan niistä sujuvasti.

Menestyt tehtävässä, kun yhteystyö ja vuorovaikutustaidot ovat erinomaiset, asiakaspalvelu sujuu luontevasti ja kykenet oma-aloitteiseen, itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Edellytämme hyvää suomen ja ruotsin kielen taitoa sekä valmiutta ilta- ja viikonlopputyöhön. Hankintaosaaminen katsotaan eduksi.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja sijoittuu Porvooseen. KVTES:n mukainen tasopalkka tehtävästä on 2935,47 €/kk. Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa. Tehtävässä ei ole etätyömahdollisuutta.

Lähetä hakemuksesi 15.10.2026 klo 12 Hae työpaikkaa- linkin kautta.


Lisätietoja antavat Sari Myllynen, matkailun kehittämispäällikkö, puh. 040 706 1200 ja Katarina Broas, tapahtumapäällikkö puh. 040 489 1899.

👩‍💻 About The Role You will establish and lead a brand-new Portfolio Delivery function, an overarching coordination layer across Asset Development that doesn't exist today. You'll coordinate project delivery from Ready-to-Build (RtB) through to Commercial Operation Date (COD), spanning development, EPC-execution, grid, tolling and financing, working alongside existing project-level management rather than replacing it. You'll also make sure project information across the full portfolio, including pre-RtB, is structured and accessible through AI-driven agents. You'll report to the VP Asset Development. This is a unique opportunity to build a process from the ground up and shape how Flower brings its assets to life.

What You’ll Do:

    

Coordinate post-RtB project delivery across development, EPC-execution, grid, tolling/merchant and financing

    

Ensure all projects between RtB and COD are actively managed through the function, securing the best possible asset conditions at COD

    

Establish and maintain the processes and handoff points needed for smooth post-RtB delivery

    

Develop internal routines and reporting cadences that give Asset Development and Flower a clear quarterly view of portfolio-level delivery progress

    

Follow up on delivery timelines and escalate risks to schedules or cross-functional handoffs early

    

Set up and maintain the AI-driven agents used to structure and surface project information across the portfolio, including pre-RtB

    

Maintain a single, up-to-date, queryable source of project status for Asset Development

Who You Are:

    

Educational background: Master's degree (e.g. MSc) or equivalent in business/finance or engineering

    

5+ years of experience in project or portfolio management, with proven ownership of fast-moving and complex projects with multi-stakeholder deliveries

    

Experienced from a scale-up or fast-growing organization

    

Proven in renewable energy, infrastructure or another capital-intensive industry

    

Knowledgeable about the commercial structures in energy asset lifecycles, from development through to commercial operations (RtB, EPC, grid, tolling/merchant, financing and operations)

    

A clear communicator who gets to the point and can present complex portfolio scenarios in an easy-to-digest way

    

A strong problem-solver and decision-maker who thrives working collaboratively across teams and functions

    

Strong skills in stakeholder management, executive communication and risk mitigation

    

Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Additional European languages (e.g. German, French, Dutch) are a plus

📍 Location Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.

✉️ Apply Our corporate language is English, as we have over 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Elevresurs för elev inom de tidigare skolåren
jobs.description:
Älmhults kommun finns i södra Småland med närhet till goda kommunikationer och natursköna områden. I Älmhult kombinerar du den mindre ortens fördelar och charm med en unik internationell atmosfär. Här är det lätt att leva och bo och du har nära till det mesta. Vi är cirka 1800 stolta och engagerade medarbetare som bidrar med service av hög kvalitet till Älmhults invånare varje dag. Vår arbetsmiljö präglas av samarbete, mod och delaktighet. Tillsammans gör vi skillnad!



1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som elevresurs finns du vid elevens sida under hela skoldagen som en stödjande hand. Tillsammans med lärare undervisar ni eleven utifrån elevens förutsättningar.

Du stödjer eleven i kunskapsutveckling, trygghet och delaktighet utifrån elevens individuella behov.

Du ger eleven ett pedagogiskt stöd genom att:

-Stötta utifrån elevens individuella förutsättningar och mål i undervisningen.

-Ge tydliga instruktioner, struktur och visuellt stöd under skoldagen.

-Verka för en lugn, trygg och inkluderande lärmiljö.

Du arbetar aktivt för ett relationellt arbete genom att:

-Bygga en trygg och förtroendefull relation med eleven.

-Arbeta aktivt med att stärka elevens självkänsla, motivation och tilltro till den egna förmågan.

-Vara en positiv förebild och ett stöd i sociala situationer.

-Finnas där och vara stödjande för eleven i relationer med andra elever.

Du arbetar med tydlig struktur och tydliggörande pedagogik genom:

-Skapa och upprätthålla tydliga rutiner och förutsägbara strukturer.

-Använda visuella scheman, tidsstöd och andra kompensatoriska hjälpmedel.

-Förbereda eleven inför förändringar och övergångar under skoldagen.

Du har god kontakt med vårdnadshavare för att skapa en helhetssyn kring elevens behov och utveckling.

Du kommer samverka med skolans elevhälsoteam, specialpedagog, speciallärare, mentor och övrig personal.

KVALIFIKATIONER
För tjänsten behöver du ha god kunskap om neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar såsom ADHD och autism.

Vi vill att du har förmåga att arbeta lågaffektivt och relationsskapande.  Du är tydlig, strukturerad och flexibel i ditt arbetssätt.

Dessutom behöver du ha god samarbetsförmåga samt förmåga att arbeta självständigt. Samt stor förståelse för vikten av ett inkluderande och respektfullt bemötande.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2026-10-05  , upphör: 2026-12-31  .

Anställning sker löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan. Anställningen är inledningsvis tidsbegränsad med möjlighet till förlängning.

Före anställning krävs registerutdrag från belastningsregistret. Gör gärna en ansökan om utdrag redan om du skulle bli kallad på intervju.

Älmhults kommun tillämpar kompetensbaserad rekrytering och tar inte emot personliga brev. Urvalet görs istället utifrån CV, urvalsfrågor och intervjuer kopplade till tjänstens krav. I rekryteringsprocessen tillämpas även anonym ansökan vid det första urvalet. För att säkerställa anonymiteten ber vi dig därför att inte inkludera namn, adress, foto, födelsedatum eller andra personuppgifter som kan identifiera dig i det CV du bifogar.

Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att jobba på Älmhults kommun: https://www.almhult.se/jobba-hos-oss

Innan anställning måste du kunna visa att du har rätt att arbeta, i enlighet med utlänningsförordningen. Det innebär att du behöver styrka ditt medborgarskap i EU/EES eller Schweiz genom att uppvisa pass, nationellt id-kort eller personbevis tillsammans med en identitetshandling. Om du inte kan göra det måste du istället visa upp ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller på annat sätt bevisa att du är undantagen från kravet på arbetstillstånd.

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringstjänster i samband med den här annonsen.

jobs.title: Dormsjöstiftelsen söker till Rönnbo behandlingspedagoger
jobs.description:
Verksamhetsbeskrivning:

Dormsjöskolan är ett hem för vård och boende (HVB) för pojkar mellan 7-23 år.

Vi finns i Södra Dalarna, strax norr om Hedemora och har en egen friskola. Här bor barn och ungdomar i fem vackert belägna hus, i närheten av en fin badsjö och spännande skogar. Här finns möjlighet till roliga aktiviteter och lugna stunder och vuxna att luta sig mot.

Målgrupp:

Pojkar med neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar samt med social och emotionell problematik.

Vi har tillstånd för 28 barn/ungdomar och tillståndet omfattar placeringar med stöd av SoL, LVU och LSS.

Beskrivning av arbetsuppgifterna:

I den här tjänsten ingår du i ett arbetslag om tre personer som tillsammans ansvarar för arbetet kring en ungdom. En stor del av arbetstiden arbetar du självständigt tillsammans med ungdomen, vilket ställer krav på trygghet, ansvarstagande och förmåga att arbeta strukturerat.

För ungdomen finns tydligt utformade rutiner, arbetssätt och strategier. En viktig del av uppdraget är därför att kunna följa överenskomna arbetssätt och bidra till kontinuitet, förutsägbarhet och trygghet i ungdomens vardag. Det är viktigt att du kan vara konsekvent i ditt arbete samtidigt som du är lyhörd för ungdomens behov och dagsform.

Under förmiddagarna följer du ungdomen i skolan och är ett stöd under skoldagen. Övrig arbetstid är du tillsammans med ungdomen i boendet och vid aktiviteter. Du samarbetar nära med dina två kollegor och andra personer runt ungdomen för att skapa en sammanhållen och fungerande vardag.

Vi söker dig som

Du är trygg och stabil och trivs med att arbeta självständigt. Du har lätt för att skapa relation samtidigt som du kan hålla fast vid överenskomna strukturer och arbetssätt. Du förstår vikten av att alla som arbetar kring en ungdom arbetar på ett likartat och förutsägbart sätt.

Du behöver också kunna samarbeta väl, kommunicera med kollegor och bidra till att arbetslaget håller en gemensam linje i arbetet. Vi värdesätter särskilt ett lugnt och lågaffektivt förhållningssätt, tålamod, ansvarstagande och förmåga att behålla lugnet även i situationer som är krävande.

Utbildning: Social/behandlingspedagog eller annan utbildning som bedöms likvärdig är ett krav.

Vid eventuell anställning krävs utdrag ur belastnings- och misstankeregistret.

Rekrytering sker fortlöpande, märk din ansökan med tillsvidare Rönnbo.

jobs.title: SiS ungdomshem Hässleholm söker behandlingspedagog
jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.

SiS ungdomshem Hässleholm är en låsbar institution med fyra behandlingsavdelningar, två avdelningar för mottagning och behovsbedömning (MBB) samt en öppen TFCO-enhet. På Karlsvik i Höör har vi en öppen utskrivningsförberedande avdelning. Avdelningen är en del av vår verksamhet där behandlingsaktiktiveteter främst består av färdighetsträning som riktas mot att förbereda ungdomen för ett fungerande liv efter sin tid på SiS, både praktiskt och socialt.

Vi tar till övervägande del emot skolpliktiga pojkar men även flickor, med pågående kriminalitet och i vissa fall missbruk.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vill du vara med och skapa den livsviktiga förändringen för utsatta människor? Då är jobbet som behandlingspedagog hos SiS en meningsfull utmaning. Som behandlingspedagog arbetar du i team tillsammans med behandlingsassistenter och behandlingssamordnare och tillsammans ansvarar ni för att de ungdomar och klienter som bor hos oss får den trygghet, vård och behandling som de behöver. Vi möter ofta människor i kris, vilket innebär att du jobbar med kvalificerat omvårdnads-och motivationsarbete och med att vara ett stöd i vardagen. Med stöd av dina kunskaper inom vård- och behandlingsarbete bidrar du aktivt till att behandlingsplaner fullföljs. Dokumentation är en viktig del av ditt arbete och bidrar bland annat till rättssäkerhet, planering och uppföljning av vår verksamhet. Du bidrar till att säkerheten upprätthålls enligt våra rutiner och du medverkar till att vardagen flyter på med skolgång, städning, matlagning med mera. Kontaktmannaskap är också en av dina arbetsuppgifter. I arbetet kan det även ingå att vara handledare åt nya medarbetare och praktikanter. Det här är ett arbete för dig som ser en positiv utmaning i att få arbeta med utsatta människor i en svår livssituation. Jobbet är många gånger krävande men också stimulerande, glädjefyllt och omväxlande.

Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt.

Arbetstiden är enligt schema dag - kväll och helg.

Som ny medarbetare ingår en introduktionsvecka som är obligatorsik att genomföra innan man börjar arbeta på avdelningen. I utbildningen varvas teori med en handledd introduktion och utbildningen rustar dig för behandlarrollen i SiS verksamhet.

När du har påbörjat din anställning kommer du även genomgå SiS grundutbildning på 10 veckor. I utbildningen varvas teori med en handledd introduktion med olika utbildningar.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i ditt arbete har du en grundmurad positiv människosyn. Du är motiverad att hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation och du delar SiS värdegrund, att vara en plats för förändring. Vidare har du en god förmåga att skapa engagemang och delaktighet hos våra ungdomar. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har lätt för att skapa relation med ungdomar likväl som med övriga i personalgruppen. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan behålla ditt lugn även i pressade situationer. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och du kan hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Du ska också ha:

    Examen från 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning vid folkhögskola eller yrkeshögskola (KY/YH) med inriktning mot socialt/pedagogiskt behandlingsarbete eller utbildning från högskola som vi bedömer likvärdig
    Din yrkesskola ska vara CSN berättigad.
    Godkända betyg i gymnasiet.
    B- körkort
    God svenska i tal och skrift
    Erfarenhet att arbeta med människor i utsatta livssituationer.

På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.

Anställning:

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Ansökan:

Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg senast 261025

Vi kontaktar dig som sökande via mail samt även per telefon, håll utkik i din inkorg men även skräppost där mailen ibland hamnar.

Vi vill även uppmärksamma till dem som har gmail att byta till annan då det har visat sig att man inte får våra meddelanden i rekryteringsprocessen.

SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande.

För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

jobs.title: Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work.

We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when humans can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI.

As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments humans.

If that’s a mission that excites you, you’re in the right place.

About the Role

We believe that everything starts with learning. And that by changing the way the world learns, we can change the world for the better. If that’s a mission that excites you, you’ll be in great company as part of the Sana team in Workday.

The Sana team is known for its adaptability, entrepreneurial spirit, and relentless pursuit of excellence, embodying our core belief that learning is the foundation of all meaningful change.

We work very closely with the companies who choose Sana. Together we problem solve, design solutions and implement them to drive change. Ultimately we measure ourselves through the impact we achieve through rolling out and adopting Sana. Our challenges are to continually learn and adapt to meet the unique needs of each company and team, and implement the creative solutions that make us proud of what we have achieved. While doing so we define what the future Sana's customer success, solution engineering and deployments teams will look like. By scaling this team, we create a significant impact on how people learn, across every industry, and across the globe.

In this role, you will:

Own end-to-end customer engagements

    Serve as the overall engagement owner for assigned accounts, accountable for successful implementation and ongoing value realisation.
    Lead complex deployments of Sana for medium and large enterprise customers, from discovery and design through go-live and post-launch optimisation.

Lead project and program delivery

    Define and manage project scope, plan, timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple work streams.
    Ensure delivery within the budget and scope outlined in the Statement of Work, proactively managing changes and trade-offs.
    Coordinate internal Sana resources and external partners to deliver against project objectives.

Engage senior customer stakeholders

    Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with executive sponsors and key decision makers.
    Facilitate steering committees and executive readouts, clearly articulating progress, risks, and business impact.
    Align Sana’s roadmap and capabilities with the customer’s strategic priorities and success metrics.

Drive adoption and measurable impact

    Define, track, and report on success metrics and KPIs for each engagement.
    Work closely with customer project managers and business owners to promote adoption, ensure change readiness, and drive continuous improvement.
    Identify optimisation and expansion opportunities that increase the value customers realise from Sana.

Provide strategic and solution guidance

    Translate business requirements into solution designs and implementation plans in collaboration with Solution Engineering and Product.
    Advise customers on best practices for learning, change management, and digital adoption, leveraging Sana’s capabilities.
    Challenge and refine customer requirements where needed to ensure viable, scalable, and high-impact solutions.

Collaborate cross-functionally and with partners

    Work effectively with Sales to scope new engagements, shape proposals, and ensure a smooth transition from pre‑sales to delivery.
    Manage third-party partners or vendors as part of the overall project team, maintaining accountability for overall outcomes.
    Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering based on customer needs and deployment learnings.

About You

Basic Qualifications (P3 Engagement Manager)

    At least 5 years of progressively responsible experience in Enterprise software implementation, management consulting, or customer success / professional services roles.
    Direct experience leading complex implementation projects in medium or large enterprises, with responsibility for scope, timeline, budget, stakeholder management, and outcomes

Basic Qualifications (P4 Senior Engagement Manager)

    At least 8 years of progressively responsible experience in Enterprise software implementation, management consulting, or customer success / professional services roles.
    Direct experience leading complex implementation projects in medium or large enterprises, with responsibility for scope, timeline, budget, stakeholder management, and outcomes

Other Qualifications:

You will thrive in this role if you:

    Are naturally curious, always seeking to learn, and view every challenge as a growth opportunity.
    Have strong project and program management skills, with a solid track record leading complex implementations in a Professional Services or Customer Success environment.
    Are comfortable engaging with C‑level and senior stakeholders, with excellent communication and presentation skills.
    Possess grit and determination, allowing you to weather setbacks and persist towards ambitious goals.
    Are driven by excellence and high standards in planning, execution, and stakeholder management.
    Embody humbleness and a collaborative mindset, always ready to learn from others and co‑create solutions.
    Are deeply committed to our mission of changing the way the world learns and have a genuine passion for driving customer impact.
    Are strong at building relationships, working cross-functionally, and influencing internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Creative Lead at NAKED Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Join NAKED Copenhagen as our new Creative Lead

Do you see visuals before they exist? Do you know how to turn brand identity into campaigns, designs, content, and experiences that people remember?

Then you might be the Creative Lead we’re looking for at NAKED Copenhagen.

This is not just a design role. It’s a key creative position at the heart of our Marketing & Creative Team, someone who’s shaping how NAKED Copenhagen looks, feels, and communicates across every touchpoint.


About the Role

As our new Creative Lead, you’ll take ownership of our visual direction and help bring our brand universe to life across digital, physical, and social platforms.

Working closely with Stine, our Founder & CEO, you’ll play a key role in translating NAKED Copenhagen’s vision into creative concepts, campaigns, and experiences that resonate with our colleagues, partners, community, and customers.

You’ll collaborate closely with various professionals in the Marketing & Creative Team, as well as E-Commerce, Retail, Buying & Merchandising, and external partners, to develop ideas and execute content that strengthens our brand presence.

From campaign editorials and website experiences to social media, collaborations, and product design, you’ll be a central part of shaping, maintaining, and evolving the NAKED Copenhagen identity.


What You’ll Do

•          Owning and evolving the brand's creative direction and visual identity across all customer touchpoints.

•          Developing creative concepts and leading the visual execution of campaigns, content and brand experiences.

•          Design and deliver exciting, engaging graphics across web pages, newsletters, logos, signs, advertisements, instore window layouts and other communication materials.

•          Leading art direction for photo, video and content productions while ensuring a consistently high creative standard.

•          Overseeing the visual expression across digital platforms, retail, events and all brand communication.

•          Collaborating closely with Marketing, Ecommerce and other key teams to translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions.

•          Leading selected collaborations, special projects and brand activations that strengthen the brand's visual identity and positioning.

 

Who You Are

•          A confident creative thinker with a strong eye for aesthetics, detail, and visual storytelling.

•          5+ years of experience within the fashion and lifestyle industry, with a scope including execution on design processes, graphic design, and campaign development.

•          Experience with developing visual concepts from idea to final execution.

•          Passionate about fashion, sneakers, culture, and contemporary brand building.

•          Comfortable balancing creativity with ambitious commercial goals and deadlines.

•          Able to work independently while collaborating closely with different teams while translating the creative agenda and vision.

•          Structured, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects at once as we always operate with an ambitious marketing calendar.

•          Strong understanding of digital platforms, social media trends, and content creation.

•          Communicate confidently in English, written and spoken.

•          Have experience from a similar creative, design, or brand-focused role.

About the Marketing & Creative Team

You’ll join our Marketing & Creative Team led by Simon, our Buying & Marketing Director. Together, the team shapes and executes everything from campaigns and launches to shoots, social content, events, and brand collaborations.

What We Offer

•          A fast-moving and creative work environment.

•          A role where your ideas directly shape the NAKED Copenhagen brand.

•          Creative ownership and responsibility from day one.

•          Close collaboration with a passionate team across marketing, e-commerce, retail, and buying.

•          Hands-on involvement in campaigns, launches, collaborations, and brand experiences.

•          A workplace where creativity, energy, and teamwork matter.

•          A job that goes beyond the desk.

Interested?

Please send your CV and application in English or Danish to job@nakedcph.com with “Creative Lead” in the subject line.

We’re looking forward to meeting you.

On behalf of,
Simon, Marketing & Creative Department
& the rest of the NAKED Copenhagen Team

jobs.title: Stödassistenter/stödpersoner till elevboenden i Östersund
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu engagerade stödassistenter/stödpersoner till två elevboenden i centrala Östersund och Torvalla. Du kommer att arbeta i ett team med 4–6 stödassistenter/stödpersoner, där samarbete och trygghet är centralt.

Uppdraget handlar om att stötta elever i deras vardag och skapa goda förutsättningar efter skolgång inom gymnasieskola. Eleverna kommer från närkommuner runt om Östersund och bor på elevboendet under sin studietid. Alla elever har olika förmågor och behov av stöd, och arbetet anpassas utifrån individens förutsättningar, självbestämmande och utveckling. Insatsen är normalt beviljad under fyra år. Verksamheterna är öppna när gymnasieskolan är öppen, fem dagar per vecka. Under skolloven planeras arbetet om till dagtid och kan innehålla exempelvis planeringsdagar, utbildningsdagar samt arbete med genomförandeplaner. Hos oss erbjuds du en tydlig yrkesresa genom Yrkesresan, en nationell och strukturerad satsning på kompetensutveckling inom LSS. Yrkesresan ger dig stöd, verktyg och kunskap genom en kombination av digitalt lärande och regionala träffar, med fokus på metoder, lagstiftning och god praxis. Du kommer även att arbeta i nära samarbete med stödpedagog som finns knuten till verksamheten och bland annat håller särskild arbetsplatsträff helt med fokus på våra elever.

Alla tjänster, tre i Torvalla och två i centrala Östersund är tillsvidareanställningar med tjänstgöringsgrad på 92,5%, med möjlighet att arbeta 100% inom Sektor funktionshinder. Inför anställning väljer du om du önskar semestertjänst eller uppehållstjänst. Arbetsplatserna har fast rullande schema, oftast över sex veckor. Arbetstiderna är förlagda till dag, kväll och jour. Tillträde 7 januari 2027 eller enligt överenskommelse.

Ditt nya jobb

Som stödassistent arbetar du nära eleverna och ger individuellt anpassat stöd utifrån deras behov och förutsättningar. Du stöttar dem i vardagen, exempelvis med matlagning och städning, och bidrar till en aktiv och meningsfull fritid genom gemensamma och individuella aktiviteter. Det kan innebära att närvara på ungdomsgård på någon av våra mötesplatser eller följa med till aktiviteter som simning, ridning och dans. Målet är att stärka elevernas delaktighet och personliga utveckling och skapa förutsättningar för ett så självständigt, tryggt och meningsfullt liv som möjligt.

Arbetet utgår från KASAM och tydliggörande pedagogik, såsom TAKK och AKK, där tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande. Samarbete sker både inom och mellan elevboendena, och arbete på annat elevboende kan förekomma vid behov. Du samverkar även med vårdnadshavare och externa aktörer som barnhabiliteringen, barn- och ungdomspsykiatrin samt, för elever över 18 år, vuxenhabiliteringen.

Vanliga arbetsuppgifter

    Skapa rutin och struktur för medborgaren
    Skapa förutsättningar till social gemenskap, som att planera för aktiviteter tillsammans med medborgaren
    Skapa relation och förtroende med medborgaren
    Omvårdnad
    Dokumentation

Din kompetens

Krav

    Gymnasial utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer lämplig. Vi ser gärna att du har en utbildning inom vård, pedagogik eller socialt arbete
    Goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift
    Goda datorkunskaper

Meriterande

    Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat inom vård, pedagogik eller inom socialt arbete
    Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med barn/unga med funktionsnedsättning
    Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat inom LSS
    Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med alternativ och kompletterande kommunikation (AKK)
    Körkort-B (även manuell växellåda)

Övrigt

    Inför eventuell anställning behöver du uppvisa utdrag "Arbete med barn enligt LSS" ur belastningsregistret.

Vi söker dig

Som har förmåga att sätta dig in i andra människors perspektiv och situation utan att ta över deras känslor. Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till ändrade omständigheter. Du kan snabbt ändra synsätt och förhållningssätt och ser möjligheter i förändringar. Du tar initiativ, sätter igång aktiviteter och arbetar för att uppnå resultat. Du är trygg och stabil och har god självinsikt. Du ser relationer i sitt rätta perspektiv, kan skilja mellan det personliga och det professionella och anpassar ditt förhållningssätt efter situationen. Du arbetar bra tillsammans med andra och bemöter människor på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt. Du lyssnar och kommunicerar väl samt hanterar och löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.



Så går rekryteringen till

Intervjuer kan ske löpande. Vi vill att du bifogar CV och personligt brev i din ansökan. Betyg/intyg behöver inte skickas med. Det ber vi dig komplettera med om det blir aktuellt med en intervju.

Östersunds kommun har före annonsering övervägt val av annonseringskanaler och undanber sig därför samtal från rekryteringsfirmor och annonsförsäljare.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Östersunds kommun erbjuder dig förmåner så som betald semester från första anställningsåret, semesterväxling, friskvårdsbidrag eller friskvårdstimme. Via vår förmånsportal får du ta del av oberoende pensionsrådgivning och en mängd rabatter och erbjudanden. Du kan dessutom få snabbt och professionellt stöd från olika specialister, som till exempel psykologer, jurister och ekonomer, genom tjänsten Personalstöd. Du kan läsa mer om våra förmåner på vår hemsida: https://www.ostersund.se/naringsliv-och-arbete/jobba-hos-oss/sa-har-jobbar-vi/lon-och-formaner.html

Om Vård- och omsorgsförvaltningen

Inom Vård- och omsorgsförvaltningen tillämpar vi valfri sysselsättningsgrad för tillsvidareanställda medarbetare. Det innebär att du som medarbetare har rätt att arbeta upp till heltid inom andra verksamheter i din sektor. Detta ger dig en chans till variation, nya erfarenheter och ett bredare nätverk. Vi värnar om att skapa en flexibel arbetsmiljö där dina önskemål och verksamhetens behov möts.Att jobba med hjärtat hos oss på Vård- och omsorgsförvaltningen innebär att du bidrar till att skapa enklare, rikare och tryggare liv för invånarna i Östersund. Vi arbetar med människor i alla åldrar och strävar efter att alltid göra skillnad i vardagen. Det är viktigt. På riktigt..

CNC Machining Centre and Router Operator Location: Sandyford, Dublin Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent Hours: 40 hours per week Salary: €38,000 per year About Us Gaelite Signs, established in 1933, is one of Ireland’s leading sign manufacturing companies with over 90 years of expertise in delivering innovative branding and display solutions.
