jobs.title: Structural Engineer - Oceanbird
jobs.description:
AlfaWall Oceanbird AB is a 50/50 joint venture, owned by Alfa Laval and Wallenius but operated as an independent company. Our strong mother companies provide valuable insights in shipping and industrial production and enable us to have a long-term perspective.

By harnessing wind - a constant and free energy source - we contribute to a more sustainable shipping industry. The wind helped us discover our planet - now it can help us preserve it!



The role

We are looking for an experienced Structural Engineer to join our Innovation team and help develop Oceanbird's next generation of wind-powered propulsion systems for commercial vessels.

In this role, you will be responsible for the structural integrity and design of large, complex structures, from early concepts through detailed design and verification. You will combine engineering fundamentals and hand calculations with advanced finite element analysis to understand structural behaviour, identify critical design drivers, and develop robust and cost-efficient solutions. Your structural expertise will directly influence how our products are designed, manufactured, tested, and operated.



The role is highly hands-on but also requires a strong system-level perspective. You will need to understand not only how an individual component behaves, but how the complete product functions and interacts with its operational environment.





Key responsibilities

    Perform structural calculations ranging from hand calculations and analytical methods to advanced FEA.

    Develop, assess, and document structural designs from concept through detailed design, testing, and verification in close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across mechanical, automation control, electrical, supply chain and quality, and customer projects.

    Take a system-level approach to understanding loads, boundary conditions, interfaces, operational environments, and failure modes.

    Prepare and peer-review structural calculation reports and documentation.

    Apply relevant design standards and class rules, such as DNV requirements.

    Evaluate alternative design solutions regarding structural performance, manufacturability, weight, complexity, and cost.

    Develop and maintain expertise in one or more specialist areas of structural engineering, such as fatigue, welding, bolted joints, dynamics, buckling, composite/steel structures, or structural optimisation.

    Communicate structural risks, assumptions, and design recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    Contribute to design reviews, testing, verification activities, and continuous improvement of our engineering methods and processes.





What we are looking for

We believe the right candidate combines strong structural engineering fundamentals with a proven track record of delivering projects from concept to field-proven solutions.



You likely have:

    Minimum 5 years of professional experience in structural engineering or a closely related field.

    A master's degree in structural engineering, mechanical engineering, naval architecture, aerospace engineering, or a similar discipline.

    Strong understanding of structural mechanics and engineering fundamentals.

    Practical experience with linear and non-linear finite element analysis; experience with ANSYS is highly desirable.

    Python programming experience is a plus.

    Experience designing and dimensioning large steel structures is highly desirable.

    Experience with marine, offshore, shipbuilding, heavy machinery, energy, or other highly regulated structural applications is an advantage.

    Experience working with DNV standards or other marine classification society rules is highly desirable.

    A sound understanding of how engineering decisions affect the business case of the product.

    Fluent professional English, both written and spoken.





Personal profile

We are looking for someone who:

    Is genuinely passionate about structural engineering and enjoys solving complex engineering problems.

    Is a pragmatic engineer who combines analytical depth with good engineering judgement.

    Is comfortable getting into the details when necessary but is equally able to step back and understand the bigger picture and how your decisions affect the complete product.

    enjoys working collaboratively in multi-disciplinary teams.

    Is comfortable challenging designs and assumptions when you see a better structural solution.

    can explain technical reasoning clearly and adapt your communication to your audience.

    is self-motivated and takes ownership of your work.



Most importantly, you want to be part of a multidisciplinary team where structural engineering is not simply a verification function, but an active part of shaping the product.



Location: Stockholm, Sweden. Occasional travel should be expected as part of the role.





We review applications continually so please send in yours not later than October 11th, 2026.

Please note that, in compliance with GDPR, we cannot accept applications submitted via email.



As part of Alfa Wall Oceanbird commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, alcohol and drug testing is applied during the preemployment process. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role.

Meie jaoks ei ole koristus nähtamatu töö, vaid professionaalne ja väärtuslik teenus, millel on päris mõju nii klientidele kui kogu töökeskkonnale.

Seoses rühmade suurenemisega, otsime enda kollektiivi kohusetundlike ning aktiivseid lapsehoidjaid!

Tööülesanded: Turvalise ja mängulise kasvukeskkonna loomine. Koristustööde tegemine. Lapse mängu-, tunnetus-, õpi-, sotsiaalsete ja enesekohaste oskuste kujunemise toetamine. Lapse keele ja kõne toetamine. Lapse väärtuste ja hea käitumistava kujundamine. Mängu ja tegevuste kavandamine, läbiviimine ja analüüsimine. Lapse loovuse toetamine. * suvel ja jõulude ajal on kollektiivpuhkus; * väljaõpet kohapeal; * toetav kollektiiv; * ühisüritused.

Sinult ootame: soovi ja tahet töötada lastega; rõõmsameelsust ja loovust; head suhtlemisoskust; head pingetaluvust ja rahulikku meelt; valmisolekut töötada meeskonnas; vastutustundlikkust ja hoolivust. Kasuks tuleb: varasem töökogemus lastega; lapsehoidja kutsetunnistus. Tööks on vajalik: kehtiv tervisetõend; esmaabitunnistus. Arvestada tuleb, et meie hoius on lapsed vanuses 1,5–3 aastat. Kui otsid kodust ja sooja lastehoidu, kus saad oma fantaasial lennata, lastega mängida, luua ja avastada ning oled valmis ka pingelisemates olukordades rahulikuks jääma, siis võib see töökoht olla just Sulle!

jobs.title: Service Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Service engineer for our client.

Your Role and Responsibilities:
As a Service Engineer, based in the Helsinki or Turku area, you will be responsible for commissioning, maintaining and servicing electric propulsion systems for marine applications. You will execute service work according to work instructions and in accordance with standard processes, quality requirements and safety guidelines.

You will work closely with customers and internal engineering and service teams, acting as the technical point of contact while ensuring high-quality service and customer satisfaction.

The position involves approximately 150 days of mostly international travel per year, as you will provide practical technical support at customer sites around the world. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work with advanced marine technology, develop your technical expertise and gain international experience in a highly customer-oriented industry.

You will be mainly accountable for:
 Commissioning and maintaining electric propulsion systems
 Supervising installations, startup, testing and commissioning in cooperation with customers
 Performing service and warranty work on operating vessels
 Installing and commissioning equipment and identifying and analysing technical problems through remote and on-site activities
 Performing various service tasks, including installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions and equipment replacements
 Consulting and advising customers on suitable service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures and safety guidelines
 Building and maintaining strong customer relationships and providing specialist technical assistance
 Diagnosing equipment failures and recommending corrective actions to prevent recurring problems
 Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and working methods

Qualifications for the Role:
 B.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, automation, marine engineering or another relevant field
 Ability and willingness to perform mechanical service work when required
 Previous practical experience in commissioning relevant products or systems is an advantage
 Willingness and ability to travel internationally extensively, up to approximately 150 days per year
 Experience in shipbuilding, marine systems or industrial equipment is an advantage
 Experience with electrical propulsion systems is considered an advantage
 Collaborative and solution-oriented approach
 Good Finnish and English language skills, as the role involves regular interaction with customers and internal teams
 Additional language skills are an advantage
 Good knowledge of MS Office
 Ability to work independently as well as effectively as part of a team
 Strong customer service and communication skills

More about the company:
Our client operates in the marine technology sector and develops advanced electric, automated and digital solutions for vessels and maritime operations. The company is committed to supporting the transition towards more sustainable and energy-efficient marine transportation.

You will join an international and dynamic working environment where advanced technology is delivered through large-scale projects around the world. The role offers the opportunity to work in a highly globalized, customer-oriented industry and develop your expertise through challenging international assignments.

The company values collaboration, continuous learning, customer focus and innovation, and offers a range of professional development and employee wellbeing benefits.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have previous hands-on experience with commissioning electrical, automation, propulsion, or other industrial systems?*
- Are you comfortable troubleshooting and diagnosing technical faults independently at customer sites? *
- Do you have previous experience working with marine, shipbuilding, vessel, or other offshore/industrial equipment? *
- Are you willing and able to travel internationally for approximately 150 days per year? *

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested we recommend that you apply immediately.

Allocation: 100 %
Assignment start date: as soon as a suitable candidate is identified
Assignment length: Possibly a longer contract, one year to begin with.
Location: Helsinki or Raisio, Finland
Language: Fluent in English and Finnish, both written and spoken

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

jobs.title: Data Products & Services Manager
jobs.description:
For this position we are looking for an individual who has a background within traceability & data transactions and is passionate to set the foundation and help drive our digitalization Journey within the Aftermarket, Service & Quality organization, part of the Business Unit Europe.

Typical areas of responsibility are to support both internal and external customers in problems related to product individual data from factories & suppliers.

You will be troubleshooting data issues that might occur related to individual product serial numbers, wrong master data and other things that may interfere with the data submission.

Help to track data quality issues and even coordinate with factories or suppliers the solution.

In this role one would also be working together with the Global operations team and the Global Information Systems organization.

You would be supporting the team responsible for implementing projects like Digital Product Passport and Husqvarna Serial Number roll out.

Your future challenge

This new role is positioned in the Digital Infrastructure team, belonging to Digital Data Solutions, where the role will be working together with our traceability analyst and reporting to the Global Traceability manager.

This person works in close cooperation with the Digital Product, Operational Excellence, Aftermarket & Services team, Data Management team, Operations team as well as with suppliers.

Tasks

• Resolve support tickets related to product individual identification.

• Collaborate with the Global Traceability Manager to develop and maintain data collection and reporting systems.

• Drive analytics of individual product data deliveries from suppliers, change management/project leading skill (to drive implementation and changes of integrations against suppliers as well educating internal users).

• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity by conducting regular audits and reconciliations.

• Provide administrative support, including managing documentation, scheduling meetings, and coordinating communication.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address data-related challenges and optimize traceability processes.

• Do/support error analysis of data and drive needed actions for stable data deliveries.

• Follow up / establish KPI on performance of deliveries.

• Analyze data related to product individual identification and identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

Required skills

• University Computer Engineering degree, Supply Chain Management or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience in data analysis, preferably in manufacturing companies.

• Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and Microsoft Excel.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

• Knowledge of APIs (REST, JSON) and system integrations is a plus.

• Knowledge of traceability systems and manufacturing execution systems best practices is a plus.

• You are fluent in English (preferably also additional languages – Swedish is a plus).

• Be able to work in a multi-cultural context both internally and externally and since all is carried out in an international context.

jobs.title: Manager salle de loisirs (H/F)
jobs.description:
Rejoignez l'aventure d'un nouveau centre La Tête Dans Les Nuages à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91)
Bienvenue chez La Tête Dans Les Nuages !

Depuis plus de 25 ans, La Tête Dans Les Nuages fait vivre à ses visiteurs des expériences de loisirs uniques et immersives.
Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

Dans le cadre de l'ouverture prochaine de notre nouveau site à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91), nous recherchons notre futur(e) Manager Loisirs.

Vous aimez le terrain, le management de proximité et le contact client ? Vous souhaitez participer à une ouverture de site et contribuer à sa réussite dès les premiers jours ? Alors rejoignez-nous !

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) au Directeur de Site, vous êtes un acteur clé de l'exploitation quotidienne du centre.
Véritable relais managérial sur le terrain, vous accompagnez les équipes et veillez à offrir à chaque visiteur une expérience mémorable.

- Manager et accompagner les équipes
- Participer au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.
- Former, accompagner et animer les équipes au quotidien.
- Garantir la bonne application des procédures et des standards de qualité.
- Fédérer les équipes autour de la satisfaction client et de l'esprit de service.
- Assurer le bon déroulement de l'activité durant votre présence.
- Garantir une expérience client exceptionnelle
- Accueillir et accompagner les visiteurs.
- Conseiller les clients sur les différentes offres du centre.
- Accompagner l'organisation des anniversaires, événements privés et séminaires.
- Veiller à la satisfaction des clients tout au long de leur visite.
- Gérer les éventuelles réclamations avec professionnalisme et réactivité.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement du site
- Superviser les opérations d'ouverture et de fermeture du centre.
- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et des procédures internes.
- Contrôler la bonne tenue des espaces de loisirs et d'accueil.
- Participer à la gestion des stocks et des approvisionnements.
- Garantir la disponibilité et la qualité des prestations proposées.
- Être un véritable ambassadeur de La Tête Dans Les Nuages
- Partager votre enthousiasme avec les équipes et les visiteurs.
- Contribuer à créer une ambiance conviviale et dynamique.
- Participer activement à la réussite commerciale du site.

Votre profil
Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +2 minimum ou disposez d'une expérience équivalente.
Vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie en management de proximité, idéalement dans l'un des secteurs suivants :
Loisirs, Restauration, Commerce / Retail, Hôtellerie, Evénementiel, Distribution.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
Votre excellent relationnel, votre sens du service client, votre leadership naturel, votre dynamisme et votre esprit d'équipe, votre capacité à gérer les priorités et à prendre des initiatives, votre goût pour le terrain et l'opérationnel.

Vous appréciez les environnements dynamiques où aucune journée ne ressemble à une autre.

Conditions du poste

Travail selon planning variable.
Présence requise les week-ends, jours fériés et certaines soirées selon l'activité du site.
Deux jours de repos consécutifs en semaine.
Horaires aménagés dans le respect de la réglementation du travail.
Les avantages
Tickets restaurant après 2 mois d'ancienneté.
Mutuelle d'entreprise.
Prise en charge des transports en commun à hauteur de 50 %.
Intégration au sein d'un groupe leader du loisir indoor.
Participation à l'ouverture d'un nouveau site ambitieux.

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future.   • Passion for designing ads, you love design and creative work

  • Work experience in paid social or with performance marketing campaigns

  • Fast learner, hard-working, and stress-resistant

  • Curious and excited about AI rather than afraid of it

jobs.title: Site Manager
jobs.description:
Aquatech is a global leader in water purification systems technology for both industrial and infrastructure markets located in the United States and internationally. We support our clients with sustainable water purification systems and technologies that are solving the world's water scarcity challenges.

Aquatech has an immediate need for a full-time Site Manager in Boden, Sweden. The Site Manager will report to the Director of Projects and will perform the duties described in the job description below.

    Oversee, manage, and direct construction from beginning to end.
    Work very closely and coordinate with the Project Manager.
    Create and manage the overall Site Construction Schedule.
    The Site Construction Manager shall be experienced in the same or substantially similar responsibilities on projects similar in size, type, and complexity to the Work and the Facility.
    Extensive industry experience as a construction manager within their area, where we see that the candidate has extensive hands-on project leadership experience in a demanding industrial environment.
    Engaging and effective leadership capability that creates forward momentum and influence across multiple disciplines and functions.
    Highly execution oriented and biased towards decision-making. Knocks down barriers and gets it done.
    Focused on problem solving and first principles orientation - challenge all stakeholders on both requirements and outputs. Proven effective technical competence.
    Ability to work under high pressure and tight deadlines, excellent time management skills.
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to work well with others in a team environment, as well as strong coordination.
    Create and issue 3-week lookahead schedules every week
    Manage, plan, organize, implement, and control all construction activities of the project per the Project Schedule
    Track inventory regularly
    Be the primary contact on site for construction & liaison with head office on issues relating to the project progress
    Create contractual documents for the execution of claims-free sub-contracts for site works
    Ensure the project is constructed according to design, budget, and schedule
    Plan to prevent problems and mitigate emerging ones.
    Establish risk profile for project(s) and proactively manage mitigation plans, dealing dynamically with unexpected outcomes to ensure project(s) success
    Ensure that company policies, procedures, standards, etc., are followed
    Site subcontractor management & implementation of HSE (Health, Safety & Environment)
    Ensure site progress as per schedule. If there are delays, initiate the necessary actions like allocating extra resources or alternative work processes to ensure the schedule is back on track
    Report progress to the project manager
    Provide a daily & monthly progress report & update the schedule for submission to the customer
    Discuss with the project team and propose/resolve customer and site-related issues
    Work with the site subcontractor to the standards at the site and maintain alignment with the customer
    Attend customer meetings, contractor meetings, and provide direction
    Ensure timely disposition of the site contractor queries
    Identify and mitigate risks that may have an impact on the project
    Inform the project manager of issues that may affect project profit, costs, schedules, and client relations
    Ensure maintenance of daily records of all site activities, including information on labor and plant, and any non-compliant materials or workmanship
    Monitor project cost and provide the Project Manager with timely identification of deviations from the budget
    Evaluate the change orders/scope change requests of the subcontractor & provide inputs to the project manage
    In case of any accidents, damages, or emergencies at the site, ensure that the proper protocol & procedure

Essential Functions:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above and below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Physical Job Demands:

Lifting/carrying/moving 50 lbs; may need to climb ladders; cannot be afraid of heights; and will need to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while on site. Involves sitting at a desk for extended periods. Needs a high degree of concentration in a busy area.

About the role

In this role, you will get the opportunity to develop mechanical components and assemblies while adapting existing designs to specific customer orders. The work perfectly combines practical design tasks with cross-functional collaboration across engineering, production, and supplier teams. You will be supported by experienced colleagues, making this a fantastic environment to grow your expertise in mechanical engineering and manufacturing documentation.

In this role, you will be employed in a 12-month fixed-term contract with our client company, working as an embedded consultant for an in-house product company.

What our client can offer to you:
- Salary: 2500–3500 €/month, depending on your background and current skill level.

- A collaborative environment: You will work closely with different departments, ensuring you gain a broad understanding of industrial engineering.

Work tasks

Your daily tasks will revolve around 3D modeling and creating precise manufacturing documentation for customized orders. You will ensure that technical specifications are met and that production has the correct information to build the components.

- Adapting established product designs to order-specific requirements.

jobs.title: Prentari / Printer
jobs.description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Um Prentmet Odda:

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. Félagið vinnur jafnframt með mörgum af öflugustu umbúðaframleiðendum Evrópu til að veita fyrirtækjum heildarlausnir á sviði umbúða. Prentmet Oddi þjónustar meginþorra af kröfuhörðustu fyrirtækjum landsins og hefur gert það í áratugi með hraða, gæði og persónulega þjónustu að leiðarljósi.

Áhugasamir umsækjendur eru hvattir til að sækja um starf á:

🔹 https://alfred.is/starf/prentari-oskast-6

eða

🔹 https://www.prentmetoddi.is/prentmet-oddi/atvinnuumsokn

Nánari upplýsingar má einnig fá með því að senda fyrirspurn á isi@prentmetoddi.is.

Við leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur metnað fyrir gæðum, tæknilega færni og áhuga á að taka þátt í framleiðslu á fyrsta flokks prentverkefnum.
Umsóknarfrestur er til og með 12 september 2026

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Prentmet Oddi is seeking a responsible, detail-oriented, and motivated Offset Printer to join our production team.
This is a varied and challenging position within a dynamic manufacturing environment where quality, service, and professionalism are key priorities.

Key Responsibilities:
Operate and oversee offset printing presses.
Inspect and compare proof sheets and printed sheets to ensure production quality.
Perform routine machine maintenance and maintain maintenance records.
Provide guidance and answer questions regarding printing processes and technical matters.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
Carry out other related duties as required.

Qualifications:
Experience in offset printing or a similar production environment is an advantage.
Strong technical aptitude and ability to work independently.
Excellent attention to detail and organized work practices.
Positive attitude and strong teamwork skills.
Commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Salary will be based on the applicant's experience, knowledge, and qualifications.
Employment terms are governed by the collective agreement of Grafía (The Icelandic Printing and Media Union).

jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

  • Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

  • Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

  • Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

  • Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

  • Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

  • Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

  • Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

  • Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

  • Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

  • Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

  • You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

  • You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

  • AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

  • You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

  • A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

  • Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

  • Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

  • 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

  • Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

  • Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

  • DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

3. Who we're looking for

A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

Must-have

  • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

  • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

  • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

  • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

  • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

  • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

  • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

  • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

  • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

Nice-to-have

  • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

  • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

  • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

  • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

  • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

  • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

  • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

  • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

  • IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).

4. What we offer

  • A seat inside a serious, very senior network team, with people who have deep service provider backgrounds and will sharpen you fast. You will see how a real carrier network behaves under live conditions.

  • A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.

  • Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.

  • Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Indexing

About us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale.

Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks

  • Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure

  • Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features

  • Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines

  • Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs

  • Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability

  • Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment

  • Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load

  • Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet

  • Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)

  • Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on.

Who we're looking for

Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow.

Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism.

Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming.

 

What you'll do

Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of:

  • Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD.

  • Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems.

  • ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software.

  • Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale.

 

What you'll bring

We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience.

You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include:

  • strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements)

  • startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them)

  • FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms)

 

What we value

We value engineers who think deeply about systems, care about correctness, and take pride in building infrastructure that is understandable, maintainable, and reliable.

Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe.

 
 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.title: Personal Trainer
jobs.description:
**Etsimme kahta(2) Personal Traineria – Ole.Fit Turenki**

**Onko liikunta sinulle elämäntapa?**

Pidät ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja haluat valmentaa ympäristössä, jossa hyvinvointi syntyy yhdessä tekemisestä? Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa jotain uutta alusta asti?

Ole.Fit Turenki etsii Personal Traineria osaksi uudistuvaa kuntokeskusta ja kasvavaa valmennustiimiä.

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan uutta Ole.Fit Turenkia**

Uudistuneen keskuksen avajaisia vietettiin alkusyksystä, joten nyt sinulla on ainutlaatuinen mahdollisuus hypätä mukaan rakentamaan uudenlaista valmennuskulttuuria heti alusta lähtien.

Ole.Fit Turenki ei ole pelkkä kuntosali – vaan **kylän olohuoneen**, jossa asiakkaat viihtyvät, liikkuvat yhdessä ja kokevat kuuluvansa yhteisöön.

**Mikä tekee Ole.Fit Turengista erityisen?**

Keskuksessa on noin **500 m² monipuolinen kuntosali**, joka soveltuu niin tavoitteelliseen voimaharjoitteluun, toiminnalliseen harjoitteluun kuin kuntouttavaankin liikuntaan. Lisäksi keskuksessa järjestetään monipuolista ryhmäliikuntaa, mikä luo aktiivisen ja innostavan ympäristön myös Personal Trainerin asiakashankintaan.

Saat ympärillesi kokeneen henkilöstön, joka tukee sinua arjessa, jakaa osaamistaan ja auttaa onnistumaan. Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa yhdessä tekeminen, avoimuus ja asiakkaiden hyvinvointi ovat kaiken toiminnan keskiössä.

Valmennustoiminta on meillä organisoitua. Käytössäsi on toimiva PT-toimintamalli, joka tukee valmentajan arkea, myyntiä ja asiakassuhteiden rakentamista – kuitenkaan rajoittamatta omaa asiakaslähtöistä valmennustyyliäsi.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa täysin uudistuvaa Ole.Fit-keskusta.

- Noin 500 m² monipuolisen ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän treeniympäristön.

- Ryhmäliikunnan tuoman aktiivisen asiakasvirran.

- Kokeneen ja helposti lähestyttävän henkilöstön tuen.

- Yhteisöllisen työympäristön, jossa valmentajaa arvostetaan.

- Selkeän ja toimivan PT-toimintamallin, joka tukee asiakashankintaa, myyntiä ja arjen tekemistä.

- Ole.Fit-ketjun toimintamallit, markkinoinnin ja valtakunnallisen tuen.

- Mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäaikainen ja kannattava valmennusliiketoiminta.


**Kenelle paikka sopii?**

Etsimme kahta Personal Traineria, joka haluavat sitoutua keskuksen kehittämiseen ja rakentaa omaa asiakaskuntaansa osana kasvavaa Ole.Fit Turenkia.

Toivomme, että:

- olet koulutettu Personal Trainer tai liikunta-alan ammattilainen (tai koulutuksesi on loppusuoralla, ei pelkästään verkko-opintoina suoritettu)

- haluat työskennellä 3–5 päivänä viikossa ja olet valmis työskentelemään myös asiakkaiden suosituimpina aikoina klo 16–20

- toimit itseohjautuvasti ja kannat vastuuta omasta työstäsi

- olet yrittäjähenkinen ja ymmärrät valmennuksen liiketoimintana

- haluat kehittää keskusta yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa

- olet helposti lähestyttävä ja kohtaat asiakkaat aidosti

- osaat rakentaa yksilöllisiä ja tuloksellisia valmennuskokonaisuuksia

- toimit kevytyrittäjänä, toiminimellä tai muulla yritysmuodolla

- hallitset sujuvasti suomen kielen.


**Mitä työ mahdollistaa?**

Vakiintuneella asiakaskunnalla valmentajan laskutus on tyypillisesti noin **2 000–4 000 € / kk (alv 0 %)**.

Saat käyttöösi toimivat työkalut, modernisoituvan keskuksen, aktiivisen jäsenyhteisön sekä ympärillesi tiimin, jonka tavoitteena on auttaa niin asiakkaita kuin valmentajiakin onnistumaan.

**Tämä voi olla urasi seuraava askel**

Jos haluat olla mukana rakentamassa Turengin liikuntakulttuurin uutta kohtaamispaikkaa ja tehdä valmennustyötä, jolla on aidosti merkitystä, haluamme kuulla sinusta.

**Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si osoitteeseen:** laura.nurminen@ole.fit

Rakennetaan yhdessä Ole.Fit Turengista paikka, jossa jokainen tuntee olevansa tervetullut – kuntokeskus, joka on koko kylän olohuone.

jobs.title: Psychiatr / psychiatrička - Pelhřimov (CDZ + psychiatrická ambulance), Lékaři v psychiatrických oborech
jobs.description:
O nás
Jsme FOKUS Vysočina, nezisková organizace, která poskytuje péči a podporu lidem s duševním onemocněním nebo mentálním postižením.
Jsme oporou a zdrojem pomoci tam, kde je to potřeba.
Jsme tady pro jednotlivce, rodiny a komunity, které hledají podporu a porozumění v oblasti duševního zdraví a postižení.
Uživatele služeb podporujeme na jejich cestě k zotavení. Naše služby vytváříme
dle současných trendů a aktivně se podílíme na změně systému péče o duševní zdraví v ČR.

Jedna z mála příležitostí v regionu dělat psychiatrii napříč ambulancí i komunitní péčí.

Chcete dělat psychiatrii, která má skutečný dopad?
Nejen předepisovat, ale rozumět lidem v kontextu jejich života?

V Pelhřimově nabízíme možnost pracovat napříč psychiatrickou ambulancí a Centrem duševního zdraví – a nastavit si práci podle sebe.

Proč k nám?
Protože u nás nebudete „jen ordinovat“.
Budete součástí služby, která pomáhá lidem zvládat duševní onemocnění v jejich skutečném životě – ne jen mezi čtyřmi stěnami.

Co je u nás jinak
- kombinujete ambulanci a terén (podle toho, co vám dává smysl)
- pracujete v multidisciplinárním týmu, který táhne za jeden provaz
- máte možnost vidět reálný dopad péče v životě klientů
- nejste na to sami – úzká spolupráce se zkušenou psychiatričkou

Koho hledáme:

jobs.title: Chovatelé a ošetřovatelé skotu, koz a ovcí, Chovatelé a ošetřovatelé skotu, koz a ovcí
OBSLUHA BISTRA, Obsluha v zařízeních rychlého občerstvení
jobs.description:
Do našeho týmu hledáme nové parťáky/parťačky na pozici obsluhy bistra v našem novém The Fifties Bistro u čerpací stanice ONO na Vysokově. Pokud máte rádi živé prostředí, komunikaci s lidmi a chcete přispět k příjemné atmosféře autentického amerického bistra, pak jste tím pravým člověkem do našeho týmu.

Jak bude vypadat Váš den?
Vaším úkolem bude obsluhovat naše hosty a svým přátelským přístupem zajistit, že se k nám budou rádi vracet. S námi se rozhodně nebudete nudit - čeká Vás výdej občerstvení, obsluha baru nebo třeba příprava kávy. Pracujeme sice v rychlém tempu, ale vše má jednoduchá pravidla, díky kterým je obsluha našich hostů hračka. Nemusíte mít vzdělání nebo zkušenosti v oboru, mnohem víc nás zajímá Vaše energie a chuť do práce. Vše ostatní Vás rádi naučíme.

Bez čeho se u nás neobejdete?
Dochvilnost a poctivost jsou u nás základem úspěchu. Důslednost při udržování čistoty a pořádku na pracovišti bereme jako samozřejmost. Výhodou je schopnost samostatně a rychle se rozhodovat, zároveň však očekáváme týmového ducha.

Co naopak můžete očekávat od nás?
Ke každému členovi našeho týmu přistupujeme individuálně, proto je organizace směn vždy na vzájemné dohodě. Můžete si vybrat ranní, odpolední nebo celodenní směny, a to jak na pracovní poměr, tak na dohodu o provedení práce. Kromě pravidelného nadstandardního platového ohodnocení nabízíme také možnost kariérního růstu v rámci The Fifties podniků.

Kolem Fifties se pohybuje spousta skvělých lidí a rádi Vás přibereme do party. Pokud Vás naše nabídka zaujala a chcete se k nám přidat, neváhejte nám napsat na e-mail: manager@fifties.cz

Zajišťování bezpečného, spolehlivého a efektivního provozu strojů prostřednictvím komplexního řízení jejich využití, údržby a modernizace.
1.Plánovat, rozvíjet a realizovat autonomní a preventivní údržbové činnosti s cílem zajistit nepřetržitou provozní spolehlivost strojů, minimalizovat prostoje a podpořit optimální výrobní výkon.Komunikace s dodavateli a zajištění nabídky, nebo nabídek pro výběrové řízení.
2.Samostatně diagnostikovat, řešit a odstraňovat poruchy strojů, včetně složitých technických problémů.
3.Analyzovat provozní data související s výkonem strojů za účelem identifikace odchylek a optimalizace procesů údržby a provozu.
4.Sdílet odborné znalosti a poskytovat praktické školení, podporovat rozvoj dovedností při řešení poruch.
5.Poskytovat poradenství při nastavování parametrů strojů a jejich optimalizaci s cílem zvýšit efektivitu, snížit ztrátové časy a zlepšit kvalitu výrobků.

8.Provádět zkoušky a testy nastavení strojů, nových nástrojů a komponent s cílem optimalizovat provozní parametry, zajistit splnění technologických požadavků a podpořit zavádění nových výrobních řešení.

11.Dodržovat zásady správné výrobní praxe, udržovat pracoviště podle standardů 5S a principů neustálého zlepšování.

13.Používat vždy vhodné ochranné pracovní pomůcky (OOP).

Provádět, zajišťovat a sledovat všechny předpisy, pravidla, postupy a politiky v oblasti bezpečnosti a ochrany zdraví při práci.

jobs.title: rozpočtář elektro-slaboproud/silnoproud M/Ž, Odborní pracovníci kalkulací, cen, nákladů a rozpočtů
jobs.description:
Do našeho týmu hledáme zkušeného kolegu/kolegyni na pozici Rozpočtář elektro, který se bude podílet na přípravě cenových nabídek a rozpočtů elektro zakázek. Zaměřujeme se především na slaboproudé systémy (EPS, EZS, CCTV, SKS, přístupové systémy, Wi-Fi, optické sítě a další technologie), přičemž znalost silnoproudých elektroinstalací je velkou výhodou.
Náplní práce je zpracování cenových nabídek a rozpočtů elektro zakázek, studium projektové dokumentace a technických výkresů, tvorba výkazů výměr, poptávání materiálu a subdodavatelů, komunikace se zákazníky, projektanty a dodavateli, technická podpora obchodního oddělení a spolupráce při přípravě realizace zakázek. Součástí práce je také hledání technicky i ekonomicky vhodných řešení pro jednotlivé projekty.
Požadujeme SŠ nebo VŠ vzdělání elektrotechnického směru, prokazatelné zkušenosti s tvorbou rozpočtů elektro zakázek, praxi v oblasti slaboproudých systémů (EPS, EZS, CCTV, SKS, přístupové systémy, Wi-Fi apod.), schopnost samostatně číst projektovou dokumentaci a zpracovat cenovou nabídku, orientaci v technických normách a používaných technologiích, samostatnost, pečlivost, zodpovědný přístup, dobré komunikační schopnosti a řidičský průkaz skupiny B.
Výhodou je znalost silnoproudých elektroinstalací, zkušenosti s oceňováním silnoproudých i slaboproudých zakázek, orientace v moderních elektroinstalačních technologiích, zkušenosti s výběrem materiálu a komunikací s dodavateli, znalost rozpočtových programů, platné oprávnění dle NV 194/2022 Sb. a zkušenosti s přípravou nebo řízením elektro projektů.
Pružná pracovní doba, možnost práce z domova, notebook a mobilní telefon, motivační finanční odměny, možnost profesního růstu a dalšího vzdělávání.
Kontakt na tel, na mail, osobně po tel. domluvě.

Jsme rodinná firma s více než 30letou tradicí. Ve třech provozovnách – Velké Meziříčí, Jihlava a Znojmo – se staráme o vozy značek Škoda, Opel, MG a LEAPmotor. Nabízíme stabilní práci, férové jednání a přátelské prostředí, kde se každý může dál rozvíjet.

jobs.title: Dansk job i Málaga - Hvad hvis dit job var at få flere mennesker ud til koncerter, festivaler og oplevelser?
jobs.description:
Vi leder efter en dansk kollega til vores nordiske team i Málaga med opstart den senest den 1. november. Du bliver specialisten i en international virksomhed, hvor din opgave er at åbne døren til nye kunder i Danmark og booke møder til vores salgsteam.

Vi er en international tech- og eventvirksomhed i vækst, der hjælper arrangører med at sælge billetter og nå ud til nyt publikum. Hver dag går vores platform i gang med at sælge billetter til alt fra små uafhængige events til store festivaler. Og det er dig, der åbner døren til de arrangører, der får det til at ske.

Du kontakter eventarrangører i Danmark og booker de møder, som bliver til nye kunder og. Det er ikke et callcenterjob med manuskript. Du får din plads på vores nye, moderne kontor i det centrale Málaga, hvor du sidder side om side med kolleger fra marketing, salg, admin, HR og andre specialistfunktioner. Organisationen er flad, og vejene er korte.  Miljøet er det samme, som hvis du arbejdede på et kontor i Danmark: professionelt, uformelt og præget af høj faglighed.

Kontoret er nyt og moderne, med samme miljø som på et dansk kontor: gamingrum, massagerum, gratis frokost og et modent arbejdsmiljø, hvor tillid og ansvar er en selvfølge. Kort sagt: fast kontrakt, fair løn, sol udenfor og en hverdag med reel indflydelse på, at virksomheden vokser.

Det her er chancen for at kombinere en fast stilling og en fair løn med en hverdag i solen, i en virksomhed der er i vækst.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Opsøgende kontakt til eventarrangører i Danmark

  • Booking af møder til salgsteamet

  • Opbygning af gode dialoger og relationer med nye kontakter

  • Tæt sparring med salgsteamet for at sikre størst mulig værdi i møderne

Din hverdag:

Du arbejder med outbound og har mange samtaler med nye mennesker. Du planlægger selv din dag og dine rutiner og har ansvaret for at skabe resultater. Du sidder tæt på dine kolleger i salg og marketing og har direkte dialog med dem, der overtager de møder, du booker.

Hvem er du?

  • Du taler og skriver dansk

  • Du har minimum 1 års erfaring med outbound‑samtaler

  • Du er god til at skabe dialog og trives med kontakt til nye mennesker

  • Du er positiv, struktureret og vedholdende

  • Du er en stærk holdspiller

  • Du kan arbejde fast fra kontoret i Málaga

  • Du søger en stabil stilling – ikke et sabbatårsjob

Du behøver ikke mange års erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og et højt drive.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Human-Centred Design for AI Companionship and Care in Ageing Societies
jobs.employer: NTNU FAKULTET FOR ARKITEKTUR OG DESIGN
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Design at NTNU invites applications for a fully funded PhD position within the Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) Lab at NTNU Gjøvik. The position offers an opportunity to conduct mixed method research, applying human-centred design methods and Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) perspectives to investigate how AI companionship technologies may reshape experiences of care, companionship, emotional support, wellbeing, and autonomy among older adults.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Many countries are experiencing demographic changes associated with ageing populations, increasing pressure on healthcare systems and growing concerns regarding social isolation and loneliness among older adults. A large body of research shows that this, in turn, can pose severe risks to their physical and mental health, eroding community social resilience and impacting quality of life – as well as longevity in general. 

At the same time, advances in AI have led to the development of conversational agents, AI companions, and socially assistive technologies designed to provide social and emotional support while removing barriers like accessibility and stigma. Within this context, the PhD candidate will contribute to developing conceptual and functional prototypes that explore alternative futures for AI companionship and care using action-oriented, empathy-driven, and inclusive design methods. 


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Research on why and how AI companionship can address challenges of ageing population
  • Engage in developing, testing, and evaluating prototypes in-house as well as with external stakeholders
  • Take part in both scientific and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the HCAI Lab and relevant research networks
  • Be involved in international activities, such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Teaching
  • Other career-promoting work 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a master's degree in design or a related field
  • You must have a strong interest in human-centred AI and the societal implications of AI technologies
  • You must have experience with building prototypes
  • You must have experience with qualitative methods and/or mixed methods
  • Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at the master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 15th of July 2027.
  • You must have an average grade from your master's degree studies, or equivalent education, which is equal to a B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme
  • You must have good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2, as well as excellent written and oral communication skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience conducting user-oriented studies, such as interviews, workshops, or co-design activities
  • Knowledge of accessibility, universal and inclusive design, ageing, wellbeing, healthcare technologies, or welfare technologies
  • Dissemination of research in relevant venues

Personal characteristics

We seek a PhD candidate who is:

  • Curious, open-minded, and motivated to explore innovative HCAI solutions
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively
  • Interested in combining theory, research, and design practice
  • Enthusiastic about connecting with people and engaging with real-world societal challenges
  • Willing to contribute to a positive work atmosphere

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work 12 months of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in [subject area] (link to possible website)within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. (decide on this - remove if not applicable)

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Cover letter describing motivation for the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Copies of academic transcripts and diplomas
  • Master's thesis (or equivalent major research project)
  • Publications and other scholarly work (if applicable)
  • Portfolio demonstrating design, prototyping, or research work (if applicable)
  • Research Vision Statement (maximum two pages, excluding references)
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Anne Britt Torkildsby, +47 90193130, anne.torkildsby@ntnu.no, Associate Professor Yavuz Inal, +47 41301855,  yavuz.inal@ntnu.no or Postdoctoral Fellow Sujay Shalawadi, sujay.shalawadi@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 26.10.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

Gjøvik, a charming town by the shores of Lake Mjøsa, is known for its beautiful nature and rich cultural offerings. The town boasts a vibrant community with excellent schools, modern healthcare services, and a variety of recreational activities. With its strategic location, just a short drive from Oslo, Gjøvik combines the best of urban life and natural experiences. Here, you'll find a dynamic business environment and exciting career opportunities in a setting that values work-life balance. 

 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Design

We are located in both Trondheim (industrial design) and Gjøvik (graphic design and web technology). Both groups have expertise in interaction design and share research interests in health and welfare technology. The design environment links many technology communities at NTNU, and nationally the Department has extensive collaboration with Norwegian industrial companies. The Department of Design is one of four departments in the Faculty of Architecture and Design.

jobs.description:
**Haemme kokenutta autonasentajaa Joensuuhun**

**Onko vianhaku ja diagnostiikka sinun vahvuutesi?** Etsimme korjaamollemme asentajaa, joka pystyy selvittämään autojen ongelmia itsenäisesti ja tekemään laadukasta korjaustyötä.

Olemme Joensuussa toimiva Bosch Car Service monimerkkikorjaamo. Huollamme ja korjaamme bensiini-, diesel-, hybridi- ja sähköautoja. Työhösi kuuluu henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustöitä sekä vianhakua ja diagnostiikkaa. Saat eteesi myös tilanteita, joissa vikakoodi ei yksin kerro, mikä autossa on vialla. Osaat suunnitella tutkimisen, tehdä tarvittavat mittaukset ja edetä havaintojen perusteella kohti ratkaisua.

**Odotamme sinulta:**

- kokemusta eri automerkkien huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- kykyä tehdä vianhakua ja diagnostiikkaa itsenäisesti

- sähköisten järjestelmien ja diagnostiikkalaitteiden hyvää tuntemusta

- huolellista, järjestelmällistä ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa

- halua tehdä työsi hyvin ja palvella asiakkaita asiallisesti.


Bosch-laitteiden tuntemus on eduksi. Arvostamme alan koulutusta, mutta meille tärkeintä on käytännön osaamisesi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn**, nykyaikaisen korjaamoympäristön sekä osaavan työyhteisön tuen. Pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi tekniikan mukana ja osallistumaan esimerkiksi Boschin autotekniikan koulutuksiin.

Hyvästä osaamisesta maksetaan sen mukaisesti. Sovimme palkasta kokemuksesi ja taitojesi perusteella, ja olemme valmiita maksamaan hyvin asentajalle, joka hallitsee itsenäisen vianhaun ja diagnostiikan. Tarjoamme lisäksi kattavan työterveyshuollon, vapaa-ajan vakuutukset sekä kulttuuri- ja liikuntaedun. Järjestämme myös yhteisiä tapahtumia, ja korjaamoa voi käyttää iltaisin oman auton huoltoon ja korjaamiseen.

**Kiinnostuitko?** Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ja CV osoitteeseen **huolto@auto-france.fi**. Kerro erityisesti, millaisista vianhaku- ja diagnostiikkatöistä sinulla on kokemusta. Kirjoita viestin otsikoksi **Ajoneuvoasentaja**. Käsittelemme hakemuksia niiden saapuessa.
