jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: Elektroinstallateur / Servicemonteur (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sie haben genug von Grossbaustellen und suchen mehr Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag? Unser Kunde, ein etabliertes Schweizer Elektro-Installationsunternehmen, sucht eine selbstständige und freundliche Persönlichkeit als Elektroinstallateur/in und Servicemonteur/in. Sie sind bei Privat-, Gewerbe- und Industriekunden im Einsatz und arbeiten an spannenden Kleinprojekten. Auch Lehrabgängerinnen und Lehrabgänger sind herzlich willkommen und werden sorgfältig eingearbeitet.

**Elektroinstallateur / Servicemonteur (m/w/d)**

**Ihre Aufgaben:**
- Service und Unterhalt: Sie führen selbstständig Servicearbeiten bei Privat-, Gewerbe- und Industriekunden aus.
- Kleinprojekte: Sie realisieren Erweiterungen und Neuinstallationen im Wohn- und Gewerbebau.
- Fehlerbehebung: Sie stellen rasch Diagnosen und beheben Störungen zuverlässig.
- Zukunftstechnik: Sie schliessen Geräte, E-Ladestationen und Smart-Home-Komponenten fachgerecht an.
- Kundenkontakt: Sie sind das Gesicht des Betriebs vor Ort und beraten Kundinnen und Kunden kompetent und freundlich.

**Ihre Qualifikationen:**
- Abgeschlossene Lehre als Elektroinstallateur/in EFZ oder Montage-Elektriker/in EFZ (Berufseinsteiger/innen frisch ab Lehre sind willkommen)
- Exakte, zuverlässige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
- Gepflegte Umgangsformen und ein sicheres Auftreten beim Kunden
- Führerausweis Kat. B (zwingend für das Servicefahrzeug)
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

**Wir bieten Ihnen:**
- Flexibles Pensum: 60–100% frei wählbar, passend zu Ihrer Lebenssituation
- Top-Ausrüstung: Modernes Servicefahrzeug, hochwertiges Werkzeug und digitale Tools (Tablet/Smartphone)
- Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen: Überzeugender Lohn, mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien und freie Ferienwahl (keine Betriebsferien)
- Weiterbildung: Volle Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, z. B. in den Bereichen E-Mobilität und Smart Home
- Starke Teamkultur: Motiviertes Team, flache Hierarchien und regelmässige Teamevents
- Sorgfältige Einarbeitung: Gezielte Begleitung beim Start, besonders für Lehrabgängerinnen und Lehrabgänger

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Additional languages

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.

  • Smooth operator: Be hands-on and actively support the operational team to make sure that every guest receives a Zoku-like experience. You'll jump in when and where needed without hesitation - you lead by example.

  • Above & Beyond: Find creative ways & opportunities to increase our financial results and revenue streams as well as team engagement and guest satisfaction.

  • Keep your admin in check: Whether it's our PMS, POS or SOP's, you stay on top of our systems and processes, and organize our data & suppliers efficiently. 

  • Guardian of our values: Uphold Zoku's brand standards and ensure that team is always up-to-date.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • A market conform salary package in accordance with experience and know-how.

  • Leadership training and coaching to support your professional growth and leadership development.

  • Cool benefits like a free after-work drink, various discounts and friends & family rates at all Zoku locations.

  • A fun, young, multi-national company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with. 

  • The best staff meals, enjoyed in our social spaces overlooking the city. 

  • Exciting (on the job) training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO

  • Bring good vibes to the work floor

  • Are genuinely friendly, approachable, and empathetic.

  • Show strong leadership skills and know how to empower and grow their team.

  • Can juggle many tasks at once while remaining cool-headed and warm-hearted.

  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit and never settle for less than amazing.

  • Have worked in an international workplace.

  • Have provable knowledge of maintaining a high standard of guest service and team engagement.


A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You speak fluent Danish and English.

  • You have a minimum of 3 years working experience leading operational teams in the Front Office and/or Food and Beverage department.

  • You’ve worked with PMS and POS software.

  • You are an EU-resident or have a valid Danish working permit.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days/hours.

  • You love to work as we'll need you full time.

jobs.title: Construction - Electrical Design Engineer - Senior Position
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The main duties and responsibilities of the Senior Electrical Design Engineer are outlined as follows: Ensure Health, Safety, Environmental, Sustainability & Quality standards, policies and procedures are developed into all designs and design outputs. Manage Electrical Department Design Engineers to ensure all design works meet the required quality standards, project schedules and budgets. Work collaboratively with other engineering disciplines in Process, Mechanical, Control & Automation, Civil and Structural to ensure an optimum design solution is reached. Liaise with the project teams to ensure that the Design works include the compilation and review of Site surveys and condition reports as required. M&I Listings. Electrical load balances, MIC load calculations. Medium Voltage design. Generator design and sizing for back-up applications. General electrical services design. Lighting and emergency lighting designs. Earthing and Lightning protection designs Cable sizing/cable schedules. Review I/O of listings. Review of control panel drawings schematics. Review of specialist reports on harmonics and selection of equipment to mitigate the harmonics. Solar PV generation and battery storage and renewable generators for small applications. Lead Design Risk Reviews ensuring that the design works meet all Health, Safety, Environmental, Sustainability & Quality standards Undertake site surveys and preliminary condition reports on existing infrastructure/assets. Procurement of packages for LV works such as Main Distribution Boards, MCC’s and control panels, automation hardware/software, starters, electrical installation works, earthing and lightning protection. Procurement packages for MV works such as distribution transformers, MV switchgear and specialist design services for MV works. Procure and manage 3rd party design consultants as required. For all procurement packages, provide a technical and commercial review of tender returns, ensuring tender returns align to the required standards and demonstrate value for money. Provide a recommendation to procurement. Provide a detailed and robust handover to site delivery teams including the close-out of any design comments or construction related queries. With the tendering team, team assist in the preparation and pricing of tender submissions for electrical works. Promote and advocate key themes from Glanua Business Strategy including a move to off-site manufacturing, improved digitalised ways of working and drive towards sustainability. Encourage use of innovative technology and ways of working within the team. Harness opportunities and mitigate risk through effective design and risk mitigation measures during the lifecycle of the design process. Ensure you are aware of local Asset Standards, Electrical Standards, WIMES, etc and embed requirements of same into respective designs. Keep appraised of the latest standards and technology through continuous professional development (CPD).

jobs.description:
Vi søger 10 medarbejdere til en større produktionsvirksomhed inden for betonelementer i Kolind.

Har du erfaring fra produktion, byggeri, beton eller andet praktisk arbejde – og trives du med fysisk arbejde, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er vigtigt? Så kan det være dig, vi søger.

Der er tale om Try & Hire med henblik på fastansættelse hos virksomheden efter endt periode.

Vi søger 8 produktionsmedarbejdere

Du bliver en del af produktionen af betonelementer og kommer bl.a. til at arbejde med:

  • Armering

  • Klargøring til støbning

  • Opbygning af træforskalling og støbeforme

  • Afformning og håndtering af betonelementer

  • Andre praktiske opgaver i produktionen

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra beton-, bygge- eller produktionsbranchen, men det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt og klar på at lære.

1 kranfører

Du kommer primært til at arbejde med intern transport og håndtering af større betonelementer – blandt andet udendørs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har gyldigt krancertifikat m. tilladelse til 52 ton.

  • Har erfaring med krankørsel, gerne fra industri eller produktion

  • Arbejder sikkert og ansvarsbevidst

  • Er indstillet på udendørs arbejde året rundt

1 medarbejder til finish

Her bliver din primære opgave at sikre den sidste finish på betonelementerne, efter de er taget ud af formene.

Opgaverne består bl.a. af:

  • Mindre reparationer af betonelementer

  • Udbedring af kanter, hjørner og mindre skader efter afformning

  • Finish og kvalitetssikring

  • Andre praktiske håndværksmæssige opgaver

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være uddannet håndværker, men du skal gerne have hænderne skruet godt på og sans for kvalitet og finish.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er mødestabil og klar til en fysisk arbejdsdag

  • Trives i et produktionsmiljø

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et team

  • Har en praktisk tilgang til opgaverne

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Selv kan transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen

Arbejdstider

Arbejdstiden ligger som udgangspunkt:

Mandag–torsdag: kl. 06.00–14.10
Fredag: kl. 06.00–13.40

Der kan alternativt være mulighed for mødetid kl. 07.00.

  • Opstart hurtigst muligt

  • Fuldtidsarbejde

  • Løn efter gældende overenskomst

  • Ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • En arbejdsplads med gode muligheder for at lære og udvikle sig

  • Try & Hire-forløb med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt.

Skriv gerne i din ansøgning, om du søger produktion, truck eller finish.

jobs.title: Driftsoperatør på farvesorteringsanlæg i Aalborg
jobs.description:
Er du typen, der tager ansvar, møder til tiden og kan lide både drift, teknik og praktiske opgaver? 
Så er du måske vores nye driftsoperatør.

Meldgaard Miljø A/S har siden 14. juli 2024 drevet et farvesorteringsanlæg i Aalborg for Nordværk på en 18-årig kontrakt. Anlægget sorterer grønne og sorte poser med henholdsvis madaffald og restaffald ved hjælp af optiske sensorer. Restaffald sendes til forbrænding hos Nordværk, mens madaffaldet afhentes af Nordværk til videre udnyttelse. Anlægget har en kapacitet på 58.000 tons årligt og modtager minimum 42.000 tons.


Om jobbet

Der er er tale om en stilling som driftsoperatør på vores farvesorteringsanlæg i Aalborg, hvor arbejdsstedet er Troensevej 2P, Aalborg Ø.

Du bliver en del af et team på 3-4 operatører, som arbejder tæt sammen med driftsleder og produktionsleder om den daglige drift af vores sorteringsanlæg. Du skal være med til at sikre kontinuerlig og optimal drift af farvesorteringsanlægget, hvor en del af dagen foregår i kontrolrummet.

Arbejdsopgaver

  • Overvågning af anlægget fra kontrolrum

  • Håndtering af mindre driftsstop og alarmer

  • Fjernelse af fastsiddende materiale

  • Truckkørsel

  • Kørsel af restaffald fra sorteringsanlægget til forbrændingsanlægget ved Nordværk

  • Rengøring af maskiner og arbejdsområder

  • Skrabning og vask af gulve

  • Smøring af lejer og lettere vedligehold

  • Ad hoc-opgaver i produktionen

Om dig

Erfaring fra produktion, lager, landbrug, genbrug eller lignende er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du er ansvarlig, lærevillig og har lyst til at være en del af et hold, der får tingene til at fungere

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du:

  • Mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har teknisk forståelse og lyst til at lære nyt

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage initiativ

  • Ikke er bange for fysisk arbejde

  • Trives med praktiske opgaver

  • Har IT erfaring på brugerniveau 

  • Truckcertifikat er en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Lastbilkørekort er en fordel, da vi løbende transporterer restaffald fra sorteringsanlægget til forbrændingsanlægget.

  • Har højt humør og er positiv

Mulighed for mere teknisk ansvar:
Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis en uddannet mekaniker. Til gengæld ser vi gerne, at du har praktisk flair og interesse 
for teknik. For den rette person er der mulighed for gradvist at få flere vedligeholdsopgaver såsom udskiftning af 
elmotorer, underbåndsruller, filtre og øvrige mekaniske opgaver på anlægget.

Vi tilbyder 

  • Fast daghold kl. 06.00-14.00 eller 07.00-15.00

    • Anlægget modtager affald alle årets dage, og der kan derfor være behov for arbejde på enkelte helligdage, særligt når dagrenovationen indsamles.

  • Grundig oplæring

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Gode kolleger og uformel omgangstone

  • Mulighed for at udvikle tekniske og mekaniske kompetencer

  • En stabil arbejdsplads med fokus på miljø og genanvendelse

Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold i en velkonsolideret familievirksomhed med over 55 års erfaring. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje. 

Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftsleder Vidar P. Pedersen på 
tlf. 6012 3040. Eller send os din ansøgning via Ansøg senest den 23. oktober 2026.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og afslutter processen når den rette kandidat er fundet. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: KS3 and IGCSE English Teacher (Year 7 – Year 11)
jobs.description:
International School Ikast-Brande (ISIB) is looking for a qualified Cambridge English teacher with experience teaching English to students from Year 7 – Year 11. Preference will be given to candidates who have experience teaching IGCSE First Language English and are native speakers. Interviews will be arranged immediately as the Leadership Team would like to recruit as soon as possible.  

This is a full-time, permanent & pensionable position starting as soon as possible. As an inclusive school, we encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We value the richness that diverse perspectives and lived experiences bring to our community, and we are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where every individual feels respected and supported.  

 

The School: 

International School Ikast-Brande is located in the heart of Denmark and has approximately 200 students across Early Years, Primary and Secondary sections, with one class per year group. Our students are highly motivated and speak very positively about the school. We are committed to providing high-quality international education to families relocating to Denmark, as well as to local families seeking a rigorous international curriculum for their children.  

Our student body is wonderfully diverse, representing a wide range of nationalities and cultural backgrounds. We encourage our students to balance academic achievement with a well-rounded, healthy lifestyle. From an early age, we instil in them a strong sense of right and wrong, empowering them to make thoughtful and responsible decisions. As a result, we enjoy a positive school climate with very few behavioural issues.  

Our teaching team is as vibrant and international as our student body. You will often hear laughter coming from our staffroom and in the corridors. Our team meets regularly to collaborate on educational and operational matters, fostering a collegial and supportive environment.  

 

Requirements: 

In line with the school’s overarching policies and procedures, the successful candidate will be expected to: 

  • Plan and develop engaging & high-quality lessons, tailored to our learners’ needs; 

  • Maintain a student-focused, positive approach to teaching and learning; 

  • Deliver dynamic, stimulating and culturally engaging lessons;  

  • Promote student wellbeing through an understanding of each child’s individuality;  

  • Assess and report on students’ progress effectively;  

  • Manage student behaviour in a positive and constructive manner;  

  • Participate actively in whole-school activities and events;  

  • Employ a solutions-focused mindset;  

  • Maintain a great sense of humour and contribute to a positive work environment;  

  • Be internationally minded and a collaborative team player. 

 

What We Can Offer: 

  • A competitive salary and excellent pension scheme, in line with collective agreements; 

  • A genuine and sustainable work-life balance; 

  • State-of-the-art, modern teaching and learning facilities; 

  • Small class sizes with engaged, capable and curious students; 

  • A calm and respectful learning environment, with motivated and well-disciplined pupils; 

  • A flexible working culture, built on mutual trust and professional autonomy; 

  • A supportive and visible Senior Leadership Team, deeply committed to staff and community wellbeing; 

  • A leadership approach that values collaboration, open dialogue and teacher voice - ensuring staff feel heard, empowered and appreciated; 

  • A culturally diverse, inclusive and welcoming team of professionals; 

  • Strong, constructive partnerships with engaged and supportive parents; 

  • Ongoing professional learning, development opportunities and team-building events. 

 

What Denmark Can Offer: 

Living and working in Denmark offers a unique opportunity to enjoy one of the world’s highest standards of living. Teachers benefit from: 

  • An excellent work-life balance supported by a strong social welfare system; 

  • A safe, clean and well-organised society with low levels of crime; 

  • High-quality, publicly funded healthcare and childcare services; 

  • A focus on family life, personal wellbeing and professional respect; 

  • Beautiful natural surroundings; 

  • Easy access to travel across Denmark, Europe and further afield; 

  • An international community that welcomes newcomers and supports integration; 

  • A strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. 

 

Salary: 

Salary and pension are determined in accordance with the collective agreement and union contract established between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Teachers’ Central Organisation. 

Please note that both local and international teachers are employed under the same pay scales and working conditions. 

While the school does not offer formal relocation packages, we are committed to supporting new staff and work closely with individuals to find practical and helpful solutions throughout their transition. To further assist international staff with their move, initial relocation support is provided during the first year of employment. 

 

Application: 

If you are a skilled, adaptable and solutions-oriented educator, we warmly invite you to apply by sending your CV and a cover letter outlining your experience to job@isib.dk. Letters of recommendation are also welcomed. All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory police security checks.   

The Senior Leadership Team intends to appoint as soon as a suitable candidate is identified to ensure a smooth transition to our school; therefore, interviews will take place on a rolling basis, and the school reserves the right to make an appointment before the advertised closing date.

jobs.title: Frederik på 8 år i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
jobs.description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

Stillingen er på 18 timer om måneden fordelt på 1 til 2 vagter om ugen om eftermiddagen i hverdage fra ca. kl. 14.00 og 3-4 timer per vagt som planlægges med familien. Der vil på sigt når der er dannet en solid tryg relation imellem Frederik, hans familie og dig være mulighed for flere timer, hvor disse også kan placeres om natten.               

                                
 Hvem er Olivia Danmark ? 

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig. 
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør 
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag


  Løn og vilkår

Som ansat hos Olivia Danmark er du sikret Løn og ansættelsesvilkår som følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte Bay Wedebye på mail charlotte.wedebye@oliviadanmark.dk 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Behaviour Change interventions (Part-Time, Fixed-Term)
jobs.description:
The Danish Centre for Motivation and Behaviour Science (DRIVEN), Research
Unit for Behaviour Science, Motivation and Health (STRIVE) at the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics (IOB), invites applications for a fixed-term, part-time (80%) postdoc position commencing as soon as possible and ending 30 September 2028.

The position is established in connection with the joint project “mPADapp - Digital Decision Support for Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD)” between DRIVEN (SDU), the Institute of Clinical Medicine (IMK) at Aarhus University and the Vascular Research Unit at Viborg Regional Hospital.

About the project

Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) is a major vascular health issue affecting quality of life, mobility, and survival. The mPADapp project aims to improve adherence to clinical guidelines for PAD treatment via an interactive decision support tool. The tool will be integrated into a mobile app for patients and into healthcare providers’ systems, to enhance understanding, motivation, and behaviour change around preventive treatments (e.g. medication adherence, smoking cessation, physical activity etc.). A key component is the development of the app’s behavioural intervention design, grounded in evidence on mechanisms of successful behaviour change.

About the job

The postdoc is expected to manage the design and refinement of an app for telerehabilitation. The role will focus on identifying and integrating effective behaviour change techniques (BCTs), user experience/user-centered design, digital engagement, and mechanisms of motivation, self-regulation, habit formation, and sustained adherence.

Key responsibilities

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary team (clinicians, epidemiologists, app developers, AI-scientists, patient representatives) to co-design the app features that promote sustained behaviour change

  • Review and apply theoretical frameworks and empirical evidence on behaviour change mechanisms (motivation, self-efficacy, intention formation, cues/triggers, habit formation, feedback loops, rewards etc.)

  • Identify BCTs appropriate for PAD patients, particularly those who may have low health literacy, low motivation, sociocultural or economic vulnerabilities

  • Collect and analyse qualitative and quantitative studies (usability testing, field pilots, interviews, survey, digital usage data) to test usability, acceptability, engagement, and mechanisms

  • Contribute to app iteration, interface design, content generation (e.g. messaging, reminders, motivational feedback) ensuring alignment with evidence-based BCTs and self-determination theory

  • Prepare high-quality publications, present at conferences and ensure that findings inform clinical integration and implementation

For information on postdoc positions at the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics in general, please click.

Qualifications

  • A completed PhD or equivalent research experience at PhD level in psychology, behaviour science, public health, digital health, or related field, with demonstrated experience in behaviour change/intervention science

  • Strong knowledge of behaviour change theories and frameworks (e.g. Self-Determination Theory, COM-B, Behaviour Change Wheel, Health Action Process Approach etc.)

  • Experience with digital health interventions or mobile app behaviour support (design and evaluation)

  • Strong collaboration skills, able to work in interdisciplinary teams including clinicians, software developers, and health economists

  • Excellent communication skills in both Danish and English (written and oral)

We offer

  • A stimulating interdisciplinary research environment, with strong ties to vascular surgery, epidemiology, digital health, and user involvement

  • Resources for user panels/patient involvement, usability labs, and collaboration with app developers

  • Opportunities for publication, networking, and professional development

Further information and contact:

For more information about the position and the department, please contact Professor Nikos Ntoumanis, Head of Centre, Tel: (+45) 6550 4525, e-mail: nntoumanis@health.sdu.dk or Jens Troelsen, Head of Department, Tel: (+45) 6550 3493, e-mail: jtroelsen@health.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for the period mentioned above. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years in total at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

The shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Employment as a postdoctoral researcher requires a PhD degree or academic qualifications at PhD level.  

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Master’s degree and PhD degree or equivalent aacademic qualifications at PhD level (copy of original + verified English translation)

  • A complete list of publications

  • Up to 4 of the most relevant publications. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication 

  • Reference letters/references may also be included 

  • A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

The application deadline is 25 October 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About the Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics

The Department of Sports Science and Clinical Biomechanics adheres to SDU's strategy and values.  Our department is recognized for our interdisciplinary research. The scientific, technical and administrative staff support this through active participation in the department's professional and social life. We prefer candidates with the ambition to make mutual working relationships thrive.

About The Faculty of Health Sciences

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

About Us

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled auto mechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,600 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

  • Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems).

  • Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

  • Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors. No work on the high-voltage battery is required.

  • Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

  • Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

  • Are a trained passenger car mechanic

  • Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

  • Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

  • Are a team player who contributes positively to collaboration in the workshop

  • Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time

  • Hold a category B driving licence

  • Have English skills sufficient for technical documentation and team communication

  • Are comfortable using digital tools to document repairs across the fleet

  • Experience with our vehicle brands (Renault, Kia, Nissan...) is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your professional curiosity and desire to develop.

Your new workplace

GreenMobility is the largest free-floating car-sharing operator in the Nordics. With a fleet of 1,600 electric cars, we contribute to greener and cleaner mobility in Aarhus and Copenhagen. Every month we enable more than 185,000 shared car trips, reducing car ownership and making cities more liveable places.

We offer

  • To be part of a green mission you can be proud of

  • An exciting everyday working life in a modern workshop

  • Ongoing training and good development opportunities

  • A strong professional and international working environment with skilled colleagues

  • Attractive terms of employment

  • A workplace focused on wellbeing, collaboration and integrity

Would you like to join the team? We look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Fanny Dutrey on +45 31 27 21 30 or fd@greenmobility.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

GreenMobility A/S

jobs.title: Talent Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model:

 - Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business.

 - Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density.

 - People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

 - People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services.



We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement.



This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

1. Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies

 - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

 - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

 - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

 - Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.



2. Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners

 - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density.

 - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources.

 - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision.

 - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment.



3. Enable talent density

 - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow.

 - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent

 - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent.

 - Enable our leadership bench.



4. Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects

This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include:

 - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent.

 - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment.

 - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do.

 - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion.

 - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives).

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority.

 - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms.

 - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes.

 - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: AML Governance Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
AML Governance Officer

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Experienced
Home Office Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

The AML Governance Officer is responsible for strengthening and harmonising AML/CFT governance across our EU entities and branches. Working closely with the Group AML/CTF Office in Switzerland and local Compliance teams, you will support the Group-wide AML/CFT Compliance Function, oversee key AML/CFT risks and regulatory developments, and help ensure consistent and effective compliance across Europe.

What you can expect

• Develop, maintain and continuously enhance the EU AML/CFT Governance Framework, ensuring consistent implementation of policies, standards and controls across EU entities.
• Monitor EU and international AML/CFT regulatory developments, assess their impact and coordinate the implementation of new requirements across the organisation.
• Coordinate and provide oversight of the EU-wide ML/TF Risk Assessment, challenging local assessments and ensuring that identified risks are appropriately addressed.
• Act as a key contact for AMLA and other supervisory authorities, coordinating regulatory requests, inspections, submissions and remediation actions.
• Support the EU AML Compliance Manager and Group AML/CTF Office with governance reporting, regulatory analysis, risk monitoring and preparation of management and committee materials.
• Coordinate with local AML Officers and Compliance teams to promote consistent standards, effective information sharing and best practices across jurisdictions.
• Monitor the effectiveness of the AML/CFT governance framework, identify areas for improvement and support audits, regulatory reviews, remediation programmes and training initiatives.
• Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across Compliance, Legal, Risk, Audit and the business to foster a strong AML/CFT governance and compliance culture.

What we expect

• Master's degree in Law, Compliance, Finance, Risk Management or a related field. An AML certification (ACAMS, ICA or equivalent) is an asset.
• 10+ years of experience in AML/CFT, ideally within insurance, banking or financial services, with international exposure.
• Strong knowledge of the EU AML/CFT regulatory framework, including AMLA requirements, EU AML legislation, FATF standards and EBA guidelines.
• Proven experience working with regulators and supervisory authorities.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational and reporting skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative and adaptable mindset.
• Very good command of English and French, both written and spoken. Any additional language is an asset.

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. In addition to our traditional financial business, we are also broadening our range with ecosystems in the areas of mobility and home. We see the digital age as an opportunity to make our offering even more sustainable, innovative and customer-oriented in the future. Are you shaping it with us?

We give you the freedom to pursue your ideas. Get involved! Question us! Develop yourself and us even further! Our culture of learning and making mistakes as well as communication at eye level all make this possible. Because only together can we move forward.

jobs.description: Na temelju članka 30. Statuta, ravnatelj ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Trg Krešimira Ćosića 11, Zagreb, raspisuje J AV N I N A T J E Č A J za prijam radnika u radni odnos na neodređeno vrijeme 6. Naziv radnog mjesta: NADZORNIK (m/ž) – 1 izvršitelj/izvršiteljica Rad s punim radnim vremenom, neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci Mjesto rada: Zagreb Sprema: VKV/SSS, edukacija kroz seminar Slučajni spasilac (edukacija se može provesti u roku od 2 mjeseca od zaposlenja) Koeficijent složenosti poslova: 1,44 Radno iskustvo: 1 godina Posebna znanja i vještine: nisu potrebna Opis poslova: provodi preventivne aktivnosti vezane uz sigurnost korisnika te brine za sigurnost korisnika u smislu životne ugroze i spašavanja iz vode, pruža neodgodivu prvu pomoć, vrši nadzor na svom području djelovanja za koje je zadužen i odgovoran tijekom u vremenu utvrđenom rasporedom, brine za čistoću bazena, raspored pruga, rekvizita i opreme na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, dnevno obavlja čišćenje bazenskog oplošja i/ili plaže, sudjeluje u pripremi i realizaciji sportskih natjecanja ili drugih događanja na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, daje informacije korisnicima u smislu uputa i pravila za korištenje bazena, jezera ili plaže prema potrebi, obavlja redarske poslove na prostoru cijelog objekta, vodi pisanu evidenciju o dnevnom čišćenju bazena, intervencijama te oštećenjima na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, sudjeluje u remontu bazena, prvenstveno u čišćenju školjke i oplošja bazena, obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog u okviru stručne spreme i djelokruga rada i sl. Plaću radnika čine osnovna odnosno ugovorena plaća i dodaci na osnovnu plaću. Osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na kojemu radnik radi i osnovice za izračun plaće, uvećan za 0,5% za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Osnovica za obračun plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obavezni probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci. Kandidati su u prijavi dužni navesti osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti e-mail adresa), naziv i redni broj radnog mjesta za koje se podnosi prijava. Kandidati koji se natječu za više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu. Uz svaku prijavu dužni su priložiti traženu dokumentaciju. Kandidati su prilikom prijave dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju: • prijavu za javni natječaj (obrazac prijave može se preuzeti na web stranici Ustanove: https://www.sportskiobjekti.hr/pravilnici-i-natjecaji/1164), • životopis, • dokaz o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica, vojna iskaznica ili domovnica), • dokaz o stručnoj spremi: presliku diplome ili svjedodžbe (ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži inozemnu kvalifikaciju, dužan je uz istu dostaviti i dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije), • uvjerenje o nevođenju kaznenog postupka (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja), • dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu, ne stariji od 1 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja: Elektronički zapis (e–radna knjižica) ili Potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, a koji Zapis/Potvrda, između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu, općini rada – prebivališta i trajanju staža osiguranja. Kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku dužni su uz istu dostaviti ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista). Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužan je uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, kao i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu, te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.) Temeljem članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihove obitelji (Narodne novine, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) i članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, 84/21), kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti dužni su dostaviti sve dokaze iz citiranih odredbi Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske https://branitelji.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama/835 . Kandidat koji se, sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i dokumentaciju navedenu u javnom natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Kandidati prijavljeni na javni natječaj biti će pozvani pisanim putem na prethodnu provjeru znanja i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se primaju. Prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti mogu pristupiti samo kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na javni natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom. jobs.title: MONTER/KA I (822416) U ODJELU IZMJENE VODOMJERA
jobs.description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su: • SSS/KV – tehničkog smjera (vodoinstalater, monter strojarskih instalacija ili srodni stručnjaci strojarskog ili građevinskog smjera) • vozačka dozvola B kategorije Opis poslova radnog mjesta: • organizira i samostalno obavlja složeni popravak svih vrsta vodomjera radi pripreme za njihovo mjeriteljsko ispitivanje i ovjeru • organizira raspoređivanje rezervnih dijelova vodomjera unutar servisa • prema potrebi izrađuje pojedine dijelove vodomjera • sudjeluje u radovima remonta baždarnice Izabrani kandidat obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER I (822416) u Odjelu izmjene vodomjera, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu. Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi: • životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER I (822416) u Odjelu izmjene vodomjera“. Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21 i 13/26) a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti i sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.
