jobs.title: SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN? - ARE YOU READY TO JOIN THE JOURNEY?
jobs.description:
SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN?

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent med ambitioner

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som både er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig.

Måske har du mange års erfaring med rengøring. Måske har du arbejdet i private hjem, hos erhvervskunder, med kvalitetssikring eller koordinering. Eller måske ved du bare, at du kan mere, end du får mulighed for at vise i dit nuværende job.

Så kan RenTid være stedet for dig.

⚠️ EN VIGTIG TING, DU SKAL VIDE

Hos RenTid starter alle på gulvet.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent – ikke som leder, supervisor eller direktør.

Du starter sammen med alle andre, ude hos kunderne og med rengøringen i hænderne.

Vi er ikke så optagede af din titel eller hvad der står på dit CV. Vi vil se:

  • Hvad du kan

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Din indstilling og arbejdsmoral

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder og kollegaer

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har det, der skal til for at vokse med RenTid

HVOR KAN DET FØRE DIG HEN?

Det ved vi ikke på forhånd. Det afhænger af dig.

Når RenTid vokser, opstår nye muligheder. Den rigtige medarbejder kan derfor med tiden få mere ansvar, eksempelvis:

  • Ansvar for bestemte kunder

  • Kvalitetskontrol

  • Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

  • Koordinering af kollegaer

  • Planlægning af opgaver

  • Kundekontakt

  • Ansvar for bestemte områder

  • Teamlederfunktioner

  • Driftsansvar

  • På længere sigt endnu større ansvar i virksomheden

Mulighederne er mange, hvis du viser, at du er klar til dem.

Vi vil gerne finde en person, som på sigt kan blive en central del af RenTid. Men større ansvar, højere løn og flere goder følger med det, du viser, du kan løfte.

DU STARTER MED EN GOD LØN

Vi tilbyder en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Men vi er også ærlige: Du starter ikke på en direktørløn.

Som rengøringsassistent får du ikke automatisk lederansvar, højere løntrin, fri firmabil, fri telefon eller andre goder, der følger med større ansvar.

Det arbejder man sig frem til.

Når du tager ansvar, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte en større rolle, følger mulighederne med.

DINE OPGAVER

Du skal først og fremmest kunne det vigtigste:

Rengøring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn, både private hjem og erhvervskunder.

Du skal kunne arbejde professionelt og selvstændigt og forstå, at vores kunder forventer et resultat, de kan være stolte af.

Hos RenTid skal rengøring ikke bare overstås.

Det skal gøres ordentligt.

Du skal have øje for detaljerne, tage ansvar og sætte en ære i at levere et resultat, der lever op til RenTids standarder.

HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG?

Vi forventer ikke, at du er perfekt. Men vi forventer, at du vil blive bedre.

Du skal:

  • Være mødestabil og fleksibel

  • Have en positiv attitude

  • Have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Kunne arbejde selvstændigt og i team

  • Have øje for detaljer

  • Sætte en ære i et perfekt resultat

  • Tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kunne modtage og bruge feedback konstruktivt

  • Være loyal over for kunder, kollegaer og RenTid

  • Være løsningsorienteret

  • Kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

  • Have kørekort kategori B

  • Selv kunne komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus

  • Være indforstået med, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde

  • Tale, forstå, læse, og skrive Engelsk

Har du ikke kørekort B, eller ønsker du ikke at køre bil, er stillingen ikke den rette for dig.

⭐ ERFARING ER VIGTIGT

Vi søger en person med stor erfaring inden for rengøring i private hjem. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er det ikke dig, vi søger.

Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring er en klar fordel.

Du skal kende de grundlæggende principper inden for professionel rengøring og kunne arbejde effektivt uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Hos RenTid skærer vi ikke hjørnerne. Vi gør tingene ordentligt.

Men erfaring alene er ikke nok.

Vi leder også efter:

Mindset. Arbejdsmoral. Ansvar. Vilje. Drive.

Du skal have lyst til at blive bedre – og lyst til at blive mere.

⏱️ DE FØRSTE 3 MÅNEDER

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode i henhold til gældende danske regler.

Det er en periode, hvor både du og vi finder ud af, om vi er det rigtige match.

Vi ser blandt andet på:

  • Hvordan du møder på arbejde

  • Hvordan du arbejder

  • Hvordan du behandler kunder

  • Hvordan du fungerer med kollegaer

  • Hvordan du reagerer på feedback

  • Om du tager ansvar

  • Om du har lyst til at lære

  • Om du har det drive, vi leder efter

Hvis svaret er ja, kan de første tre måneder blive begyndelsen på noget langt større.

HOS RеNTID KAN DU UDVIKLE DIG

Vi tror på, at mennesker kan udvikle sig.

Derfor vil vi hellere finde den rigtige person med det rigtige mindset end den flotteste titel på CV'et.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan blive leder.

Vis os det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan tage ansvar.

Tag det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du har ambitioner.

Vis dem.

HVIS DU VIL MERE...

Vi kan ikke love dig en lederstilling om seks måneder, en firmabil om et år eller en direktørløn.

Det skal du gøre dig fortjent til.

Men vi kan love dig dette:

Hvis du arbejder hårdt, tager ansvar, udvikler dig, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte mere, så vil vi gerne give dig mulighederne for at vokse.

For når RenTid vokser, skal vores medarbejdere have mulighed for at vokse med.

Her starter alle på gulvet. Hvor langt du kan komme derfra, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Stillingen er primært i Aarhus og omegn.

Du skal kunne transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen og være indstillet på, at arbejdsdagen kan foregå hos forskellige kunder.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en ansøgning og dit CV med billede, hvor du fortæller:

  • Hvem du er

  • Hvor længe du har arbejdet med rengøring

  • Din erfaring med private hjem

  • Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

  • Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

  • Hvorfor du passer godt ind hos RenTid

Skriv gerne din ansøgning på Engelsk Mærk ansøgningen "The Journey".

"Jeg skal med på rejsen"

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

JOIN US ON THE JOURNEY!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaner with ambition

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaner who is highly skilled at their profession and wants to develop further.

Perhaps you have many years of experience in cleaning, private homes, commercial cleaning, quality control or coordination. Or perhaps you simply know that you have more to offer than you currently get the opportunity to show.

Then RenTid might be the right place for you.

⚠️ ONE IMPORTANT THING YOU NEED TO KNOW

At RenTid, everyone starts on the floor.

You will be hired as a cleaner – not as a manager, supervisor or director.

You start alongside everyone else, working directly with our customers and the cleaning itself.

We are less interested in titles and more interested in seeing:

  • What you can do

  • How you work

  • Your attitude and work ethic

  • How you treat customers and colleagues

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you have what it takes to grow with RenTid

WHERE CAN THIS JOURNEY TAKE YOU?

We don't know in advance.

That depends on you.

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right person can gradually take on more responsibility, such as:

  • Responsibility for specific customers

  • Quality control

  • Training new employees

  • Coordinating colleagues

  • Planning tasks

  • Customer communication

  • Responsibility for specific areas

  • Team leader responsibilities

  • Operational responsibility

  • Greater responsibility within the company over time

There are many opportunities if you show that you are ready for them.

Greater responsibility, higher salary and additional benefits come with what you demonstrate that you can handle.

YOU START WITH A GOOD SALARY

We offer a good and fair salary from day one.

But we are also honest: You will not start on a director's salary.

Management responsibility, higher salary levels, private use of a company car, company phone and other benefits are not automatic.

They are things you work your way towards.

As you take responsibility and deliver results, the opportunities will follow.

YOUR INITIAL ROLE

First and foremost, you need to be able to do the most important thing:

Clean.

You will work at customer locations in Aarhus and the surrounding areas, including private homes and commercial clients.

You must be able to work professionally and independently and understand that our customers expect a result they can be proud of.

At RenTid, cleaning is not something to rush through.

It has to be done properly.

You should have an eye for detail, take responsibility and take pride in meeting RenTid's standards.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

We don't expect you to be perfect. But we expect you to want to become better.

You must:

  • Be reliable and flexible

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Be willing to learn and develop

  • Work independently and as part of a team

  • Have an eye for detail

  • Take pride in delivering a perfect result

  • Take responsibility for your work

  • Receive and use feedback constructively

  • Be loyal to customers, colleagues and RenTid

  • Be solution-oriented

  • Maintain an overview in a busy environment

  • Have a valid Category B driving licence

  • Be able to get to and from work in Aarhus independently

  • Be comfortable with possible weekend work

  • Speak, understand, read, and write English

If you do not have a Category B licence or do not want to drive, this position is not for you.

⭐ EXPERIENCE MATTERS

We are looking for someone with extensive experience cleaning private homes. If you do not have this experience, this position is not for you.

Experience with commercial cleaning is a clear advantage.

You should already understand professional cleaning principles and be able to work efficiently without compromising quality.

At RenTid, we don't cut corners. We do things properly.

Experience alone is not enough.

We are also looking for:

Mindset. Work ethic. Responsibility. Determination. Drive.

You must want to become better – and want to become more.

⏱️ THE FIRST 3 MONTHS

The first 3 months are a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish employment law.

This is a period where both you and RenTid can determine whether we are the right match.

We will look at:

  • How you show up for work

  • How you work

  • How you treat customers

  • How you work with colleagues

  • How you respond to feedback

  • Whether you take responsibility

  • Whether you want to learn

  • Whether you have the drive we are looking for

If the answer is yes, these first three months could be the beginning of something much bigger.

AT RENTID, YOU CAN DEVELOP

We believe people can develop.

That is why we would rather find the right person with the right mindset than the person with the most impressive title on their CV.

You don't need to tell us you can become a manager.

Show us.

You don't need to tell us you can take responsibility.

Take it.

You don't need to tell us you have ambition.

Show us.

IF YOU WANT MORE...

We cannot promise you a management position in six months, a company car in a year or a director's salary.

You have to earn it.

But we can promise you this:

If you work hard, take responsibility, develop yourself, deliver results and show that you can handle more, we want to give you opportunities to grow.

Because when RenTid grows, our employees should have the opportunity to grow with it.

Everyone starts on the floor. How far you go from there will largely depend on you.

WORKING AREA

The position is primarily based in Aarhus and the surrounding areas.

You must be able to travel to and from work and be comfortable working at different customer locations.

RenTid provides a car for you or your team during working hours.

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Then we would love to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV with a photo, including:

  • Who you are

  • How long you have worked in cleaning

  • Your experience with private homes

  • Any commercial cleaning experience

  • What you would like to develop within

  • Why you believe you would be a good fit for RenTid

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

Notion’s Tax team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to support our global tax operations. In this role, you’ll run global indirect tax operations and strengthen the systems behind them. As Notion scales across products and jurisdictions, this role exists to make compliance, close, audits, and tax data more accurate, scalable, and audit-ready. You’ll own recurring sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business tax, registrations, notices, reconciliations, and related controls, while building exposure to income tax compliance and reporting. The work is hands-on and cross-functional: you’ll trace differences across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger with Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience partners.

 

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take ownership of recurring U.S. and global indirect-tax filings, calendars, data packages, notices, registrations, and close support—with accurate, review-ready work.

 - Establish a reliable reconciliation and exception workflow across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger, escalating issues clearly and early.

 - Use AI-enabled workflows and data tools to investigate variances, quality-check work papers, and improve documentation while preserving human review and controls.

 - Make tax operations more scalable and audit-ready by strengthening controls, process documentation, evidence, handoffs, audit support, and SOX walkthrough readiness.

 - Become a trusted partner to Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience—and contribute to income tax compliance and reporting with guidance from experienced teammates.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - At least 3 years of public accounting and/or industry tax experience, with a primary focus on indirect tax compliance and operations.

 - Hands-on experience with indirect tax compliance or operations, especially U.S. sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business taxes, or other non-income-based taxes; this is the foundation for owning Notion’s recurring global work.

 - Experience preparing accurate reconciliations, journal entries, filings, payments, and audit-ready work papers, with the ability to connect activity across source systems and the general ledger.

 - Strong operational judgment: you manage recurring deadlines, investigate exceptions, keep documentation organized, escalate issues promptly, and drive assigned work through completion.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with a collaborative approach to working across Finance, Accounting, business teams, and external advisors.

 - Curiosity and learning agility, including willingness to build income-tax capability and demonstrated AI fluency—using AI to analyze data, investigate variances, improve documentation, perform quality checks, or automate repeatable workflows while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

Risk Management, Controls & Audit

• Act as a key control owner for the assigned client portfolio, ensuring that fund accounting activities are performed in line with internal policies, ISAE requirements, regulatory obligations, and client documentation.
• Ensure that appropriate preventive and detective controls are in place, operating effectively, and evidenced.
• Review and challenge unusual transactions, valuation judgments, late data, or deviations from standard processes.
• Act as the primary escalation point for NAV issues, breaches, or errors, ensuring timely resolution, root‑cause analysis, and clear documentation.
• Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit queries and timelines.
• Support the Manager in maintaining a strong control culture across the team and client portfolio.

Team Leadership & People Management

• Provide day‑to‑day supervision of Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accountants within the team.
• Allocate work effectively, taking into account complexity, risk and deadlines.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team and provide structured feedback.
• Support training, development, and performance management of team members.
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and quality.
• Escalate capacity, performance, or quality concerns to the Manager with proposed solutions.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Continuously assess existing fund accounting and reporting processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Actively contribute to system enhancements, automation, and standardisation.
• Support the Manager in implementing new operating models, tools, and best practices.
• Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and risk awareness

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
• ACCA (or equivalent) – qualified or advanced stage preferred
• Strong knowledge of Lux GAAP and IFRS (including consolidation)
• 8+ years of experience in fund administration, primarily for closed-ended funds, open-ended funds and evergreen/hybrid funds, with experience in various asset classes (private equity, private debt, listed loans)
• Prior experience reviewing NAVs and supervising team members is essential.
• Experience in capital hedging and portfolio management.
• Added value for candidates familiar with public loans managed through Allvue or WSO platforms.
• Languages: English fluent; French and/or German is an advantage.
• Additional advantage for candidates with experience using Paxus.

Skills/Behavior

In addition to demonstrating IQEQ's Group Values (Authentic, Bold, Collaborative), the Assistant Manager is expected to:

• Take ownership and accountability
• Demonstrate sound judgement and risk awareness
• Lead and develop others
• Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders
• Navigate complexity and ambiguity
• Balance client service with internal control discipline
• Plan, prioritise, and delegate effectively
• Continuously develop technical and leadership skills

Context

As the Head of Internal Audit, you will lead, structure and continuously develop LIST's Internal Audit Service, an independent and objective assurance and advisory function serving the Board of Directors through the Finance and Audit Committee.
The role provides independent assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control, while supporting compliance with applicable laws and regulations and contributing to the continuous improvement of LIST's organisation and operations.

In addition to defining the internal audit strategy and the risk-based annual audit plan, you will oversee the full audit lifecycle, from planning and execution to reporting, follow-up and quality assurance. The role also leads specific assurance, advisory and investigation assignments and ensures that Internal Audit methodologies, policies, processes and the Internal Audit Charter remain robust and aligned with professional internal audit standards.

Working closely with the Board of Directors, the Finance and Audit Committee, the CEO, Executive Management, Risk Management, external auditors and auditees, you will provide clear insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making while safeguarding the independence, objectivity and credibility of the function.

Your team and environment

Your team - 3 people

• Internal Audit collaborators - 2 | contribution to assurance, advisory, audit follow-up and continuous improvement activities

The Internal Audit Service operates as an independent function within LIST and coordinates with Risk Management, where relevant, to leverage synergies and avoid duplication of work without prejudice to its independence.
You will report to the Chair of the Board of Directors, or to the Vice-Chair in the event of replacement of the Chair, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter. For administrative and day-to-day matters, you will report to the CEO.

• Build constructive relationships with key internal and external stakeholders while maintaining the independence and objectivity required of the function

Background & experience

jobs.title: Project Coordinator in Product and Supply
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator – Product & Supply

Do you enjoy creating structure, improving processes, and coordinating projects across different teams? Are you highly organized, analytical, and motivated by making operations run more efficiently? Then you might be our new Project Coordinator.

As Project Coordinator, you will play a key role in driving smaller projects and continuous process improvements within our Product & Supply organization. You will work closely with stakeholders across different departments to map, optimize, and maintain operational processes while ensuring consistency and efficiency throughout the supply chain.

Your responsibilities

As our new Project Coordinator, you will:

  • Lead and coordinate smaller internal projects within the Product & Supply organization

  • Drive updates and continuous improvements to operational processes and procedures

  • Map, document, and analyze current supply chain processes

  • Develop, align, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across departments

  • Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvement initiatives

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather input and ensure alignment

  • Support timely execution of both operational tasks and longer-term initiatives

  • Facilitate recurring process reviews and operational performance updates

  • Participate in process discovery and optimization workshops

  • Gather and analyze operational data to support reporting and decision-making

  • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Who you are

We imagine that you are a structured and proactive professional who enjoys working with both people and processes. You are naturally curious and have a strong desire to understand how things work and how they can be improved.

Additionally, you:

  • Have a strong attention to detail and a systematic approach to problem-solving

  • Can manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously

  • Thrive in a dynamic environment and work well independently

  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across teams

  • Possess excellent communication skills

  • Have experience working with SharePoint

  • Have an interest in business intelligence tools and data analysis

  • Have advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data modelling

What we offer

jobs.title: PhD Position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education
jobs.description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This is a unique position in that research and its consequences sit in the same place. You will not be studying a distant phenomenon and writing it up; you will be running studies in live courses, designing interventions from what you find, and seeing them change how software engineering is taught. If you see yourself as someone who wants to help our discipline navigate the AI disruption rather than wait for it to settle, this is that opportunity.

 

Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and conduct empirical studies of how software engineering students generally use generative AI — how they justify it, what they delegate to it, and where their agency is preserved or surrendered.

  • Translate those findings into agency artifacts, practicum activities, and assessment designs that can be used by real instructors in real courses.

  • Co-develop and evaluate self-learning components, and contribute to alignment work on intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment together with the ITU stream.

  • Work directly with the head of programs and instructors to implement classroom interventions, whose buy-in is what makes this kind of change hold. Persuading colleagues is part of the craft here, not an afterthought.

  • Publish in leading venues for computing education research, and present internationally.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a closely related field, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree and including a substantial thesis component. The degree must be completed before the starting date. Students with master’s in education and related fields are welcome to apply.

  • A grade average at or above 10 on the Danish 7-point scale, or a documented equivalent from the awarding institution. Applicants with degrees from outside Denmark should include a grading scale and, where available, a conversion statement.

  • Documented ability to carry out independent scientific work, evidenced by the master’s thesis.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • A software engineering background, with practical familiarity with how software is actually built — you should be able to judge whether an AI-assisted solution is sound, not only whether it runs.

  • A genuine motivation for teaching and education, both in delivery and as an object of research.

  • The ability to design and carry out empirical studies involving students, and to engage stakeholders for support.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Prior research and publication experience.

  • Experience with empirical research methods — interventions, experiment, interviews, coding, thematic or pattern analysis — and with mixed-methods designs.

  • Familiarity with computing education research, or with constructive alignment as a course design framework.

  • Teaching or teaching-assistant experience at university level.

  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in software development, and a considered view of where they help and where they do not.

 

Personal competences

  • Critical and ingenious thinking. You question assumptions — including your own, including ours, and including the ones embedded in our education design and the AI tools you will be studying. You are as interested in what a finding does not show as in what it does.

  • A demonstrated passion for software engineering and its education. This project asks you to care about how the next generation of engineers is formed, not only about publishing on the topic.

  • The ability to bring colleagues along. Much of this work happens through instructors and program leaderships who own their courses. We value someone who can earn agreement through evidence, patience, and good listening rather than argument alone.

  • Independence paired with collaboration. You will drive your own studies, and you will do it inside a two-university project with shared deliverables and deadlines.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be researching people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

  • Comfort with iteration. Design-based research means your first intervention will be wrong in interesting ways. That is the method working, not failing.

 

Workplace description

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Two recommendation letters, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

SCANDINAVIAN MEDICARE ApS SØGER SOSU MEDHJÆLPER TIL HJEMMEHJÆLP

Er du omsorgsfuld, tålmodig og har du lyst til at gøre en forskel i hverdagen for et andet menneske? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Hun har derfor behov for en stabil, omsorgsfuld og tryg person, som kan støtte hende i dagligdagen og hjælpe med både personlige og praktiske opgaver, så hun fortsat kan have en værdig, tryg og så selvstændig hverdag som muligt i sit eget hjem.

-              At bidrage til en hyggelig positiv hverdag

Vi forventer at du:

-              Har en relevant uddannelse eller erfaring inden for pleje og omsorg

-              Er tålmodig, empatisk og omsorgsfuld

-              Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

-              Er mødestabil og fleksibel

-              Har forståelse for de udfordringer, der kan være forbundet med nedsat syn

Det er vigtigt, at du møder klienten med respekt og nærvær og har lyst til at blive en stabil og tryg del af hendes hverdag. Borgerens selvbestemmelse skal til enhver tid respekteres.

Vi tilbyder:

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

jobs.title: Pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Naturly – 37 timer
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for unge – også når dagen ikke går helt efter planen?

Naturly søger en pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt på vores børne- og ungehjem.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan skabe ro, struktur, relation og udvikling omkring unge, som har brug for voksne, der både kan stå fast og være nysgerrige på det, der ligger bag en adfærd.

Hvem er vi?

Naturly er et mindre, privat børne- og ungehjem med 5 pladser efter Barnets Lov § 43 samt 1 fleksibel plads efter Servicelovens § 107.

Vores målgruppe er unge i alderen 12–22 år, som blandt andet kan have ADHD/opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser, angst, stressbelastning, tilknytningsvanskeligheder og erfaringer med omsorgssvigt.

Vi arbejder med KRAP som pædagogisk metode samt en mentaliserende og strukturpædagogisk tilgang.

Hos os skal faglighed ikke kun stå i en metodebeskrivelse. Den skal kunne ses i hverdagen, i relationen til den unge, i vores refleksioner og i vores dokumentation.

Vi søger dig, der

er uddannet pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent, og som har lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med unge, kolleger og ledelse.

Du må gerne have erfaring fra døgnområdet eller med vores målgruppe, men det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, stabil, ansvarlig og fagligt reflekterende.

Du skal kunne bevare roen, når en ung har svært ved det, være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag adfærden, og samtidig være tydelig omkring de rammer, der skaber tryghed og forudsigelighed.

Vi prioriterer din faglige udvikling

På Naturly skal man ikke stå alene med de faglige udfordringer. Vi prioriterer tid til refleksion, sparring og udvikling af vores fælles praksis.

Hos os får du blandt andet:

• Løbende supervision
• Faglig sparring med kolleger og ledelse
• Faste faglige drøftelser
• Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling
• En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og tæt kontakt til ledelsen
• Mulighed for at være med til at præge og udvikle vores faglige praksis
• Et tværfagligt kollegialt fællesskab med fokus på en fælles faglig retning

Arbejdet foregår i døgnregi, og vagterne vil derfor også omfatte aften, weekend og døgnvagter.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, om der står pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent på dit eksamensbevis. Det vigtigste er, hvad du bringer med dig ind ad døren – fagligt og menneskeligt.

Stillingen: Fastansættelse, 37 timer ugentligt.
Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen eller Naturly, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Naturly – et lille sted med plads til udvikling.

jobs.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance - Functional Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a Functional Solution Architect with a passion for providing top-notch service to customers, focusing on quality when implementing D365 solutions?

Join our team at TravelOperations and help us design and implement cutting-edge solutions that meet our clients' complex business needs.

Responsibilities

As a Functional Solution Architect at TravelOperations, you will play a key role in influencing and overseeing large-scale international implementation projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and implement enterprise-level solutions, ensuring they align with business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define functional requirements and develop architecture roadmaps.

  • Lead the integration of multiple systems to create seamless business processes.

  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with industry standards.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentor team members in best practices and emerging technologies.

  • Execute workshops, including in-depth analysis sessions, in collaboration with a team of Business Consultants to refine and validate solution designs.

  • Collaborate with skilled Developers to ensure the solution design is thoroughly tested and meets the technical and functional requirements.

  • Engage in General Architect work, such as exploring emerging technologies, conducting Proof of Concepts, and participating in Product Advisory Board activities with partners like Microsoft or industry-specific leaders such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.

  • Offer internal guidance and support to colleagues, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in architectural best practices.

  • Maintaining daily ownership of customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor in implementing scalable and secure solutions.

Desired Skills & Requirements

Seeking a candidate with 5+ years of Dynamics 365 Finance experience with a strong finance background. While various profiles may apply, we highly value a strong person-organization fit. Our ideal candidate possesses the following attributes and qualifications:

  • Extensive experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and proficiency in finance.

  • Proven experience as a Functional Solution Architect or in a similar role.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methodologies.

  • Proficiency in system integration, data migration, and cloud technologies.

  • Excellent communication skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality solutions within tight deadlines and the capability to lead functional areas within projects.

  • Certification in MB-310 / MB-700.

  • Dynamic, proactive, and possesses a comprehensive solution overview.

  • Exceptional consulting and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

  • Demonstrated passion for driving positive change for customers and their businesses, coupled with a willingness to travel both professionally and personally.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work with innovative technologies in a dynamic environment where progressive work culture with a global perspective where your ideas truly matter, and growth opportunities are endless.

  • Work with the latest Microsoft Technologies alongside Dynamics professionals committed to driving customer success.

  • Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere

  • Work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.

  • Experience a dynamic workplace where team spirit, joy, and productivity go hand in hand.

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

  • Career growth and professional development opportunities.

  • A collaborative and inclusive work culture.

Workplace

Work from either our Copenhagen or Aalborg offices and have the chance to visit our Brisbane location. Join our global team spanning Denmark, Sweden, India, the US, and Australia.

How to Apply

For more details, please contact our People and Culture Team at hr@traveloperations.com or

visit our careers site at www.traveloperations.com.

We can't wait to hear from you!

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

About Travel Operations A/S

At TravelOperations, we're not just about professionalism and ambition; we're about building an environment where every employee shines. Our global reach spans from Greenland to Australia, as we partner with leading travel agencies, airlines, and leisure-focused businesses to craft tailor-made solutions. Join us in reshaping the travel industry landscape, where responsiveness and innovation are our guiding stars.

Diversity and Inclusion

At our company, Diversity and Inclusion are core values. We welcome applicants of all genders, striving for a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Join us in building an inclusive future where diversity is celebrated as a strength

jobs.description: ΥΠΟΒΟΗΘΗΣΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΩΝ. ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ, ΚΟΠΗ, ΛΕΙΑΝΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΧΡΗΣΗ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΥ ΤΕΧΝΙΤΗ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΑΣΤΗΡΙΟΥ Η ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΥΝΑΤΟΤΗΤΑ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ. ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΠΩΛΗΣΕΙΣ Ή ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ.  ΜΕ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΟΔΗΓΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΙΔΙΟΚΤΗΤΟ ΟΧΗΜΑ.  ΓΙΑ FULL-TIME + PART-T , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

jobs.title: Head of Sales & Structuring - CIB Financial Markets (m/f)
jobs.description:
BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Key objectives of the role:

• Lead the Sales & Structuring function within CIB Financial Markets, providing strategic direction, team leadership, and oversight of business performance.
• Develop, manage, and distribute Financial Markets solutions, including structured products and OTC derivatives, ensuring innovative, client-centric offerings that meet market trends, risk standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Partner with business lines across the bank to deliver tailored investment solutions, provide product expertise and education, and support Advisors, Relationship Managers, and DPM teams in serving clients.
• Drive product governance and business development, overseeing product approval, issuance programs, process enhancements, counterparty relationships, and the expansion of sales and distribution capabilities.
• Ensure compliance and stakeholder alignment, working closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, regulators, counterparties, and other key stakeholders to maintain a robust and compliant operating framework.

Deliverables and key activities:

1. Leadership & Team Management

• Lead the Sales & Structuring function, setting strategic priorities, budgets, KPIs, and performance objectives.
• Develop the team as the bank's center of expertise for Financial Markets, Structured Products, and OTC Derivatives.

2. Business Strategy & Governance

• Define and execute the Sales & Structuring strategy, enhancing product distribution, sales processes, and client solutions.
• Coordinate with Relationship Managers, Advisory, DPM, and Business Development teams to implement strategy across the bank and international locations.
• Chair relevant committees and contribute to governance forums to align product development with client needs and business objectives.

3. Product Solutions & Distribution

• Oversee the development, approval, and management of structured products and derivative solutions for internal and external clients.
• Ensure offerings remain innovative, compliant, and aligned with client needs and the bank's strategy.
• Manage strategic partnerships, distribution agreements, issuance programs, and product distribution channels.

4. Stakeholder & Market Engagement

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, counterparties, partners, and internal stakeholders.
• Promote product adoption, identify market opportunities and trends, and support business growth across the bank.
• Represent the bank with industry participants, partners, and regulators.

Your skills:

• Minimum 12 years of experience in Investment Banking, Financial Markets, Asset Management, and/or Private Banking.
• Strong hands-on experience with complex investment products, risk management, structuring, trading, and sales.
• Demonstrated people management and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop multidisciplinary teams.
• Deep expertise in Financial Markets, with a focus on the sales of financial market instruments and the structuring of structured products and derivatives (vanilla and exotic), encompassing pricing and issuance activities, and supported by a strong understanding of Risk, Regulatory, Legal and Compliance requirements.
• Solid understanding of balance sheet management, sensitivities, and derivative pricing models.
• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field with a strong quantitative focus (MBA or equivalent preferred).
• Fluent in English; French and German are considered an asset.
• Knowledge of VBA, Python, C++, or other programming languages is a plus.

jobs.title: R&T SCIENTIST IN STRUCTURE – FUNCTION STUDY OF SOLUBLE DIETARY FIBRES (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
As part of the Biotechnology Unit, and particularly the Bioformulation Group, you will contribute to the machine learning assisted structure-function study of soluble dietary fibres (galactomannans) isolated from underexplored leguminous seed bioresources in the framework of the ENTANGLE FNR funded project. You will develop clean label procedures to extract and isolate galactomannans from forage legume seed biomass such as alfalfa and clover. In addition, the successful candidate is expected to determine the technofunctional and prebiotic potential of native and enzymatically modified derivatives benchmarked to commercial biopolymer targets.

As a Postdoctoral Researcher, you will mainly be responsible for:
• Extracting, isolating and purifying galactomannans from forage legume seeds
• Enzymatically tailor the chemical structure and technofunctional profile of native galactomannans
• Determine the structure conformational, technological and prebiotic potential of the native and modified galactomannans and
• Promoting and disseminating your research work through high-quality scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals, oral and poster presentations in conferences, and patents.
If you are specialised in food biopolymers, colloids science, and/or food process engineering, with a strong foundation in soft-matter physics and a focus on understanding and tailoring structure–property–function relationships for innovative food applications, please apply and join our new and dynamic team.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The University's main Library, the Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC), located in the heart of the Belval campus, is much more than a library: it is a hub of innovation and knowledge designed to foster research, learning, collaboration and outreach. Its building, a true architectural masterpiece, combines the restructuring of an old industrial hall with bold contemporary design, and spans 14,000 m², 10.7 km of shelving and more a thousand working spaces. It stands as a prestigious façade for Luxembourg and for the University of Luxembourg, reflecting the ambition and academic excellence of both the country and the institution. Equipped with modern infrastructure and advanced technologies, the LLC offers a unique environment where students, researchers, and professionals come together to create, share and innovate. Complementing the central role of the LLC in Belval, a library hub specialising in European law research is located in the Weicker building, benefiting from its proximity to European institutions and Luxembourg's financial district.

Your role
We are looking for a specialist in the Library's strategic growth area of research support and information skills training. Based in Belval, with the opportunity to offer support and training at our other campus locations in Luxembourg, the person will be involved in developing new innovative research support services around research data management, in collaboration with colleagues and senior managers. You will also contribute to developing the information skills training programmes in partnership with the learning and teaching centres of the University. You will help to promote the development of the Library's emerging research support services.
Key Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the development and implementation of research support services, policies, and future service planning
• Provide specialist support for the University's research activities, with a priority on research data management, and additional support around open science, open access, bibliometrics, and scholarly communication
• Assist with the development and management of institutional data and publishing repositories, e.g. contributing to efforts in data quality, compliance with funder requirements, and timely deposit of research outputs
• Support day to day operations of the Library's Research Support team, including responding to enquiries and maintaining service documentation
• Develop and deliver training, workshops, and one to one consultations for researchers, students - bachelor, master and doctoral, and academic research support staff
• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with researchers and students, as well as across the Library and research support services, to establish requirements and inform service delivery
• Promote all research support services of the Library
• Contribute to the development of Library policies and practices
It is anticipated that 80% of the role involves outreach and development of research support services, and 20% of the role involves developing and providing training in information skills topics, e.g. research data management, information literacy and use of digital tools.

Your profile
• Master's degree or equivalent professional experience in an academic, research, digital, or information-intensive environment
• 3+ years' experience in research support environments with a focus on research data management
• In depth knowledge in research data management and related trends
• Library and/or teaching experience is an asset
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to engage diverse stakeholders and promote services
• A PhD is considered an asset
• Full proficiency in English; good knowledge of French or German would be an asset

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
