jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team and help ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of Replit's infrastructure that serves millions of developers worldwide. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will bridge the gap between development and operations, implementing automation and establishing best practices that enable our platform to scale efficiently while maintaining high availability.



We are seeking Staff SREs who are passionate about building and maintaining resilient systems at scale. Your mission will be to proactively find and analyze reliability problems across our stack, then design and implement software and systems to create step-function improvements. You will design robust observability solutions, lead incident response, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve our infrastructure's reliability, all while mentoring and educating the broader engineering team to make reliability a core value at Replit.




YOU WILL:

 - Architect and Implement Observability: Design, build, and lead the implementation of comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions. Create dashboards and metrics that provide real-time visibility into system health and performance, enabling proactive issue detection.

 - Define and Drive Reliability Standards: Work with product and engineering teams to define, implement, and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs). Build systems to monitor and report on these metrics, holding teams accountable and ensuring we maintain high reliability standards while balancing innovation speed.

 - Lead Incident Management and Response: Act as a senior leader during high-impact incidents, guiding the team to rapid resolution. Conduct thorough, blameless post-mortems and drive the implementation of preventative measures. Develop and refine runbooks and build automation to reduce Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).

 - Drive Automation and Infrastructure as Code: Architect, build, and improve automation to eliminate toil and operational work. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation using tools like Terraform or Pulumi. Create self-healing systems that can automatically respond to common failure scenarios.

 - Optimize Performance on Kubernetes: Collaborate with core infrastructure and product teams to performance-tune and optimize our large-scale cloud deployments, with a deep focus on Kubernetes, Docker, and GCP. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, implement capacity planning strategies, and reduce latency across global regions.

 - Debug and Harden Distributed Systems: Dive deep into debugging extremely difficult technical problems across the stack. Use your findings to design and implement long-term fixes that make our systems and products more robust, operable, and easier to diagnose.

 - Provide Staff-Level Guidance: Review feature and system designs from across the company, acting as a key owner for the reliability, scalability, security, and operational integrity of those designs.

 - Educate and Mentor: Educate, mentor, and hold accountable the broader engineering team to improve the reliability of our systems, making reliability a core value of the Replit engineering culture.

 - Build and Integrate: Write high-quality, well-tested code in Python or Go to meet the needs of your customers, whether it's building new internal tools or integrating with third-party vendors.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 8-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or similar roles (e.g., DevOps, Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering).

 - Strong programming skills in languages like Python or Go. You write high-quality, well-tested code.

 - Deep understanding of distributed systems. You’ve designed, built, scaled, and maintained production services and know how to compose a service-oriented architecture.

 - Deep experience with container orchestration platforms, specifically Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies.

 - Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining sophisticated monitoring and observability solutions (e.g., metrics, logging, tracing).

 - Strong incident management skills with extensive experience leading incident response for complex systems and demonstrated critical thinking under pressure.

 - Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi) and configuration management tools.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and simply and a bias toward open, transparent cultural practices.

 - Strong interpersonal skills, with experience working with and mentoring engineers from junior to principal levels.

 - A willingness to dive into understanding, debugging, and improving any layer of the stack.

 - You're passionate about making software creation accessible and empowering the next generation of builders.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools.

 - Expert-level knowledge of modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

 - Experience designing and building reliable systems capable of handling high throughput and low latency.

 - Significant experience with Go and Terraform.

 - Familiarity with working in rapid-growth, startup environments.

 - Experience writing company-facing blog posts and training materials.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.description:
Manager / Senior Manager - Forensic & AML - Consulting (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.
We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.
We offer excellent career prospects that balance autonomy, flexibility, and responsibility. Our comprehensive benefits inspire our people do and feel their best.

Right now, we have more than 1800 employees from over 70 nationalities. Join our growing group of young and youthful innovators to uncover a world of opportunity together.

Job Description

We are seeking a Manager / Senior Manager in Forensic & AML Consulting

Governance, Regulatory and Compliance continues to be a complex business challenge. As new laws and regulations are introduced, companies' management needs to ensure that corporate governance standards are adhered to and that robust compliance management systems are in place, especially as non-compliance with regulatory requirements is under increased scrutiny from regulators.
In a period of heightened regulatory scrutiny and continuing globalization of AML/CTF regulation, organizations are faced with greater challenges to achieving and maintaining their AML/CTF compliance.

Our Forensic & AML services team, part of our Advisory department is advising clients on how to deal with and meet these regulatory challenges, assisting them in their efforts to prevent, detect and respond to money laundering, corruption and fraud issues.

What you will be working on

• Review, design and implementation of AML/CTF control framework
• Review and preparation of ML/TF risk assessment
• AML/TAX remediation
• AML/CTF compliance assistance
• Provide clients with AML/CTF training and updates Work with a broad range of clients across different industries, with a focus on Asset Management
• Promote our service offerings externally, engage in go-to-market and business development efforts, including the preparation of proposals for prospective clients and client presentations, marketing materials
• Maintain an awareness of current marketplace issues and stay up-to-date with emerging regulatory requirements and guidance
• Actively participate in the management and development of Junior Advisers to Assistant Managers

What we look for

• University degree or equivalent in Business, Economics, Law or other relevant subjects
• 7 to 12 years of experience in AML/CTF/KYC, fraud, bribery and corruption, sanction regimes within the financial sector, or a similar experience within a consulting firm with similar activities
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg and international AML/CTF regulatory framework
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to apply sound reasoning when delivering services to clients
• Strong attention to details, ability to manage teams and multiple priorities
• Fluency in English & French and/or German

What will you get

KPMG is where you will find the right opportunities to advance your career and the widest available range of possibilities so you can grow professionally. Make a real impact, join a diverse team of leading experts, work with global clients, and discover technological solutions.

By submitting your resume and application information, you authorize KPMG to transmit and store your information in the KPMG recruitment database, and to circulate that information as necessary for the purpose of evaluating your qualifications for this or other job vacancies.
KPMG is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. Our recruiting decisions are based on your experience and skills.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Support (m/f)
jobs.description:
À propos de Rotarex Firetec

Rotarex Firetec est une entreprise mondiale de référence dans le domaine des solutions d'extinction incendie, avec plusieurs millions d'installations à travers le monde.

Business Unit de Rotarex, Rotarex Firetec s'appuie sur un réseau international de centres de services et de distributeurs présents dans 65 pays.

Depuis plus de 100 ans, Rotarex Firetec développe des produits innovants qui sont devenus des références dans l'industrie. Notre expertise repose sur trois piliers essentiels : l'innovation, la qualité et l'excellence technique.


Localisation : Lintgen, Luxembourg

Le poste est actuellement basé sur notre site de Lintgen, au Luxembourg, avec un déménagement en cours vers notre nouveau site industriel 4.0 à Bissen, conçu pour offrir un environnement de travail moderne et pensé pour le confort de nos collaborateurs.


Votre mission

En tant que Support Technique Commercial, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'accompagnement de notre réseau commercial international et contribuerez au développement de nos activités dans le domaine des systèmes d'extinction incendie.

Vous apporterez votre expertise technique aux équipes commerciales et aux clients, les accompagnerez dans la conception et la sélection de solutions adaptées et assurerez le lien entre les équipes commerciales, les clients et les différents départements internes.


Vos missions seront les suivantes :

Support technique et accompagnement commercial

    Harmoniser les outils et les méthodes de support technique utilisés au sein du réseau commercial international

    Apporter un support technique avant et après-vente aux Sales Managers locaux et aux clients concernant la conception des systèmes, les spécifications techniques et les performances des solutions d'extinction incendie

    Mettre à jour et améliorer continuellement les configurateurs techniques

    Réaliser des présentations techniques et des démonstrations produits afin de renforcer la compréhension des clients et des équipes commerciales

    Accompagner les équipes commerciales dans le cadre des appels d'offres et des projets en préparant des réponses techniques détaillées et des solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients


Support clients et interventions terrain

    Agir en tant qu'interlocuteur technique pour les clients et accompagner la résolution de problématiques techniques complexes liées aux systèmes d'extinction incendie

    Effectuer des déplacements sur site afin d'apporter un support technique lors de l'installation, de la mise en service et de la maintenance des systèmes

    Développer et maintenir les ressources techniques nécessaires au support des équipes et des clients, notamment les guides de formation, benchmarks, spécifications systèmes, fiches techniques et FAQ

    Participer à la revue et à l'amélioration des manuels techniques et apporter un support aux équipes R&D lorsque nécessaire


Formation et transmission des connaissances

    Mettre à jour et maintenir les supports de formation, y compris les modules de formation en ligne

    Animer et superviser des formations techniques destinées aux clients et aux différents interlocuteurs du réseau commercial

    Émettre les certificats de formation et assurer le suivi des participants


Expertise réglementaire et connaissance du marché

    Assurer une veille sur les normes et évolutions réglementaires susceptibles d'impacter les systèmes d'extinction incendie

    Accompagner les équipes locales dans la compréhension des exigences réglementaires et des certifications applicables


Collaboration et amélioration continue

    Recueillir les retours des clients et des différents marchés afin d'identifier des opportunités d'amélioration des produits et des services

    Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Marketing, Product Management et Sales afin de développer des contenus techniques destinés aux supports promotionnels et à l'information des clients


Votre profil

Formation et expérience

    Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bachelor en ingénierie, commerce ou dans un domaine connexe

    Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée dans des fonctions de support technique et/ou de développement commercial, idéalement dans les secteurs de la sécurité incendie ou des équipements industriels

    Vous possédez de solides connaissances techniques des systèmes d'extinction incendie, des stations de remplissage de gaz ou de technologies similaires


⚙️ Compétences techniques et professionnelles

    Vous disposez d'une forte aptitude technique et êtes capable de comprendre et de résoudre efficacement des problématiques liées à des systèmes complexes

    Vous possédez une bonne compréhension des enjeux commerciaux et savez identifier des opportunités de développement

    Vous disposez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, ainsi que d'une réelle capacité à former différents types d'interlocuteurs

    Vous possédez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles et êtes capable de construire et d'entretenir des relations de confiance avec les clients

    Vous êtes organisé, rigoureux et capable de gérer plusieurs projets et échéances simultanément

    Vous maîtrisez les outils Microsoft Office et SAP


Langues et mobilité

    Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et l'anglais

    La connaissance d'autres langues constitue un atout

    Vous êtes disposé à effectuer des déplacements professionnels lorsque nécessaire

jobs.title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

jobs.title: Senior QA Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenriscreations.com/en/postings/d315eb37-715d-4657-b29d-484420749257
Application deadline 8th of october 2026

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team and serve as a strategic partner to our rapidly expanding enterprise sales organization. In this high-impact role, you'll drive complex commercial negotiations that fuel our growth, working closely with our sales teams to close sophisticated technology agreements with enterprise customers across diverse industries. You'll play a critical role in scaling our commercial legal processes while navigating the evolving landscape of AI-powered development tools and ensuring our customers can confidently deploy Replit's platform in their organizations.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive Enterprise Deals: Serve as the lead legal advisor for complex, high-value enterprise sales transactions, working directly with our Account Executives and customer legal teams to negotiate and close sophisticated software agreements

 - Navigate AI & Technology Compliance: Help enterprise customers understand and navigate the legal and regulatory implications of adopting AI-powered development tools, addressing data privacy, security, and compliance requirements across various industries

 - Build Scalable Frameworks: Design and implement contract playbooks, template agreements, and streamlined processes that enable our sales team to move quickly while maintaining legal rigor as we scale

 - Risk Management: Identify, analyze, and proactively manage complex commercial and legal risks while maintaining deal velocity in our fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and Privacy teams to ensure our commercial offerings align with product capabilities and regulatory requirements

 - Strategic Advisory: Provide strategic guidance to leadership on commercial legal matters, emerging AI regulations, and market trends affecting developer tools and enterprise software adoption

 - Customer Relationship Building: Foster strong relationships with enterprise customer legal teams, becoming a trusted advisor who helps facilitate smooth adoption of Replit's platform




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Legal Foundation: JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar

 - Commercial Experience: 5-7 years of relevant legal experience supporting enterprise software sales and complex commercial transactions, preferably at high-growth technology companies

 - Technology Focus: Strong background in SaaS agreements, software licensing, and technology transactions, with bonus points for experience with AI/ML tools, developer platforms, or cloud infrastructure

 - Deal Velocity: Proven track record of successfully closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in fast-paced environments while balancing legal risk with business objectives

 - Business Acumen: Exceptional business judgment and ability to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice that enables (rather than blocks) commercial success

 - Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives and enterprise customer stakeholders

 - Startup DNA: Thrives in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments where you'll need to build processes from the ground up and adapt quickly to changing priorities

 - Collaboration: Collaborative mindset with a track record of building strong cross-functional relationships and supporting high-velocity sales processes




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - In-House Experience: Previous in-house counsel experience at technology companies, particularly those serving enterprise customers or developer audiences

 - AI/Developer Tools: Experience with AI, machine learning, or developer platform companies, including understanding of the unique legal considerations around code generation and AI-assisted development

 - Industry Knowledge: Experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries or understanding of compliance requirements across different sectors

 - Scale Experience: Experience supporting sales teams through hypergrowth phases, including building legal processes that scale with rapid revenue expansion


This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

jobs.title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;
- Représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur : entreprises, bureaux d'études, architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, partenaires industriels ;
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires sur les marchés ciblés ;
- Participer à la structuration des méthodes commerciales et du suivi client ;
- Contribuer au développement des activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives.
Profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée en chargé d'affaires, conduite de projets, développement commercial BTP, construction métallique, ingénierie ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne compréhension des dossiers techniques, plans, métrés, chiffrages et contraintes chantier ;
- Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires en parallèle avec rigueur et autonomie ;
- Aisance dans la relation client, la négociation et la coordination d'interlocuteurs variés ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer son activité ;
- Profil terrain, réactif, fiable et orienté solutions ;
- Une expérience dans la construction métallique, le bâtiment industriel, l'enveloppe du bâtiment ou les structures métalliques serait fortement appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compréhension technique et commerciale, nous recherchons une personne capable de prendre en main des affaires de manière autonome, de sécuriser le suivi des projets et de contribuer concrètement au développement du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration
- CDI ou collaboration selon profil ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des clients / partenaires ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events

Education
• Master's degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline relevant to environmental sustainability, such as: industrial ecology, environmental engineering, environmental or ecological economics or computational social science
• Solid academic grounding in Planetary Boundaries, Doughnut Economics, Post Growth or degrowth literature
• Familiarity with Decent Living Standards and Quality of Life frameworks

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:

• Frugal AI / Green AI and, in general, the design and deployment of AI models in low-resource environments.

jobs.description:
PROJEKTANT SURADNIK (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant suradnik (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant suradnik sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih rad

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Software Engineer, User Database Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

You’ll build the systems that let any knowledge worker leverage fast, scalable databases without having to become a DBA.

You’ll be a hands-on technical leader, helping set the architectural direction and roadmap as we take a new product from early alpha to general availability. You’ll work directly with early customers to shape foundational technical and product decisions. Then, together, we’ll work on scaling as adoption and workloads grow.

This is a backend-leaning role with work spanning the stack. You might build the systems that provision and manage a fleet of customer Postgres instances, design how user-defined schemas evolve safely, or make complex queries execute efficiently. You’ll also follow those systems into the product: improving how a table loads, how users understand a slow operation, or how an agent safely works with their data.

You’ll help shape the architecture and the product together. Some problems call for a better abstraction, others for a better default, and others for rethinking what we ask the user to do in the first place. You’ll work with teammates and customers to find those answers, ship practical solutions, and evolve them as usage grows.



Our stack includes Postgres, Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and React.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The people who understand a business best aren’t always the people who can build its software. A support lead knows how tickets should be triaged. An operations manager knows how inventory should move. But turning that knowledge into a reliable system often means finding an engineer, provisioning a database, and building an application.

We’re building database infrastructure for everyone else. We want everyday knowledge workers to bring their data into Notion, connect it, and build workflows around it. And do so with the power of a real database (Postgres!) and the approachability of a tool they already know.

AI agents make that opportunity even bigger: helping people build and operate systems they couldn’t have created on their own.

For our team, this is much more than putting a friendly interface on Postgres. It means making hard database problems disappear from the user’s workflow without sacrificing correctness, performance, or flexibility. How do you let someone reshape a live database as easily as editing a document? Make the right indexes exist without asking someone to become a DBA? Let a weekend experiment grow into a company’s system of record without anyone having to rearchitect it?




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take a new product from alpha to general availability. Work with early customers to understand what matters, iterate on feedback, and help shape what we ship.

 - Make real customer workloads fast. Improve query execution, indexing, and client data loading so performance holds up as datasets grow and workflows become more demanding.

 - Build systems businesses can trust with their data. Make schema changes, concurrent writes, permissions, and recovery reliable enough for customers to build essential workflows on top.

 - Make powerful capabilities approachable. Turn database provisioning, migrations, and indexes into a reliable, easy-to-use product experience that gives people the power of a database without the burden of managing one.

 - Build for the customers who come next. Automate database provisioning and fleet operations, strengthen observability, and evolve the architecture so we can serve many, many customers.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production relational database experience (e.g., Postgres or MySQL). You’ve made decisions about schemas and indexes, analyzed database performance, and debugged issues involving transactions, locking, or concurrency. Your experience goes beyond accessing a database through an ORM.

 - Engineering experience and technical leadership. You bring 10+ years of experience building and operating production software, with a track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, cross-team initiatives from concept through delivery. You identify the most important problems to solve, turn ambiguous goals into a technical strategy, and align engineers and partner teams around a practical plan. You stay hands-on while helping others make better decisions through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical guidance.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals. You’ve built services that need to remain correct under concurrency and failure. You can reason about retries, partial failures, consistency, and the trade-offs involved in reliable reads and writes.

 - A systematic approach to performance. You use query plans, traces, profiles, and experiments to find bottlenecks and verify improvements. You’re willing to follow a problem across storage, services, and client code rather than stopping at a team boundary.

 - Product judgment. You’re interested in who will use what you build, not just how it works. You can turn a customer’s problem into a technical approach and recognize when a better default or simpler workflow would solve it more effectively.

 - Willingness to work across the stack. You bring backend depth, but you’re comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and working in client code when that’s what delivering a good experience requires.

 - Fluency with AI-assisted engineering. You use AI to accelerate exploration, implementation, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience managing fleets of databases or building database platforms, including provisioning, upgrades, backups, and recovery.

 - Deep Postgres expertise, such as advanced query optimization, performance tuning, or workload isolation for large datasets and high-concurrency workloads.

 - Experience building query layers, sync engines, change-data-capture pipelines, permission systems, or other reusable data abstractions.
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!

The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 

While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.

This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
  • Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
  • Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
  • Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
  • Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
  • Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
  • Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
  • Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
  • Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
  • Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
  • Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
  • Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.title: UREĐIVAČ/ICA VIDEOZAPISA / SADRŽAJA ZA DRUŠTVENE MREŽE
jobs.description:
Tražimo junior content creatora / video editora Rvstica (sapunerija.com) traži vrijednu i odgovornu osobu koja voli snimati i montirati video sadržaj. Moguće korištenje mjera aktivne politike zapošljavanja. Uvjeti radnog mjesta:
  • Puno radno vrijeme
  • Fleksibilno radno vrijeme
  • Plaća 1100 eura neto, dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije ostvarene putem videa koje osoba snimi i montira.
  • Početak rada 1.10. 2026.
  • Potreban vlastiti prijevoz, zato je dobro imati osobni automobil.
Opis posla:
  • Snimanje kratkih video sadržaja za Reels, TikTok i Stories: proizvodnja sapuna, uživo radionice izrade sapuna, priroda, "behind the scenes", UGC videi s korištenjem proizvoda, priče o proizvodu.
  • Montiranje videa u CapCutu, uz dinamične rezove, titlove i ubacivanje slika.
  • Pisanje scenarija prema zadanim edukacijama, uz praćenje trendova na Instagramu i TikToku i predlaganje ideja za sadržaj.
  • Snimanje se odvija u Tučepima, dok se video montaža radi kod kuće.
Koga tražimo:
  • Osobu s osjećajem za vizualno pripovijedanje i ritam montaže, s iskustvom ili jakim interesom za CapCut i format Reels/TikTok.
  • Kreativnu, samoinicijativnu osobu s okom za detalje, vrijednu i marljivu, spremnu puno učiti i savladati edukacije koje odredimo. Prethodno profesionalno iskustvo nije potrebno.
  • Poželjno je poznavanje osnova marketinga društvenih mreža, fotografije i rada s kamerom, mobitel je dovoljan za početak. Zanimanje za prirodnu kozmetiku, održivost i "slow living" estetiku predstavlja prednost ali nije nužno.
Poslodavac nudi:
  • Rad na autentičnom, vizualno bogatom terenu (proizvodnja sapuna, maslinici, radionice izrade sapuna, konoba), kreativnu slobodu u oblikovanju sadržaja, plaćene edukacije video editinga i marketinga općenito, te dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije videa.
  • Osobi koja pokaže rezultate i želju za razvojem nudimo mogućnost napredovanja unutar brenda, povećanje plaće uz kontinuirano mentorstvo i vođenje kroz edukacije.
Prijave slati na mail

jobs.description:
Otsime laialdase kogemusega brigadiri, kes meeskonna tööd juhiks platsil.

Tööülesanded: Tööde planeerimine ja juhtimine: Brigaadi igapäevatöö organiseerimine, ülesannete jagamine ja jooksvate probleemide lahendamine.
Kvaliteedi ja tehnoloogia kontroll: Raketiste paigalduse, armeerimise, betoneerimise ja betooni järelhoolduse vastavuse kontrollimine ehitusprojektile ning normidele. Tööohutuse tagamine: Ohutusnõuete täitmise jälgimine ehitusplatsil ja tellingutel. Materjalide ja tööriistade haldus: Vajalike materjalide (betoon, sarrused, raketised) ja seadmete õigeaegse olemasolu ning säästliku kasutamise tagamine. Aruandlus: Tehtud tööde mahu ja töötundide arvestuse pidamine ning info edastamine objektijuhile.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist palka, mis vastab Sinu oskustele ja kogemustele
Alati õigeaegselt laekuvat töötasu ja ametlikku vormistamist. Stabiilset ja aastaringset tööd (meil on objektid olemas ka talveperioodil). Ametiautot või isikliku auto kompensatsiooni objektide vahel liikumiseks.Vajadusel tasuta majutust ja transporti ettevõtte poolt, kui objektid asuvad kodukohast kaugel. Võimalust rääkida kaasa tööprotsesside parendamisel ja meeskonna komplekteerimisel.

Muud nõuded: Vajalikud oskused ja omadused:
Erialane pädevus: Pikaajaline praktiline kogemus betoonitöödel (raketised, armatuur, valu, viimistlus) ja jooniste lugemise oskus. Juhtimisoskus: Võime meeskonda motiveerida, delegeerida ja konflikte lahendada. Pingetaluvus: Ehitusplatsil muutuvad olud kiiresti (ilmastik, tarneajad), mis nõuab kiiret reageerimist. Keeleoskus: lisaks eesti keelele ka vene keele oskus, et suhelda eri rahvusest töölistega.

jobs.title: Design Engineer (Web & Brand)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Design Engineer with strong visual taste to help drive our creative initiatives across web and brand. When it comes to design and code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story—what we're building and why it matters—as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

What you'll do

 - You will be responsible for building complex and interactive UI web/app experiences

 - Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

 - Implement creative animations and interactions in code

 - Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

 - Eye for good design

 - Strong frontend engineering skills

 - Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

 - Experience with React and TypeScript

 - Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

 - A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

 - Paid lunch and coffee during work days

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we use AI in design https://designerfund.substack.com/p/ai-design-linear feature of Linear's design team

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post
